I was shocked when the salesman told me it was a 4 cyl.  It was a beautiful car and extremely fun to drive.  We only have 2000 miles on it so I can't comment about problems.  So far, we haven't had any.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: This car is an absolute mess. I bought this car my senior year in high school, and it has been nothing but a headache. I bought it used from a guy, and within two days the thing was overheating. I replaced the whole coolant system myself, only to find out that it was the head gasket, so I put in a new engine. Then it was the struts that I had to replace. Then it was the ball joints. Then it was the control arms. Then the battery which do I even dare to say that the dang thing is under the wheel well on the driver side, so you have to take the wheel off to get to it. After 6 months of tampering with everything, it was okay for a while until the electicity started to go out. Both windows on the passenger side don't go down, the driver side window went off track, and now the power steering is even acting up. The car only has at this point 160,000 miles. After all of the repairs, I paid 2300 for the car and then another 2000 to fix all the crap, and Ill only get about 600 for it. Interior design is nice. Very roomy. But in the end it is not worth it. Invest into a different vehicle. Please. For your own sake.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: Ive had this car for about 2 years baught from a used car shop in very good shape out of the 2 years ive had it only have had to change the spark plugs and plug wires and oil so i think its been a damn good car and i love it

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I bought a new Dodge Stratus from Chapman Autoplex in Scottsdale back in 2003. Traded a leased car in and ended up buying a new Dodge Stratus. This car was in and out of the shop the entire time I owned it. Factory warranty covered very few of the repairs and the extended warranty didnt cover anything. Airbag light went on and horn quit working at 20,000 mi. By 42,000 mi I already had to replace all of my brakes-drums, everything. My struts and shocks went bad at 60k, transmission was starting to give me trouble and car was not running well at 4 yrs old. Car got totaled by a drunk driver (thankfully) in '08 and airbag didnt go off and it should have. Will never buy another Dodge again. I currently have a Kia Soul...90k miles, hardly any trouble, just got brakes replaced and this car has been 20x better than the Dodge Stratus.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review_Title: Looks good, decent mpg, cheap to keep and simple
Review: Bought the 03 Stratus with 56000 miles a corp lease well maintained records, 136000 now, only repairs were rear shocks and brakes, did timing belt service at 115000, it's been very cheap to keep. Not very fast but the iron block 4 cyl engine keeps going no leaks or oil usage between oil changes. Trans serviced every 35000 miles still shifts smoothly. So far so good our 03 Altima bought new only has 80000 and has had about 7 repairs so far 2 no starts, mostly engine elec.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review_Title: Low cost to own and fun to drive as 4 cyl. eco cars go
Review: Bought new in 03 4 cyl auto good value and to our surprize it's cost to operate has been lower than our japanese car our mother drives, not as well refined but still fun to drive and quieter ride. No issues yet with 140,000 miles except rear struts were replaced. 4 cyl engine not real fast but simple to service and reliable.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review_Title: this car is garbage worst investment ever
Review: this car has been nothing but a nightmare to own i am a person that likes to do maintenance on my own but that's pretty much impossible. the water pump is on the inside of the engine and costed me $800 to get replaced, the thermostat is on the bottom of the engine and requires you to remove the alternator, battery is located inside the wheel well and you have to remove the tire and splash guard to get to it, just about anything you work on with this car will take 2 times longer than a normal car it was built A$$ backwards i would not tell anyone to buy this car unless they have a LOT of time and money on their hands to fix it.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: I bought this car with 50,000 miles on it six years ago. so far I have only done some normal maintance. changed timing belt twice and front brake pads once. now at 206,000 mile mark i have had to change one front wheel bearing. and the transmission is slipping. would have lasted longer if i had changed the fluid and filter like i should have. i have beat this car into the ground and it is still going. i put 36,000 to 40,000 miles a year on this car for the last three years. so i will be putting a transmission in it and keep on driveing it. and i plan on driveing it till the body rusts away. i live in south carolina and there is no rust on it yet so i will be driveing this car for a long time

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review_Title: 1st new car, worst car I ever owned
Review: This car was built cheaply. Here is all the things that have gone wrong with it in the 8 years and 89,000 miles.year 2 new brakes and rotorsyear 3 drivers side window came off the track $300year 4 new brakes and rotors, gas gauge stopped working causing $300 bill to replace gas pump, heater fan will only work on highyear 5 engine blew up, I had oil change every 3 months, it was under warrantyyear 6 new brakes and rotors, all windows rattle inside doorsyear 7 transmission had to be rebuiltyear 8 rear strut mounts totally disintergrated because they were made out of cheap aluminum, new brakes and rotorsI can finally get rid of it this year. My wife and I alternate buying cars.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I purchased my 2003 stratus brand new.. I loved it, the only reason I no longer own it is because I traded it for an SUV, becuse 3rd baby was not going to fit in the stratus.. I NEVER had any problems with the vehicle, beside normal wear and tear, and regular maintenance. I HATE the BUICK RENDEZVOUS I ended upo trading in for... My review for that is up too! I am thinking about purchasing another stratus, 2006 model. I loved the stratus!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: I bought this car used because it was such a great deal compared to other cars. It has been very dependable, and is overall a wonderful car to own. This is the 2.4 liter SXT model. I would really recommend this car to anyone on a budget. Just remember to buy from a private party.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I have had my stratus for four years. I have had to replace the cold air intake, transmission parts, fuses, water pump, timing belt, and starter. Every few months something else is wrong with this car. The latest episode was the car engine shut off in the middle of th freeway going 70 leaving me without power steering or braking. My car did not give any warning signs before this. no smells, sounds or rough handling. Not only did this car almost kill me but has often left me stranded.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I bought 2003 SE 4 Dr in July 2005 for $9,000. It had 54,000 miles on it. It now has 118,000 miles and I had to replace a tie rod and a blower motor in the 4 years that I owned it.  Other than routine maintenance, oil changes, brakes.timing belt, I have had no major problems. This car is fun to drive and I usually get from 25-28 miles per gallon. I have the 2.4 engine. I am looking now to buy a 2006 and keep this one as a second car. This car is light brown and I will try to find a low mileage red one next.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I bought the car in October of 2002.  Picked it up w/ the shrink wrap still on the car and 0 miles on the odometer. I like the car and the styling, but it has become a maintenance headache. 77k miles, and I've had to replace: rear struts, rear brakes, rear strut mounts, transmission solinoid, coolant overflow, front bearings, rust repair on door and on body, and trip computer on top of normal maintenance.  The car from day one has also had a fantom ground issue in which on occasions it will: not lock the doors, sunroof stays open, dash lights go bright, cylinder 5 won't fire, speedometer acts up, etc. And most resently the torque converter has started acting up. I'd be cautious w/ the RT.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review_Title: its a c+ rating at best
Review: Fun to put it in corners w/ 16" wheels the road ride is stiff like sporty vehicle, nice. Glass all around few blind spots. I have problems with it that Dodge can't find to fix.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: Bought the car on Labor Day weekend '06 and have never regretted it. It's a four-door with the R/T package, deep metallic red, looks great, runs great, roomy, comfortable, great gas mileage, has all the bells and whistles (leather, 6-disc cd changer, sunroof, etc.), just an all- around great car. The perfomance is definitely suprising. Ours has the automatic with Autostick and can pass pretty much anything you want to (it can do over 110 in third!). It can at least run with 3 Series Beemers with ease:). Definitely get the V6 if you are considering one, they're suprising powerful and get good gas mileage (we average at least 30-32). And we always get compliments on the styling. Great car.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: This was an excellent purchase. The car has outpeformed our previous vehicle a 2000 Ford Taurus. It is peppey and fun to drive and the gas mileage is excellent. Not as comfortable on a long trip as the bigger car, but not unbearable either. We have had no mechanical problems with this car with 91K on the odometer right now.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: I bought my Status off the line. Great car! Have had very little trouble in over 62k miles. Only had a tire rod break on front right tire. It was under warranty.  And now my blower 1-3 is out. Not too bad for over 3 years of owership.  Just bad at Christmas.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: The '96 was much more enjoyable.  The transmission has had trouble since day 1 in the 2003 model, and I've had nothing but trouble dealing with the Dodge dealerships to fix it. Even though the transmission was replaced 6 months after I bought it, it has had problems the whole time of ownership. I've had the car for 3 years. It has left me stranded on more than one occassion.  I've never been so disappointed in a car in all my life. I know one thing, my next car won't be a Dodge of any kind, ever again.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review_Title: How it handled in an accident.
Review: I was in an accident last week in my 2003 Stratus SE because a fool on a four-lane highway decided to turn left from the right lane, and while I was traveling in that left lane. (He said I was in his blind spot. Guess he never took driver's ed.!) He nearly t-boned me, but I have lived to tell the story. The car was totalled. Both airbags went off, the windshield broke, the front right side sustained much damage, but I was able to get it stopped in a field, not tip over, and pretty much got control as soon as possible. His car was about the size of mine, which helped, but I now have enough faith in the car to buy a 2005 version, which we did just tonight.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: This is just a great vehicle. I justhave the SE model, so I don't have allthe goodies, but nontheless it performesgreat. The gas mileage is good, runsquiet with just a little road noise. Ithandles well and the 4 cylinder is peppyand made for the do-it-yourselftune-ups. The engine warms upunbelievably fast and the heater willblow you away. But the A/C could be alittle colder. You can use your cupholders without your cup getting in theway of anything. The seats arecomfortable even on long trips. Usesemi-synthetic oil, I find that itimproves mileage and smoothness in thisengine. Don't use high priced brakepads. Just use the cheap semi metallicpads or it will eat your rotors.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: We just bought it and paid 10,000 for it.I didn't want a sedan initially, but I am very happy with the styling and solidity of the car.It could use a few more amonites, but other than that we are happy wih our purchase.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: This is my 2nd stratus & very happy

column1: with it.  Only gripe is the doors
squeak. dealer replace all hinges and
they still squeak.  brakes are much
improved over previous model.  fuel
economy is not as good as previous
model. pretty peppy for a 4cyl car.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I ordered a 95 dodge stratus ES (loaded) with a 5 spd, which was a blast to drive, great gas mileage too... I always thought it needed a v6. Not the wimpy 2.5 liter-150hp w/ automatic MTX only, which was an option that 1st year.The 2003 r/t with the 200hp magnum, match up with the 5 spd, is exactly what it needed. I have had no issues with the vehicle at all. It is powerful, handles extremely well and most vehicles will have trouble keeping up with it. (If that interests you)I look forward to driving it every day. The gas mileage is great. The engine is very smooth and delivers its 200hp nicely.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I love my stratus, good car and nice looking too.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I traded in my 2001 Dodge Durango because of the horrible fuel milage (12/17mpg) I was getting. I am very pleased with the 18.5/27.5 I am getting now.  It handles great with the 17" tires.  The 2.7 is pretty peppy for its size.  Anybody know where I can get aftermarket permormance parts for 2.7? The one thing I do miss is the heated leather seats from the Durango. The R/T is a sharp looking, good value for the price.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: Well I don't really know if its the safest but when I got in an accident with my dodge stratus, it saved my life.   The car took the impact in all the right places and the driver and I walked away just fine.  If you could see the picturesof the accident, you'd be amazed.  I'm buying another one.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I am so in love with my car. I've owned three other vehicles since I've been driving and my Stratus is the most enjoyable for both style and reliability. Dodge, keep doing what you do.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan ES 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: Traded in a 99 Breeze with 83,000 milesfor this Stratus 4 cylinder ES used with19,000 on it.So far its been a Greatcar. Some minor adjustments like noisywiper blades and excessive wind noisefrom the drivers door.I will have to goback to have this fixed again as theyadjusted the door, but its still there.Also need to get corrected a noisy winefrom altenator. Otherwise it ridessmooth and fairly quiet.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: It seems to be a rough ride

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan ES 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review_Title: Excellent middle of the road car
Review: Realize that this is not a performance car, so performance gets an "average." Comfort-wise, the seats are cushy, and the steering wheel feels good--not cheap. Fun to drive? Not particularly. Interior is well thought out, very simple. The styling of the exterior is pleasing to my eye, especially the shorter windows. It has a kind of "meaner" look to it than its predecessor. As for reliability, it always starts up as soon as the key is turned--no delays. I've never had a problem with my 1999 Stratus, and I sure don't expect to have too many problems with this one.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: The fuel milage is awful. We started out getting 22.7 in town, but the milage has fallen with each suceeding fill up to 16.5. We can only get 25 on the highway. Also on days with a temps over 115 the idle is erratic. The car will almost stall coming a stop. On one very hot 126 degree day the idle jumped to 2000 rpms causing the car to lurch forward almost causing an accident. The dealer can find nothing wrong and says that the Chrysler Eng. Dept. claims this is normal for all Chrysler 4 cyl. engines in hot weather. Chrysler Corp. won't help so I have filed a complaint with the NTSA regarding the sudden engine acceleration problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SE 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I love my Dodge Stratus,it fun car driveit has lots of power.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased my 2003 Stratus RT in December of 2002 after my 2002 Chrystler Sebring sedan was totalled out.  I was hit by someone(estimated to be driving in excess of 65 mph)that ran a stop sign.  Almost everyone that saw my Sebring said that I should have been killed, but I walked away from the accident with a few fractures, lots of brusies and a fear of driving.  About a month after my accident I found my Stratus R/T and purchased it.  I feel safer in it than I did in my Sebring.  My Stratus R/T has helped to restore my life.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan SXT 4dr Sedan (2.4L 4cyl 4A)
Review: Bought the car new and have been very satisfied!  Sexy styling and eye catching color (inferno red) is just the beginning!  Rides great, quiet, comfortable and enough accessories to satisfy creature comforts.  So far (2500 miles), no problems or rattles.  Fold down rear seats are a hidden value.  Good basic trasportation makes this vehicle a good car for the money.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I should have known better than to by another Dodge.  Much like my 97 Caravan this car has been one problem after another.  My ABS has failed 4 times on the car and Chrysler has done very little to try to fix it.  The 5 speed is hard to shift, often requiring a double clutch to get the car to shift, which the dealer tells me is normal.  I have been driving manual shift cars for 15 years and have never had these issues.  The car is sluggish, our other car is an 02 VW Cabrio with a 4 banger and it runs every but as well as my R/T.  Dealer tells me that is the thin air in Colorado.  I think the car is thin on good old HP.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: love the car.  i drove a 92 chevy corsica for 10 years...so this is great.  I've only had the car for about a month, but i've had a lot of compliments.  I have never seen another 4 dr R/T on the road though.  Not as quick as I'd though it would be, but it  handles better than I thought.  One complaint is that there are only 4 color options

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan ES 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: What a great car - I have never been as happy with a purchase as I am with my Stratus.  It's powerful and fun to drive and has more room than most other sedans, esp. in back seat and cargo areas.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: this is the one of the coolest and

column1: sweetest looking family cars out there
trust me after puting my intake in
that baby was even fast and boy is she
fun to drive

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Dodge Stratus Sedan R/T 4dr Sedan (2.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I've only put on a couple hundred miles, but here is my first impressions:  Fun to drive w/ excellent handling.  Good feel of brakes.  Steering a little over sensitive, but responsive.  Horsepower OK...nothing to write home about.  I have noticed a couple squeaks and rattles inside...typical Dodge.  Overall, about the most fun you can have in a car that is still practical.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Loved this truck when I bought it, but the exhaust has rusted at 48,000 miles.  Chrysler was no help, found out the truck was made in Mexico.  I think for a truck that has been maintained and well taken care of should have an exhaust system that did not rust out so soon.  My Chevy Duramx has held up better, no rust underneath, no problems with the truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Cummins Diesel will tow anything on you can think of.  But the downfall on my truck is the front suspension components and the weak transmission. I love the truck to death, yet hate the front components.  Family of five can go on 1000+ mile trips comfortably while refueling only once.  The enormous fuel tank allows this. Added 4.5Inch Exhaust, AFE Stage 2 Intake and also a Hypertech Econ Tuner to increase fuel mileage.  My truck is definitely a workhorse!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Best truck, best vehicle I have ever had.  Cummings will pull anything you have.  Added larger tires to fill in wheel wells.  Went from 265/70-17 to 285/70-17 added about 1 inch in height.  Does very well off road.  Get 19-20 city and 20-22 highway.  If you are looking for a porsche ride go buy a porsche.  This is a truck and rides accordingly.  The only thing that has broken on it so far is the power seat. It will go up, back, forward but not down.  Love the option of a sun roof. Huge back seat.  Had to sit in it a couple of times.  Love the fact that the back seat reclines.  I will drive the truck until it falls apart.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is a diesel megacab, 2WD review. 93000 on the odometer-maybe will be called the best overall vehicle I've owned.  On the road 22.4 mpg, in town 19-no hot doggin, and yes, the truck is capable of spinning the tires- whenever.  Great room for a big/tall guy, and the person behind him.  Not an intown vehicle-is not a short radius turner, and at 7600#, it doesn't handle or brake like a Porsche. But it is a very capable truck.  Ride is truck like.  Removed a leaf in the rear to help soften ride-I don't haul much.  Three decided mfg. defects- engine has a breather tube which drips black engine oil, exhaust pipe too short-soots the rear quarter panel, spokes on wheel (al) had chatter marks.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is a work horse.  Tons of room in the back and plenty of power with the Cummins.  I average 16-18 mpg in the city and 20-22 mpg on the highway (hand calculated).  Best Truck I have owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck for work and family. $250 chip gave me 120 hp and 3 more mpg. Took several long trips comfort and excellent fuel mileage.(but not quite as good as my 2004 2500 I had before.) I still range in the 19-21 mpg hwy if I keep it under 70. Cruising range in the 600-700 mile range. Will tow anything you hook it to have towed a 24k bachhoe with mine. And haul a 12k skidsteer regularly

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I had a transmission solenoid go out around 10,000 miles causing slipping between 1st and 2nd gear. The warranty covered it but it took a special engineer to come down and isolate the problem. The truck is tough to maneuver. The megacab offers ample room inside but is not worth the sacrifice. This truck sticks out of my garage by more than a foot. Performance was lacking until an aftermarket exhaust and air intake were installed.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Dodge, you don't have to any more
Review: You don't have to "Dodge" them anymore. They are well built, powerful, long lasting and fun to drive. The truck has been above average on all things, fit and finish, gas mileage, handling, and most of all very fun to drive. It will spin the wheels at any moment if you get after it. No more worrying about getting into traffic, you floor board it and off it goes. In fact you have to watch the speedo. You are doing 90 before you notice, No motor noise, no wind noise, and you can actually use the drive up now without killing the engine. Great job Dodge!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Fuel economy averages 10-11 MPG around town and only about 13-14 at 75 MPH. The ride is quite rough, much rougher than my '97 half ton extra cab. The Hemi engine is very powerful and runs smoothly. The truck looks stunning after it is freshly washed and earns many compliments. The room in the backseat is outstanding.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Fuel mileage is poor unless you are on the highway, cruise on, going 65 or less. A/C stinks if the temps are above 90. Even worse when humidity is high or above 100.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have loaded it down with 3+ tons of tile and it handled as if nothing was in it. It has been on various trip which required 4X4, with a quick turn of the nob I was climbing a muddy hill or going through sand. Size does matter, the room in the back fits 3 full sized adults (6' plus) and they had plenty of leg room, without touching the front seats.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: What a truck!  Nothing compares.  I can go on and on about so much I like about the truck. However, the leather seats are too hard.  Air conditioning does not blow out hard enough for AZ weather. And the air vent flaps are to restrictive. For a $50,000 truck the seats should be more comfortable. It is a truck though, one kind of a truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: TheTruck I Have Been Waiting For
Review: I love this truck. Great performance and fuel mileage. It's a roomy 4x4. What else could you want in a truck? This truck does it all. It's the biggest, baddest truck on the market today. Nothing else even comes close.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I would buy this truck again.  The handling and power are evident the moment you turn the key.  I previously had a 2002 Lincoln Navigator 4wd and this truck out performs it by a long shot.  The Laramie package has all the comforts one could want in a pickup.  I also tow my 6500lb Grady-white on occasion and with the power trailer tow mirrors, there is not a blind spot anywhere.  Also, my pickup has the 4.10 axle ratio to boost its tow rating and accelleration.  On the inside, there is more room and comfort than I previously had in my Navigator.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Truck of trucks.  If you are looking for a heavy duty Ram, the Cummins should be your only choice especially with a 4x4. I thought hard about the mega cab but then realized I don't ride in the back seat so I stuck with the quad cab. This is my second Ram with the first being a '96. Fit and finish has come a long way in 10 years like it should. The interior is a bit boring and the plastic wood trim is horrible any way you look at it but can be replaced after market with ease. The ride is smooth, acceleration is better than I thought it would be in a diesel 4x4. Mileage is 15 according to the trip computer with mostly city driving. Stock ride height is taller than Super Duty or  Chevy

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Traded in my 04' Quad Cab 2500 diesel for the new Mega Cab. Couldn't be happier. More horsepower, more options, and the kids don't kick the back of my seat anymore! I got every single option except the snow plow! Love the navigation and overhead DVD is great - kids can even select a satelite station to listen to in the back seat. Great new color too - Khaki metallic. It's beautiful with 4" lift and Weld wheels with 35" Toyo mud terrains.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Mega cab is the way to go
Review: I needed an office on wheels that could haul and tow large loads with ease and still be a pleasure to drive. This truck is the ticket, tough, good looking, roomy, a pleasure to drive or just to ride in

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: 2006 dodge quad cab cummins diesel, great truck
Review: the truck is solid been driving for a few hundred miles now and i really like it. there is lots of power for when you need to get up to speed. the ride comfort is what you would expect from a heavy duty truck. i average 22mpg on the hwy and 20 in the city. its worth the money. yes the interior quality is not the best but its ok. good truck. i drove a 2003 ford f250 with the 6.0 the aceleration sucked and the turbo lag was horrible. i would rev it all the way up to 3500 rpm and it would barley move the the dodge is a better choice.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought this '06 Ram Diesel when it had 51000 miles and it runs great.  I changed all the fluids with synthetic but am staying with Delo 400 15-40 for the engine and changing it every 5000 mile along with a fleetguard filter. I added an AFE stage 2 intake, BD tranny pan, and Smarty Jr. Recent trip from Denver to Seattle averaged 19.7 mpg unloaded at average speed of 70.  Did not burn a drop of oil. The dealer changed the ball joints and u-joints when I bought the truck.  I can see these are going to be a weak area but the Cummins diesel can't be beat. I was a Chevy person for 30 years and even though I loved the Silverado I will drive this Dodge till it won't go anymore.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love it!  And I really love the gas mileage,I have got 28 MPG on a curvy uphill state highway!  This thing almost has too much power for its own good!!!  We tow a 7,500 lb bumper pull Travel Trailer up the rocky mountains and still get 15 MPG! I also tow a 16ft trailer that i tow a 3,500 Lb Antique Tractor and It pulls it like a piece of thread.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Bought the 4X4, diesel, in June 2009.  Traded in 2006 Tundra regular cab for it.  Closed box beam frame, brakes that'd stop a locomotive, and an industrial grade diesel engine - all "the" requirements for a work truck.  Interior is not glamorous, but the SLT has the essentials.  SB has a tight turning radius; on a dime.  Stock configuration sits up high off the ground.  Low gear 4X4 transfer case; climbs up anything.  Sound system has good tone; MP3 player plug in.  Cab is quiet.  Quab cab is roomy enough for adults for <300 mile trips.  All around - looks manly; not an overchromed glitz truck.  Best truck for the money.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my 1st diesel picked it up used with 24k on it now up to 31k and I love it. The 5.9 has all the power you need and no EPA crap like the 08.  Towing is not a problem. Get the Laramie pkg. Heated seats great in the winter. QC has lots of room for the kids. I have started this thing at -20 with no plug in around, truck starts right up. If your looking for a used diesel, go with this one for sure, you will love it

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: This is a good truck in every way
Review: I purchased my 2006 Dodge 2500 5.7L 4WD SLT Quad cab new.  It now has about 30k on it and has been an excellent truck. Nothing has ever broken, it drives great with excellent acceleration and braking, but definitely rides like a truck. The storage space under the rear seat is great. I live in the south and the AC cools pretty good, but could be a little better.  Fuel economy averages just under 14MPG, if I do all city driving it drops to around 13.5.  I bought this truck to drive for years and enjoy and so far I have gotten what I paid for.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: We needed a heavy tow rig with 4 wheel drive and economy.  We have had the Dodge for over 3 years and 65K on it.  No problems.  Have upgraded rr suspension with supersprings, swaybar and ranchos, but we carry a 3k camper and tow a 3 horse trailer with draft horses, so we are 19k going down the road.  We get 13 to 14 loaded and have done 23 empty.  What i liked about the truck is it is set up well stock with big exhaust, nice alloy wheels, tow package, etc. so there was not a lot it needed.  My stock tires went 58k, and I just did the ft. brakes at 62k. I run synthetic fluids all around.  We plan on running the Dodge for a minimum 10 years at 20k per year, so we are right on plan and happy!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I had an older Dodge 1500 which I hated. No power and the brakes were horrible. I went to the 06 diesel after comparing Ford and Chevy. Chevy was too expensive but has a nice transmission. Dodge had the Cummins. The brakes on the 06 are awesome. The comfort level and reliability are excellent. I pull a 50 hp Kubota tractor on a large trailor with implements with no problem. I'm getting about 18 - 20 mpg on a mix of highway and street driving.  I find the back seat of the quad cab adequate for my needs. I'll be driving this truck until it or I won't go anymore.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is a work horse in a business suit, black with chrome. Mileage is in the high teens if I baby it. My only complaint, the truck handles terrible. Wanders down the road and chases every groove. My F150 with 100k miles drove better than this truck the day it came off the lot new. Replaced the stearing stabilizer shock with an aftermarket and improved it somewhat. I'm the only owner, so I know it has been taken care of.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I can't believe the power of this vehicle! Everything I need in a work horse to a family vehicle all in one. Its fun to drive! The torque can definitely pull everything i use it for. I usually pull a 8x24 triple axle enclosed trailer loaded with equipment. the Diesel Power pulls the trailer with absolutely no problems at all. Even up and down the mountains of South Carolina. My kids can sit in the back without comfort being a problem. The Laramie package was always a plus with the leather seats and trim. 5" lift kit, cap, bigger tires, and a chrome brush guard makes this beast a feared vehicle on the road. I traded in the HEMI power for Diesel. The Hemi just didn't pull.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just purchased this truck used with 22k miles. I traded in my 01 Cummins and have zero regrets. With the six speed manual the 5.7 Hemi can be really fun to drive. The kids have plenty of room in the backseat and the front offers plenty of room for both driver and passenger.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Excellent power, comfort, style, fuel/mileage(19 city-22 highway), good materials, worth the money. Don't like the smoke when i have to accelerate fast, can't find anything else to complain of.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Has rust on the inside of doors and not even 2 yrs old! Dealer repainted! I feel like it has cancer! Its been treated but will it come back and how bad? That speakers crackle a lot! The plastic around the fuel spout is cracking! Water will actually stain the seats! I purchased the truck with the intention of driving it till the wheels fall off! Now I am scared the body will be gone way before that!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a great truck. Have had the other models but like this one the best as far as the ride and handling.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: This truck is everyone I had hoped for
Review: I have owned my 2006 Dodge Ram 2500 SLT 4WD QUAD CAB 5.7L now about 20 months and I do not have a single complaint. It is extremely reliable and fun to drive and pretty much rides like a refined truck. I get over 15 mpg driving it easy to and from work and around town and if I drive it hard the mileage drops to around 13.5 mpg. Handling and braking are excellent as is the interior functionality and comfort with plenty of storage space under the rear seat.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have the Cummins in mine and it is awesome. The fuel mileage around town is about 16.9 usually and on the highway between 20.5 and once I got 23. When the motor runs above 2000 rpm the mileage falls pretty quickly. I have the 373 gear so I can still run around 70 mph with good mileage.I have driven it off rd. on the beach in NC and it did very well the motor has so much low end that it has no trouble at all. I won't take in the mud so I won't be able to report on that,it's to nice of a truck. I plan on keeping this truck forever and hopefully it will be the last p/u I ever have to purchase. I want a Challenger, Camaro or must. Once I pay this off in around 3 yrs.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Put 30k on in the first year. For the most part the truck is great.  Have owned several Cummins Dodges.  Spend a lot of time in the diesel performance arena, and nothing beats the Cummins. Considerably better trucks than my past Cummins Dodges. Better brakes, better ride, better stock power and better stability for heavy towing. Mileage will never match the older 12v's. Too much stock power and emmissions equipment to have great mileage. Still much better and more powerful than any gas engine. Will buy more Cummins Dodges. Five in the family now.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Since purchasing new in August of2006 I've put 25,000 trouble free miles on this truck. I have been pleasantly surprised that the thing still feels solid with no rattles or squeeks. The 5.9 Cummins turbo diesel engine is great, tows my trailer with ease. It has over 7000 miles with thetrailer behind it so far and many more miles carrying heavyloads in the bed. The fuel mileage is decent for a 7000lb. vehicle but the mileage while towing is where it really shines. Overall I have been very pleased with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: The best truck I have owned so far
Review: I have the 5.9 diesel, and it has been an incredible truck. I like the power,I can haul everything that I need for work, and it is comfortable to drive long distances in

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My 06 2500 Hemi is the worst truck I have ever owned.  It has no power.  I pull a #5000 trailer and feels like I am pulling a #20000 trailer.  There is no power pulling up hills and shifts all of the time.  Fuel mileage is absolutely terrible.  I usually get 7.5 mpg pulling and 12 mpg without.  Interior is plain and overall offers nothing special.  I can't wait to trade back to a Chevy/GMC.  The ride is average.  If you are not a die-hard Dodge fan, I guarantee you will be disappointed.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This Dodge diesel is a verry good truck, fun to drive and a lot more pickup speed than a Chevy Duramax diesel. I drove a Duramax for abought 5000 miles or so and there is no compairison to the Dodge diesel except for the fuel mileage. I get abought 15 to 16 mpg on the highway. I put on 300 to 400 highway miles on a week. Even with a k&n intake kit no better mileage. I have just over 20,700 miles on it and it's going back for the 2nd time to be looked at for the mileage problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Sweet truck. Drives and handles very well. It's not sloppy feeling like the other brands.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I think 4x4's should come with on and off road tires standard. Highway tires are useless in the field when the ground are wet. Also they should have kept the ashtray on the dash instead of the little cupholder ashtray. And they should had kept the adjustable cup holders. Plus they need to put back the bag clip on the dashboard. Basicly I like the 2003 dash setup better than the 2006 models. I wish they kept the (DEE) 6 speed standard transmission because I got better fuel mileage with it.I'm getting 21mpg a round town and 19 on the highway running 70mph. With the tranny Iwas get 23mpg in town and on the highway 28 to 30mpg. I also I miss the power lumbar.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This will be the last truck I buy. I have waited years to own one and I finally do.  The only thing I am looking for is more assessories and performance parts.  I love this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Absolutely by far the best diesel on the market. You will never regret buying this truck. Ford guys drive by me and give the thumbs up with Super Duty Envy ;)

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck with a diesel will move mountains. With a travel trailer (7000 lbs.) in tow and a 600 lbs. quad in the bed, this baby rides like a dream. You can't feel anything behind you. Granted, the truck rides a little rough when empty, but when loaded, it smoothes right out. It's designed for the load and it shows. Loaded down, mountains rarely slow you down, the torque is awesome. I've driven Silverados, but go with the Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is another great truck from Dodge. The seats are a little on the firm side, but adjusting them every few hours makes the trips bearable. Pulling a 25' trailer grossly weighted at 8000 pounds, 35000 miles a year, I don't even know it's there. A change of the exhaust and the power and mileage gets better without voiding the warranty. :)

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Whats not to like? Buy it!
Review: Just sold my '03 Ford fF150 fx4 and bought this Dodge Laramie QC 4x4  Diesel and I am in love! This is an awesome truck for the money! I have never had a diesel before and was a bit nervous about the noise and ride quality but after having this truck for a while I just find any excuse to get out and drive it. The fuel mileage is at 17 mpg now but will get better as time goes on. Dodge is the way of the future! Grab it by the horns.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Just got an '06 2500 SLT with the Cummins diesel.  What an awesome truck.  The diesel power is unbelievable.  You can stomp on the gas and the truck will just run like a scalded dog.  With the higher clearance you sit up above the traffic and can see everything.  The color, inferno red, is spectacular.  Everyone at the fire station was jealous.  Interior noise is almost non exsistent with the new seals and insulation.  Just that cool diesel vibration that puts the kids right to sleep.  Looking forward to having this truck for a long time.  Great job Dodge

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Purchased the 2500 SLT 4WD QUAD with 5.7L a month ago, and couldn't be happier.  You buy these things for utility, drivability, and all around looks.  Fuel economy is the only negative I can see with this truck.  I have been driving as fuel efficient as I possibly can, and have averaged a best of 14.2 MPG (expressway/city driving). This should get slightly better when the motor is fully broken in.  The build quality is excellent as are the interior features. It brakes wonderfully, and maneuvers like you are driving a much smaller truck.  I previously had a 2002 Dodge Ram 2WD, 3.7L, 5 spd.  This truck was extremely reliable but severely underpowered.  Overall, I have been happy with Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded in a Ram 1500 with a 5.9L (gas) engine and my new 5.7L Hemi (w/auto)completely blows it away.  100 more HP and about the same gas mileage.  I average around 11 MPG around town and get aroud 16 on the highway (12 towing a 4000 lbs TT).  The new 2500 is exremely well designed inside and out.  I have a Sport model with leather bucket seats and fixed center console and it's very comfortable and loaded with features.  My wife is jealous becuase it's more luxurious than her car!  Navigation and satellite radio are both fun extras that I would have never considered but ended up really liking.  My only complaint is the low ride height of the 2500 2WD nose and the unattractive stock wheels.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought a 06 Ram 2500 Diesel with 6- speed manual quad cab, I had to have the engine computer reprogrammed due to extended starting problems, and I also had to have the A/C worked on. TIPM was replaced due to non-working horn, I bought the No Horn Package :) Other then that the truck works great, I like how quiet the engine is, I can hardly hear it while driving down the highway, steering is precise, everything works good now.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: FYI, I have a 2500 Quad Cab 2wd short bed 5.9L Cummins Diesel 4 speed auto trans. I love this thing, it gets better mpg towing my 6500lb trailer then my '03 Hemi did empty. Wish the shocks were a bit firmer. Interior is simple and clean. Been real good to me so far, 2 months and 5400 miles. 13mpg towing, 20mpg empty, and with all that torque, it makes it fun to drive on the freeway, passing is a breeze, no down shifting needed.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I truly love the power and ride of this truck. The trans could be a bit better but I can live with it. The seats, they are another story! I have had constant pain in my back since purchasing this truck. In the past I have owned several Dodge products, and always liked the comfort level of the seating - this is the exception!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Design and quality of fit and finish  are up there with the best.  Power is impressive, especially when climbing passes in the Colorado Rockies.  Heater gets hot enough to cook a meal. Will do a follow-up after 1 year.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I had traded my 2003 Dodge ram Qc 4X4 for an economy car. What a mistake that was. So then I put myself back into the market for a truck. I really enjoyed my '03, but wanted to see what the others had to offer. I drove the toyota, Ford, Chevy, and Nissan. It was not hard to find my favorite. They all offer something a bit better than their competitors, but the Dodge won hands down in nearly every category. The Hemi is a very strong motor. The transmission does a great job, though a bit slow to down shift at slower speed maneuvers. The interior is logical and roomy; comfortable for long trips, as well as a daily driver.  All in all, I am happy to recommend this  truck to anyone.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: X Ford, had concerns about their diesel (6.0).  We choose the Ram because of the engine and body profile. The biggest factor, full 4 door (short distance, 6'plus men NOT an issue). The short wheelbase allows maneuvering in parking lots much easier than the others 4 drs, granted they have more room.  Only have 2000 miles to date, so reliability is yet to be seen.  Had a couple of  engine lights issues, apparently cold air setting off sensors.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my first new Dodge Ram with a Hemi , the power is great,the 6 speed is still a little tight.gas mpg only 12, I only have 556 miles on it to date.and yes it is SWEET !!!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Tough as nails and rides beautiful.
Review: This is  "THE" truck for serious truck owners. Considering all the "play" trucks from the import market that claim to be a full size truck, the Dodge Ram truely is in every way.   I can't believe how well this heavy duty truck drives. Its like driving a freight train carved out of a block of steel. No rattles, creaks or growns. The Hemi motor is unbelievably powerful and the huge front and rear anti-lock disc brakes stop this mammoth truck on a dime. Fit and finish is excelent.  After driving the other 2006 full-size trucks, The 2500 HD as a complete package, has no equal.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: The best truck there is HONESTLY
Review: An unbelievable truck. It beats the competion performance wise and well as in comfort and safety. Better than ford, Chevy, Toyota, Nissan, Honda, and GMC. You literally have to drive this truck to understand what I'm trying to tell you. If you get this truck, you will love it.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Dodge Diesel is the ONLY way to go!
Review: We bought a 2005 Laramie 2500 Dodge 4x4 with the Cummins Turbo Diesel.  There isn't a diesel engine on the market as reliable (my company buys Ford, so I do have some experience).  We are getting on average 19mpg out of a big, heavy 4x4 truck.   When towing our boat, we don't even know it's there!  Same with our Horse!  If you are considering a diesel truck, the Dodge with the Cummins is the best one out there.  The Cummins has fewer moving parts than the Ford or Chevy diesel engines, which means, less to fail.  Power is unreal!   Pulls over the Rocky Mountains with out even downshifting!  Stop reading about it and go buy one!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I am quite disappointed with the fact that I got some bad Diesel and now my 2500 "Heavy Duty" will not run.  It has been in the shop for 4 days short of a month.  To beat all, neither the factory nor the extended warranty coveres this repair.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just traded my 2005 Ram 2500 QC 4WD SB ST w/ HEMI+M5 to a 2006 QC 4WD SB SLT w/ Cummins+A4.  The HEMI + M5 tranny were OK, but a bit weak, and hard on gas at 11mpg (13 on a very good day). The M5 wasn't particularly good at in-town driving. Highway driving wasn't any better because of too much gear.   The Cummins + A4 is a different story. When empty, the truck is quite sporty and the A4 has pretty decent road manners.  I can't wait to put it to the towing test.  Fit and finish are very good on the '06. Road and engine noise are quite acceptable.   Overall, a very good, powerful, truck for the money.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Been very pleased with performance and styling of truck. Creature comforts have come along way. Quad cab still lacking in rear space, but only down fall to the truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Drove well in all conditions

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Power and mileage are excellent. I can tow my Bronco with a full size camper in the bed, far more cheaply and much faster; than I can drive the Bronco by itself

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB (5.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The Ram 2500 SLT 2dr long bed with the Cummins Turbo Diesel has been a great performer for me. Not one problem in over 55,000 miles of driving in less than 1 year. I average 12.5 mpg @ 68mph pulling 7x14 cargo trailer with avg gross weight of 4,000 lbs. (I avg 14.0 mpg when towing empty trailer @ 2,100 lbs) I have been across the desert, across the Rockies, and in a blizzard. The only negative with the 2 wheel drive is that in the snow,ice, or Florida sand,  you are not moving...even with an empty trailer attched, there is no traction! Light rear end that will spin even with moist road conditions. Otherwise, I am extremely pleased with the workhorse that I bought from Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB
Review: The quality is below avg

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB
Review_Title: Dodge, nice but plenty of money
Review: Used for work and snowplowing, It never let me down, pulls bobcat and trailer real good. Plenty of power. good milage under load.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I use this pickup for a lot of different things.  I pull four wheelers, snowmobiles, have even pulled a backhoe.  Good power but don't pass a gas station.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Truck is primarily used for hauling 5th wheel trailer, a 16,000 pound and recently a 12,000 pound. With V-10 gas engine it takes the hills better than any commerical tractor trailers. With anti-slip differential I have never been stuck where I needed a tow. Fuel economy with trailer is poor, at my normal cruising speed of 62 mph, about 7 mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I have 92000 miles on my Dodge, and this truck has worked hard and never gave a lick of trouble. I installed a Banks kit on the truck and it will pull anything and still gets 11 mpg towing.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: Reliable, great mileage and tough as nails. Excellent work vehicle

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: 71,000 miles with oil, filter and air filter changes every 5,000 miles.  Totally reliabible, my opinion.  Will buy another if and when this one wears out.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab LB

column1: 30' travel trailer.    14mpg pulling;

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I now have 51000 on the truck and it

column1: has had only a few problems.  It has
the cummins diesel and I pull a 11000
pound boat counting trailer from one
end of KY to the other.  There is
plenty of power but I could use a few
more when I'm pulling my boat.  I think
I will put a new computer chip in it.
I have leather seats and the padding on
the seats is not very much.  This is my
4 dodge truk and the cloth seats feel
much better for a long ride.  The
automatic transmission went out at
16000 miles and it was because dodge
said in it's manual to keep it out of
overdrive when pulling a load.  Let it
go into over drive and save your
tranny.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: Fit and finish were very poor.  I was in the repair shop 8 times in the first year.Two were for recalls, the rest for squeaky brakes or for an alignment.  The alignment was set many times, but the truck still pulls to the right.  I had the transmission replaced at 35000 miles because it wouldn't stay in gear.  That transmission locked up and stuck in second first gear at 52000 miles.  The transmission was rebuilt from scratch at a cost of $2900. I traded this vehicle one day after the transmission rebuild was complete. All told I have spent over a thousand dollars in repairs on this truck and it is STILL UNDER WARRANTY.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I love this truck, it is the best 4x4 that I have ever driven. It has not been perfect, had to have the steering replaced, but it was done quickly and have had no other problems since. I love the drive, handling and the interior on my truck is awsome, love those leather seats!!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: We purchased this truck new in October of 2003 and it has been an unbelievable experience as this vehicle has performed flawlessly.  We are moving into a time of our lives where we don't need a big powerful truck like this anymore.  The 5.7 L Hemi V8 has tons of power and the limited slip differential coupled with 4X4 drive makes it virtually unstoppable in any terrain / conditions.  This Ram has a trailer tow package and we towed a 32' Prowler RV with hardly any effort at all.  It came with a snow plow package (which we never used for snow plowing) but it provided the vehicle with extra heavy duty cooling capacity and beefier front end parts.  I can't say enough good things about the Dodge Ram and before we bought it we compared & drove Ford, Chevy and Toyota similar models.  The Ram is heads and shoulders above the competition.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Vehicle is not dependable. Had problems from day one through day 6. Returned it to the dealer on day 6 because it had 3 different mechanical failures.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased this truck new in 2004. this was the third new dodge truck purchased by me.From previous experience I knew not to get the auto tranny due to failure in the previous two 1500s. I knew when I went to the dealer about cummins reliability and long life and I also requested the six speed manual. before I made the second payment, the truck broke down 5 times.     However, dodge would not buy the truck back under the lemon law. you would need a really good lawyer to fight dodge. I am really glad I kept the truck. after I got a good mechanic from dodge to fix the problem this truck has been great. Pushing 175,000 miles and not another single issue. 24.5 mpg@70 mph 33.0 mpg@50 mph. still stock.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My truck developed the 'death wobble' and I've spent in excess of $2500 trying to fix it.  If you aren't aware of what the 'death wobble' is, Google it.  There is a serious design flaw in the 2500 and 3500 models that Dodge has yet to address let alone acknowledge.  Do not buy this vehicle or it can happen to you.  Most people that have this happen to them sell their trucks because of the difficulty in fixing.  I'm surprised no one has died (which is probably why Dodge refuses to admit the problem).

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have never had a vehicle in the garage as much as this dodge. I bought a used 04 2500 4wd quad slt. My first repair was replacing all the shocks, driving on the highway if I hit a bump the front end would pound had to slow way to for it stop. Then my water pump went, all the pulleys went, evap leak had to replace all the hoses on top of the gas tank. Had to replace front u-joints and upper and lower ball joints on both sides. Now @ 70k have to replace muffler which you can not buy after market so I'm putting dual exhaust on it. Sad thing is this truck gets babied. I never tow or haul anything. Just drive to work and back. Worst truck I've ever owned!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck has proved itself to be a great workhorse. About 80% of miles were empty city/highway and 20% towing very heavy loads (10,000#s +). Oil gets changed every 8,000 miles and run Marvel Mystery Oil every other tank. Only repair was a fuel pump at 80K which was covered under warranty. Plan on many more miles with this truck and wouldn't hesitate to buy another.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought it used with 60k miles. Not many used out there, then or now with the Cummins. Automatic has been great. Ride is a little stiff, but it's a real truck, 2500. Had the 1/2 ton,1997, gas, Dodge, no comparison. Now have 138k miles, looking at going with a chip. I run 185/70/17s, get 19.4 mpg, at 71mph. city/hwy average 17.6, no load, with bed cover. City and 6x12 box trailer milage 13.2. With trailer and these tires, running around town its a little weak, time to chip.Maintenance has been low, very few problems. Get the Laramie, it's worth it, you will appreciate them, I know I do.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Had a Nissan Titan before this.What a pile of crap it was. Always in for repairs. The Dodge never once has let me down. Looked at the Tundra. Overpriced and very UGLY.  I can see why Toyota is trying to give them away now.  Nobody wants them.  Way to go Dodge.  I'm sold. Two of my buddies traded in their Tacoma and Frontiers to get one also.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My Truck, a 2005, 2500 with the Cummins TD HO is the best truck I have ever owned. Speaking of owned... thats exactly what it does to the Ford and Chevy. It's the most quiet, fuel efficient, smallest engine, and still generates the more power. This truck is amazing. though the  48re is letting me down after 90kmiles ( having trouble shifting in between first and second gear) I still rate it a 10. I have every performance upgrade you can do to the engine.... minus twin turbos and have been running the stock tranny. I'm happy it's lasted this long.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Seats not as good as Ford super duty, but 5.9 diesel makes up for all short comings. Great towing and handling. Average 16 mpg towing 8-10000 lbs, 20-24 hwy .BFG rugged trails bad on wet road . Went to Toyo open country all terrain, no more sliding

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My wife and I love my truck. I had a Dodge 1500 and traded it in on my Dodge 2500. The diesel is great and it drives better than any other vehicle I have ever had. The only thing I want now is a Mega Cab 2500. I have 4 boys and we have taken numerous trips for more than 500 miles and the truck was great. The mileage is usually around 22 to 23 mpg. The truck is great.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've owned 11 vehicles in my life, most of them purchased new, and I can honestly say this is the happiest I've ever been overall with a vehicle.  The list of issues I've had with this truck is short - I had a leaking coolant hose which I fixed with a 75 cent hose clamp.  That's it in over 36K miles.  I'm averaging 17.5 mpg (hand calculated) over the life of the truck.  It tows well, can accomodate 5 people decently (though not for extra long trips), and is fairly comfortable.  I intend to keep this a long time, unless the new 6.7 Cummins with the 6 spd. automatic tranny is just too good to pass up.  I'd buy another one in a heartbeat.  Oh - I also got this $5K below a comparable Ford.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie Rwd LB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've owned two Super Duties (a 99 and 04) both diesels. This Ram with the Cummins gets 20mpg, with more HP and TQ than than Ford's did.  58K miles, and its been to the dealer once for a minor items.  Solid, reliable, powerful!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck will carry me in comfort just about anywhere I want to go. It has exceptional towing power and I expect to have it in 2024

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Truck has performed perfectly since day 1. Have not had one single problem with truck. Fuel mileage is great for truck of this size, 20.5 highway and 16 city,  and its not even broken in yet! Only changes I would make are back seat comfort level similar to ford/chevy. Feature are also bleak compared to others, no dimming mirrors, no auto headlights etc. his thing will pull a house and get 16 mpg when doing that.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck has been a pleasure to own.  It has Cummins diesel engine, 4X4, and all options.  I'd recommend it to anyone needing (or wanting) a HD 4X4.  I've driven the big Fords & Chevys.  This one wins hands down.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Dodge Trucks are the best overall!
Review: This 2004 Dodge Ram 2500 4x4 is fully loaded including the 345 H.P. 'Hemi' engine.  This is our third Dodge truck in a row and they keep getting better.  The first was an '86' long bed which we sold after 200,000 miles - the only repair (one water pump) at 150,000.  The second was a '95' Ram 4x4 which we sold at 186,000 miles to buy the 2004.  The only repair to the '95' - a component in the electronic fuel injection system failed.  This 2004 is a heavy duty quad cab with a short bed.  We bought it with the trailer tow package as we own a 32' Prowler travel trailer. We are totally impressed with it's ability to haul that trailer around. We can't find fault with any aspect of Dodge Trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The truck has plenty of power and the ride is consistent with the 2500 style. Diesel fuel economy is slowly improving but still not good in town.  Price wars in 2005 have reduced my trade-in value more than expected. The 4WD with limited slip differential provides plenty of pulling capability in rough road conditions.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd LB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is a great truck to own but I liked my 2001 Dodge truck better, it never had any problems after 3 years of owning it and more than 80000 miles, never was in the shop for any repairs. This truck does have a few minor flaws with it and has been in the shop a couple of times for minor repairs over the two years I've owned it. I've towed more than 8000 lbs across country and over the mountains with no problems several times, tons of power. The quality of the build is not as good as the previous model but the previous model was an excellent truck. I am very rough on trucks and have owned both Chevy and Fords and even with the minor flaws with this model it still beats the others hands down.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck in Alaska, then rolled it three times, three days later. It saved my wifes life. The state trooper on the scene said "she had never seen a truck take a beating and the person inside survive with NO injury's". She went out and bought one the next day. All it had after rolling three times was skin damage, easy fix. Only complaint I have is the cruise controls on the steering need to be lighted for night driving.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is my second Dodge pick up. Same body style, so I do like it. I am suprised at how stable I feel driving down the road with trailer load of 6,000 lbs or more

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This was our first Dodge product and WOW ! We now have 36K on it and it has only had maintenance. Power is great - Mileage is great (16.5-18.5 4WD!) - Quality is Great- Style Great. So satisfied that we will replace this truck with one just like it when it reaches 150K mi.

Review: I compared Chevy, Ford and Dodge beforeI bought... Simply put: Dodge = more foryour money. The Cummins Turbo Diesel isquiet, powerful and fuel-efficient. Theride is firm, yet comfortable. I took myRam to show to a friend who bought theChevy Duramax. He drove down the road,came back and said he wished he'd boughta Dodge! That's quite a testimonialcoming from a lifetime Chevroletdiehard! Everyone is impressed with thequiet & powerful Cummins engine. I haula heavy work trailer and you can barelytell it's there! I had a Dodge Dakota,then a Chevy and now this Dodge Ram. Iam truly a Dodge fan now! Thanks for agreat truck at a great price!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)

Review: This truck is the best purchase we have ever made.  It's reliable, fun, fast, fuel efficient, and nice to look at! The trucks can go and will go forever!  We enjoy just taking it for a drive and it comes in handy when we need to tow, or just wanted have fun off-road!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: You want a TRUCK, buy a Dodge
Review: First, it seems odd that Edmunds does not list the Cummins HO Turbo Diesel as one of the choices when submitting a review.We use the truck as a daily driver, commuting about 90miles a day, because it gets BETTER fuel mileage than my 4cyl S-10, about 22 on the road.  Towing a 9000# fifth wheel, we get 12-13 and never feel overloaded or underpowered.The cabin is quieter than the 2001 Ford F150 Super Crew we traded in and the Infinty sound system kicks a**.The truck is solid, strong, and a real pleasure to drive.If you want a TRUCK, buy a Dodge - Everything else is just payments.

Review: I have owned most any type of vehicle you can think of and have owned countless trucks. This is my first Dodge and I'M SOLD ! I have a 2500HD 4x4 with the Cummins HO/auto. It gets between 16-18 mpg and has more power than any truck that I've ever been in. It runs great,drives like a car, and has all the creature comforts that you could want. This is probably the only vehicle that I have EVER been totally satisfied with. I highly recommend it and will buy another one when this one is worn out- But from what I hear that will be about 350K miles !Way To Go Dodge Boys !

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)

The truck is much stiffer than my 2001 F350 was and I can turn around in my street unlike the F350. Build quality is good and I have had no problems as of today.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5M)

If you don't know diesels don't let the "6cyl" fool you. This engine will stomp the other V-8's! I've driven Cat's, Detroit's, and Cummins for nearly 2 million miles, and this engine is simply a smaller version of the engine I make a living with. Who care's about Dodge, (though it's a nice truck) buy the truck for the cummins!!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 2500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This vehicle received all service at Chrysler dealerships and yet had way too many issues.  It is used for occasional towing of a 5th wheel (8500 lbs.) and a four wheeler on a light trailer as well as a 17 ft boat.  Entire front end was replaced at about 30K miles.  Next the front engine seals replaced at about 60K miles. Next at 102K and the front seals leaking all over driveway again this time at my cost of $3800.   Soon after transmission pan leaking just under $500 for seal and service.  Listed are just the larger items.  My maintenance cost on this truck has exceeded $8000.  At 110K miles and has been in the shop for weeks.   Truck started having a shutter at 110,000 miles, first place charged for diagnoses and could not figure it out at all.  Next diesel shop say $175 and referred to transmission shop.   Transmission place says no it is maybe injectors.   Forth diesel shop says maybe injector issue but can not tell which one says wait until it gets worse.   One year later I am still driving it while it shakes.  Two years now and still same problem.  Dealers have different ideas so I am afraid to have a few unnecessary items fixed while trying to find the correct one.

A fuel pressure gauge needs to be installed on these trucks as the fuel transfer pumps fail and you may not even know it until it takes out the expensive injector pump.
