Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Viper Coupe GTS 2dr Coupe (8.0L 10cyl 6M)
Review_Title: One of the best cars out there!
Review: This car is the ipitimy of the cars on the road, short of modern Ferrari's and Lamborghini of course. But how many of these cars are on the road though. The Viper is the same, with only roughly 1500 units a year. But this car is a blast to drive. And you can leave for a short trip in it without someone yelling or almost breaking their necks to get another look. Contrary to magazine reviews, this car is quite confortable as a daily driver and a very easy car to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Dodge Viper Coupe SRT-10 2dr Coupe (8.4L 10cyl 6M)
Review: What interested me in the Viper was performance from a front engined car. My Viper has an all out hold on pure race feel. Inside is a little cramped at first feel with scary blindspots, but the option of turbo upgrade that will flat out out accelerate anything ( If of course you can keep the rubber on the ground. I'm enjoying? Thanks Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Dodge Viper Coupe SRT-10 2dr Coupe (8.4L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Bought the car out of VA, flew back, picked it up and headed home to California. Drove it almost 3000 miles with NO problems. Outran 2 tornadoes in Oklahoma. Has to be the most fun car to drive I've ever been in. Did I mention the looks ya get when in one of these... Buy one and you'll see. Now it just needs some upgrades from Hennessey.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Dodge Viper Coupe SRT-10 2dr Coupe (8.4L 10cyl 6M)
Review: it's is a good vehicle and great handling and stuff like that. gas mileage is ok but not the best of the best

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Dodge Viper Coupe SRT-10 2dr Coupe (8.4L 10cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Not for the faint of heart
Review: This is probably the most extreme car I have ever owned.  The acceleration of this car is unbelievable, and the attention it receives rivals that of any other exotic car I have seen.  The fuel economy average I have seen is about 13mpg, and getting into and out of the car is not very easy, but other than that, I don't see why this car could not be a daily driver.  I will definitely have at least 12,000 miles a year on this car.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased a used (73,000 miles) 2006 Dodge Ram 1500 SLT from a dealership. It appeared in great shape and I did my homework on this truck, but some things lurk in the shadows and come out at night.this truck fits that description.  Fortunately I purchased an extended warranty, $0 deductible and it was a blessing I did. 1. Two weeks out of the purchase date the check engine light comes on. Unknown problem. $125 at dealership to determine issue.2. A few weeks later exhaust pipe comes out of y pipe. Local garage fix for $1003. Squeaking from engine, to dealership, unknown problem, changed fan belt determined a water leak but unknown from where.4. In shop again suspension squeak, located water leak, replace water pump, squeak still not located not diagnosed5. Brakes making steering issue. Brakes hanging up on rotors - was an issue for a while and rotors warped, brake job at local garage6. Steering very loose all of a sudden, dealership inspected, flushed out, that was their solution7. Driver's side Ball joint out, Took 3 trips to dealership to determine this.8. Normal maintenance schedule followed - oil, trans fluids, filters etc9. A couple months after scheduled trans maintenance Transmission all of a sudden trans slips, loses gear ratio in 3rd and 4th, loses 4 th and 3rd completely. Codes were pulled within an hour of the check engine light coming on and 7 different codes pop up.All of this was in a period of 14 months and 24K miles. No off roading, no racing, just normal driving mostly on highway and very  occasionally on hard packed dirt roads.Now I know that used vehicles have some issues that will arise as they get older, as any vehicle will, but this is way too many trips to the garage to fix issues. The final straw that broke the camel's back was the transmission service completed and a couple months later the transmission blows out. Currently waiting for service day to diagnose issue.Caution on Dodge Rams....look before you leap.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought this truck for it's roomy interior.  At 8 ft inside it is incredible.  Brakes are great, in the snow it is awesome in 4 wheel drive with standard tires. I bought the truck with 111,000 miles, it is now at 149,000 and I still love it.  At 55 or 60 I can get 18.7 mpg but around town at less than 2 miles to work I average 11.3 at the most.  I recently purchased a 3,000 pound 5th wheel and the truck actually rides smoother with the trailer in tow.  I love the ride height, my cousins Chevy with 36" tires only rides 4 inches higher than my truck at the cab top with 265 stock tires on mine.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Hemi power is a joke, could not spin the tires on wet grass. Starts to pull a little after 4000 rpm. I tow a two place snomobile trailer loaded and feels like the brakes are on. Ride is rough and choppy for a long wheel base. I have replaced all ujoints,tie rods,wheel bearings,ball joints,shocks and still it wanders all over the road.With some aftermarket add ons i can now pass for a sober driver but have to work at it.Still has a vibration at 75 that no one can fix.Sterio sounds really good when it feels like powering up but wont half the time.Rear power windows roll up and down great but only when they want to. 12 mpg on a great day but normally 9 or so.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just traded my '06 ram 1500 SLT hemi v8 4x4 Quad cab after 1 year of ownership. I owned 2 Ford F150 FX4 crew cabs before this. No comparison. you get what you pay for and that is why dodge's are cheaper. Not only did the truck depreciate by $10,000 in a year without any damage, high mileage, or the like, but my confidence in it's reliability is to the point that I'm biting the bullet and eating all the inequity in my next deal. Terrible ride, they might as well call it an extended cab, the transmission has had issues, rear window leaked, it didn't crank on two occasions and couldn't be diagnosed,and you don't want to hit a bump going 70mph or more, especially in bad conditions.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is not great on gas mileage (rual driving avg 14.3 mpg) but has gotten us out of plenty of jams and is great for family camping trips.  I have pulled cars sideways out of the mud while I was in the mud (great traction even with heavy and difficult load to pull).  The best feature of this truck though is the internal space, you have to see it from the inside to grasp how big it actually is (comfortably fits 5 full grown men for long trips).

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is great to put my 3 car seats in. Tons of room. Gas mileage w/4:10 gears 11.5-12.3 city, highway @75 13-15.5 mostly 13 though. I took a trip drove 75-80 got 12.8. Towing, the power is there the mileage is horrible pulled about 2000lbs got 9.3 towing mostly up hill. ON the way back got 10.9 mostly@75 both ways . But over all I really love the truck. Things seem to be holding up very well. I got the Laramie w/dvd&nav those are great features. The kids love it. This truck does not have the performance/mileage but more room and handles loads better than the 04  I used to have but it does o.k. I wish this was a diesel but it is a good truck and  people in the back are compfortable.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Hands down the most powerful truck I've ever owned. This truck is a top performer with the carrying and pulling capacity of a deisel. Pulls a trailer full of quads, loaded down with minimal effort. You'd hardly know you were  pulling a trailer if were not for the rearview mirrors. Never owned a Dodge before this one. Mega Cab has the most spacious rear seat, great for long hauls. Mega cab styling is a head turner and powerful hemi an added bonus. I purchased this truck for my wife who has always driven SUV's. She wanted it for the long trips to Baja and the Grand Mesa in Colorado. I wanted it for pulling five full size quads plus trailer. Fuel economy? Minimal but acceptable. Santa Ana, Ca.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Purchased in California late 2007, switched from a regular cab 1500 to the mega cab 1500. All my cars have been Dodge for the last 15 years. I'm impressed with almost every aspect of the vehicle except the ride and gas mileage. Took the family of six to Disneyland and the ride was almost unbearable going over the Altamont. Felt like we were in some sort of shaking machine. Can't imagine what this is doing to the truck. This truck is not a smooth ride unless the highway is perfect. Also I average about 10-11 mpg in the city and 13-15 on the highway. But I expected this knowing the vehicle type I was buying. I'm deciding if the ride is enough of an issue to cause me to get another vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Driving this truck for a little over a year. Great. I'm 5'3" female, this truck handles beautifully. The back seat has plenty of room for full size adults, plus the seats recline and they fold down flat, unlike every other 4-door truck I looked at where the back seat bottoms folded up. Also like the hidden storage behind the back seat. Haven't had any trouble with my A/C. MPG 15 HWY and 12-13 in town. Do not like the fact that when I open the driver's door from the inside all the doors unlock (personal safety issue).  Also wish the radio still played/windows rolled up/down after the key was turned off and radio went back to low volume after shut off/restart (my crappy Ford did that).

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned Ford, Chevy, GMC, Toyota, and Nissan Titan. So I figured why not Dodge?  I purchased a 2006 SLT Mega  cab 2WD with the 5.7 Hemi.  After my purchase co-workers were telling me "That Hemi is a gas hog". I guess that if you are used to driving a Honda Civic or one of the hybrid vehicles that would be a true statement.  However if you are in the market for a full size truck you expect that 40- 50 mpg is not in your sights.  I currently have 2675 miles on it. and average (with conservative driving habits) about 13.6 mpg city and 17.5 Hwy. Not bad for a 3/4 ton truck. Pulling a tandem axle trailer loaded I recieved approx 9 MPG.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: In the first 50 miles this truck made me not even look back at my 2007 Lincoln Mark LT truck I traded in on this Dodge Mega Cab. At least when you step on the gas you could at least feel the truck move. I don't care if it only gets 12 mpg. The Lincoln only got 13 mpg and you had to worry that you cleared the intersection before the light changed. The interior room is fantastic and at least the seats are really comfortable. This truck is awesome.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is a great truck. I have always bought Chevy trucks, but I think I am a Dodge guy now. The only bad thing about the 1500 megacab 4wd is the gas mileage, about 11 mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Nice truck, but could be a great truck
Review: Dodge design is best in class.  Ride is nice but can be choppy on turns.  A/C and heat continue to be problems for Rams.  When either is on it feels like engine is about to die trying stay on and idle fluctuates heavily.  Heat takes forever to heat up.  A/C is adequate at best during really hot days. Brakes are weak for such a big truck and can be scary during bad weather conditions. No power passenger seat. That stinks for the passenger. Gas economy with MDS is a myth. I get nowhere near 18MPG HWY.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: There isn't much more that you could do on the inside to make this truck any better. It has plenty of room for just about anyone who is cabable of climbing into this beast. It's quiet and comfortable. It's hard to determine where the end of the vehicle is when backing up.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have the Big Horn Edition and love all the add ons it has. This is my first Hemi and I don't really notice much difference from the 4.7 liter until after 2nd or 3rd gear. Otherwise, It has a lot more power. I just installed an AirRaid intake and it makes a huge differance. Much more responsive and sounds great! I also notice that the ride of the 06' is much smoother and handles bumps great. Also, the cabin is quiet until I added the intake :) I did not get the 4X4 and regret it, but I would only us it like 2-3 times out of the year anyways.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love the style and roomy Mega Cab interior. Plenty of low end torque but you suffer with terrible fuel economy both in town and highway.  Air conditioning cannot handle additional cab size on warm days with the family. Customer service and dealer repair service is the worst of the big three. I would never buy another Damiler Chrysler product! Have been waiting 18 days for a climate control part to fix the non working air conditioning. More excuses than good news from all parties.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck really rides smooth for such a large beast! The only time I hate driving it is when I am driving to the gas station.  However, the cost is well worth it to me. This is the best looking, most capable truck on the market.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The best truck I ever owned as far as comfort. Fuel mileage is another subject, I don't know how everyone else that has rated the truck says the mileage is so great, I get 10 mpg! The truck has 2000 miles. The dealer said it has to break in more, but I can't imagine it improving to 15 mpg like I was told. I'm not the type to put the pedal to the metal. I'm afraid to tow anything with unless I take out a loan.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The Mega cabs are perfect for a growing family. The rear doors are over-sized and open to a full 90 degrees. The rear seats lean back, besides folding down and the leg room is better than car out there. The only flaw is the side view mirrors do not have the auto-dimming feature like the rear view mirror has. At night the side view mirrors, which are very large, cast a lot of light into the cab when another vehicle is behind you.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The Megacab has a lot of room.  I purchased the vehicle to have more secure space inside (like a SUV) and still have the pick-up bed.  When the back seats are folded down, there is as much room in the back as a smaller SUV.  It has good power and handles well for something that large.  The ride is rough and can be jittery.  It is better when loaded down with 500-600 lbs in the bed.  Braking is not as good as other large trucks I drove.  There is plenty of room in the cabin for taller people (I am 6'4").  The cab layout could be a little better.  The climate controls and radio controls require the driver to lean forward to adjust.  I get 15 miles per gallon on the highway and about 11 in town

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Replaced my '01 Ford F-150 SuperCrew with this '06 Mega Cab. A lot more truck in just about every way.  After 3 months and 4000 miles I'm not disappointed.  Great to drive, a super comfortable interior, good styling, and reasonable mileage given its size and weight.  Since mileage seems to be everyone's biggest issue, I'm getting right at 12mpg in mixed driving around town and to work, and just got three consecutive tanks between 15-16 on a 1400 mile round trip to Wisconsin.  Again, not bad given the truck weighs 6000+.  Overall, I'm very happy with my decision to buy this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I traded in an '06 Hummer H3 on this truck. I love the ride, solid feel and the looks. Everyone comments on the Mega Cab design. My friends call it the "limo truck".

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Talk about comfort. This one's got it. Reclining rear seats (the kids love it), very roomy; and plenty of power for it to get out of its own way and blow the others away. This is my 6th Dodge truck and by far the best!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Just had it for the last 2 weeks, Love it.  Quality is up to the MOPAR Par.  First trip in it, 265 miles.  Got just over 20 MPG on this trip, I drove the speed limit,(65MPH) Fantastic.  Ride was more than comfortable.  Performance is up to the '69/72 Standard only smoother and just as fast if not faster. Keep it up Chrysler/Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Performance matters. Appearance matters. Interior space matters. I have never owned a Dodge product before the MegaCab. The power of Ford and Chevy engines are insignificant when compared to the power of the force (whoops) HEMI. The steering has excellent feel. No ambigous power steering feel. Power off the line is smooth and consistent. Interior space is tremendous. A good amount of storage behing the massive rear seat.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: The Mega Cab is New Comfort on the Road
Review: I've had the Mega Cab now for several weeks and can't say enough good about this truck.  Now understand, I'm 6'6" tall and weigh 300 lbs.  I's not easy for me to fit into any vehicle.  But the Mega Cab 1500 is more than enough for me to be comfortable.  I got the upper end stereo system because I like music.  It's the closest thing you can get to a custom installed job.  The ride is definitely a truck ride, but much smoother than others I've tried. The handling is great with a surprisingly tight turning radius for a truck this size.  Back seat comfort and storage is amazing to say the least.  My friends snored in the reclining rear seats on the way home from my last trip of 1100 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: From the moment I looked one over, I knew that would be buying it.  Its all about the interior space.  This thing is like having a full sized SUV but with a truck bed on the back.  Rear seat occupants up to 6'1" have fully extend their legs and reclined the rear seat while I sit comfortably in the drivers seat.  I recently went on a 3 day trip to Baton Rouge from Houston.  Incuding myself, we went with 4 adults and 1 child.  All of our luggage fit behind the rear seat easily and we all were more than comfortable with the amount of space that each passenger enjoys.  As far as the engine goes I have one word, "sublime".  Can't say enough about the build quality either.  This thing is the bomb.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Proud Owner of a brand spanking new (12 miles on the odometer at time of purchase)1500 Mega Cab 4x4 Hemi.. It's an AWESOME Truck! Had 5 future Hemi owners with me (ranging from 6 to 10 yrs old)and they overwhelmingly approved as well. Just put 2400 miles on it getting back to where I am stationed and it was amazing how many people took interest during my travels. Had quite a few other pickup truck drivers staring hard as I drove across the country... probably wishing they were me. All I could think was.. " Yup, it's got a Hemi.."

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is without a doubt the best truck on the road...period! I will never own anything less than Dodge. I have tried Ford and Chevy and will never go back to either of those manufacturers.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Awesome interior make sure air runs great!!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my 2006 used. I have owned it for a year now and I love my Dodge. I have recommended the Dodge Ram to two of my buddies and both of them now love theirs too.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased my Ram 1500 4WD Laramie quad cab new in 2006.  It is equipped with the 5.7 liter hemi.  So far, it's been bullet proof.  In 10 years, only one trip to the dealer for a warranty repair on an "air gate" that was making noise and preventing proper air circulation.  That was covered promptly under warranty and no other service actions other than normal maintenance.  I live in Montana and hunt and fish a lot so I'm often using the truck to tow my boat (about 30 times a year) or traveling off-road while hunting.  The truck is also used for routine hauling around my property.  Pros:  reasonable power and torque, outstanding reliability, super sound system and GREAT fuel mileage (about 18.5 mpg on the highway when not towing my boat) with the 5.7 liter hemi with MDS (shuts off 4 cylinders when all 8 are not needed).  The creature comforts are also a big plus (leather, dual climate zones, power everything).  Con:  when towing up hills, the transmission often "hunts" for the ideal gear and shifts too often.  I'm betting it's programmed to optimize mileage so it often shifts to a higher gear than I'd like.  This has been a great truck for 10 years and I hope to use it for another 10!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Hands down the worst vehicle I've ever owned
Review: And I've had some really bad ones over the years. Within just a few weeks of purchase- used, the power steering pump went out (google/common problem), the tach quit working (common problem), the blower motor developed such a racket you couldn't hear the radio over it, then the resistor failed so it was WFO or nothing, adding insult to injury. The brake fluid level switch at the master cylinder reservoir started intermittently shorting out, causing the ABS and BRAKE lights on the dash to illuminate (google/common problem). Here lately the transmission has developed an alarming lag to engage reverse first thing in the morning, almost as if the reverse pump is going out. Dodge should be ashamed of themselves for marketing such a poorly constructed pile of crap. I've got a GMC Yukon that's 5 yrs older and has 40,000 more miles on it, but its power steering works like butta, same with the blower motor and resistor, same with the tachometer, etc. The 4.7l doesn't deserve to be called a "power" plant- it has none. ANYWHERE. IN ANY GEAR. AT ANY RPM. Dodge might as well have put a 4cyl under the hood for all the good that V8 does. It's a laugh, if it didn't make me want to cry. The rear middle seat belt constantly hangs up, aggravating to both me and my son, since I'm the one that has to fix it for him. The ignition is so worn out the key will simply fall right out if you hit a bump right, and the suspension could teach an Abrams tank a thing or two, it's.....horrible....is even being too kind. I had my reservations about trusting an "older" dodge product. I should've gone with my gut and stuck to a GM or Ford product, but I fell victim to naivety, a serious time crunch, and flashy looks (Silver/20"alloys/Big Horn) and I've regretted it ever since. It is an awful awful truck. I tried to resell it, asking $1,000!!! LESS!!! than the previous owner I had just purchased it from had asked, and for a month I couldn't get any takers, I ended up just swallowing the bitter pill and taking my lumps like a man. I hope this review helps someone out there avoid my mistake. Stay away from this truck, there are plenty of others out there (Sierra/F150/Titan/Tundra) that simply can NOT be as bad as this one.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love my Ram runs great course every vehicle has their problems and none are perfect, but this truck is great if u have the MDS in the hemi 5.7 then its a great engine with a good drive line behind it to be honest im not to thrilled on the 4.7 it drinks gas and doesn't have much power considering that engine at that time was designed with the Dakota and Durango more in mind so made for a lighter truck but I work for dodge and their new 5.7's, 4.7's the new 3.6 and not released yet but the new 3.0 diesel in the 1500 all great engines again the 4.7 drinks fuel but the others are great looking around 14-19 mpg depending on your driving habbits. all in all GREAT trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my ram hemi used two years ago had 11000 miles. My truck is the nice black slt quad cab.Love the hemi but now have the dreaded he hi tick.Now have 27900 on it. Change oil and have recommend service at local dealer. Have had to replace breakers and tires and had blend door replaced. Was very expensive! Don't drive it in the winter as I wish to keep it and give it to my oldest son in two years. Gas mileage is not that bad if you keep a light foot. Wish I had gotten the sat radio the factory one sucks...

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: My 1st truck: so no comparison-but I love it. Got the V-6 and it has plenty of power.  Truck came with the optional lower rear end; which I wouldn't have bought-maybe this helps with the power? Have thought about changing to the standard rear end-but wonder if any computers would need to be changed. Water pump failed at around 50K, which I didn't think should happen. My main complaint is the AC.  It has never been cold. Took it back to the dealer and he said it was operating to spec.  Dropped the headliner and put in a heat shield and tinted the rear windshield but didn't seem to help. Now the recirc door has broken (maybe has been broken for a long time) which really limits the airflow.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I am having a fun time with my Ram driving off road to the fishing holes I fish at.  I have no problem with it and enjoying it even on the long trips i have gone on with it.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Have had mine for 4 years now with 49k on odometer. At approx. 15k I had to have air recirculation door replaced (warranty). At 30k I had to have rotors turned and transmission replaced (transmission replaced under warranty). I rarely tow and when I do it is nothing more than an enclosed motorcycle trailer with a Harley. I'm a bit disappointed in reliability. Plenty of power, very quiet and comfortable ride and plenty of room except for rear seat passengers. Avg. fuel economy is between 16 and 17 mpg. -- I expected closer to 20 mpg with the MDS system. I'll keep it as long as it runs but I'll probably go with Ford when the time comes to replace it.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is half the truck my 98 gmc z71 was. I mean the 4 wheel drive has a mild low range and cant really get the truck to pull the boat out of the water. The ride is rough and have no idea that a truck made in 2006 can get the same fuel economy as a model A. The comfort of the seat is like siting on a rock. I dont know if its because the truck is cheaply made or that all the other american made trucks are that much better. Also if you lean against the truck you will dent the slim sheet metal. I can't think of any other truck that shifts as much as this one. It dosen't even know when it wants to.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This has been a great truck (going on four years ownership) and I would recommend to anyone.  Never any major problems but I have kept up on maintenance.  The only problem has been the air recirculation door for the A/C system (my mechanic says it is fairly common in this model) and unfortunately I found out about it 1,000 miles after my warranty expired.  Gas mileage is OK (average about 15 mpg based on my combo of highway/city driving) but that's what I expected with a 5.7L/345 hp engine. The ease of flipping up the rear set allows for easy carting of cargo (mostly my Dobermans).

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This has been a Great truck! I bought this truck to tow our new camper, which our old minivan had a tough time doing, even with a tow package. Also, this would be my wife's vehicle and needed to carry our three kids, with one still in an infant seat. We installed nerf bars so my wife could get in, the 20" wheels made it difficult for her, and she has been in love with it ever since.  The Hemi pulls like a champ and after we installed a tonneau cover, our mpg went to 15/20! We towed our camper to FL and averaged 16.5 mpg! The only issue we've had is with the seat coverings, they show every water drop like its a stain. We had them replaced once, but they still do the same thing. Great Truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: great overall only had one issue and that was the transmission pack went out so it wouldn't shift.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Well here's an update on my Ram. I've now had it 37 months and 36,600 miles with no real problems.. I've had to take it in two times...Door mirror was loose and chrome grill peeling.. They replaced both parts. I changed the rear end to a 4.56 so my mileage dropped to 15 but I wanted her to pull and she does just that with the new gears. She pulls our 28' boat effortlessly now.  Overall great truck and considering trading it in on a 2009 (my 6th Ram).

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: service dept.  cannot find any problem ?
Review: we purchased this truck, only 10,000 miles.does not do this all the time. in the last year have problem shaking,cold start, take off shakes really bad, than goes away,shakes more when we pull the boat, starts shaking when we take off then levels out?  now shaking when we turn a corner hanna chryselr cannot find anything wrong, my warranty is about to expire,i even drove the truck in with the boat on it, and they could not get it to shake. could this be a tork converter? could this be the power steering is going bad?

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: my mpg is 18.6  mpg on hemi
Review: I had 30k on my slt quad cab 06 ,got the hemi and the 20" plus is 4x4, my truck color is the red inferno turns heads a lot with big horn package (towing ready,infinity sound,)nothing chance under the hood and still make 18.6 on the hwy going 60 to 65 mph with ac on !! the secret: dont go over 2000 rpm, driving in the city be very gentle on the gas. on this truck is enought the hemi badge to show others you have lot of balls use it when pulling trailers,loads,toys. i wish i could have bigger breakes, and more feedback from the wheel is soft and some times when you go on bump feel is missing. if the road is smooth you have a great ride but if not bounce a lot.this is for me the best looking t

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review_Title: i'll never but a ram again
Review: The worse truck experience-- I have ever had. From day one this truck shimmied its way down the highway. within the first year I replaced, the rotors & brakes (at my cost), and within 2 years I had the brakes and rototrs turned again-- year three it need a brake job again. After 12 k miles like domino's, balljoints, tie rods, alignments, wheel bearings... The dealer actually acused me of driving on dirt roads & panick breaking. (Ram tough but no dirt roads?) I cant help I lived on a dirt road but it shook worse on the highway and on the dirt roads I drove slow. The 60k miles the transmission started to slip,What a piece of junk this truck is, I traded it in this week for a toyota- sad

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: In 3 years I have had to put 3,300.00 into it. Front axle wore out, needed all new rotors and brakes within 2 years, and I had completed all dealer recommended maintenance, which ran me close to a grand alone. Standard mirrors are useless, cupholders are useless, seat belt covers routinely get hooked on your clothes and you go fishing under cars in a parking lot to find them. Emergency handling is non-existent. Sticker stated anti-lock brakes, little did I know that only meant the 2 rear wheels, which I discovered when I braked in the rain the truck went sliding sideways. A power plug went within 2 years, heat/ac fan went in 2 1/2 years, and it has stalled twice now due to electronics.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Bought a certified pre-owned '06 Dodge Big horn w/ hemi to tow my travel trailer. Lots of power. Nice interior. Stock stereo is just fine, has jack for external player (nice feature). Under seat stowage is great.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I absoulutely love this truck.  It's by far the best looking truck available and the Hemi is a must have.  Yes, tires go bald quick but thats because this thing burns rubber when tapping on the gas.  Mine is a powerhouse.  The interior is very basic which I like.  Its not like the Tian with buttons everywhere which means more crap to fix when it eventually goes up.  Dodge makes a good truck here and thats a big statement for me, because I have always bought foreign vehicles, this is my first American made vehicle and I love it.  I am hoping Dodge stays alive and the economy improves becuase the new ones look great as well.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love my 5.7 liter Dodge. I have a single in dual out flowmaster and recently installed a cai and an exhaust cutout. It sounds mean! I am getting a total of 18.6 mpg highway. I got a total of 480 miles on a single tank of gas it was 90% hwy and the rest city. This truck rocks! It's far better than any 5.6, 5.4, 0r 5.3.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my first Dodge purchase. Really like the vehicle and room in the front and rear. Nice flip up back seat for storage.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have 06 Ram Big Horn 1500. I don't get the mileage everyone is talking about and nor does anyone of my friends who has the Hemi Dodge. We all get around 11.5 to 14.5 mpg but hey it's a truck with a Hemi. Performace is good but typical Dodge with power dropping after 6-8 months. I've countered this with a cold air kit, Banks power pack and superchips programmer. Mpg now at 12 to 14. Interior is not of the Ford or Chevy but that's what you get for $10000 less. Still take the Dodge over the Chevy or Ford any day of the week. Best looking truck out there I think. No mechanical probs yet. Make sure you get anti-spin diff other wise power will leave you spinning in the rain or snow.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I purchased this 2006 Dodge Ram 1500 4X4 Big Horn Edition Quad Cab to replace my 2003 Dodge Dakota Club Cab. I needed the room since I'm 6'4" and 220lbs and I need to put a carseat in it for my son. I love the fact that I don't have to bend down or over to put my son in his chair. My back thanks MOPAR for the truck's ride height. I have the MDS Hemi I average about 22-23 MPG. I put an AEM Brute force intake on it and a Flowmaster Super 40 series muffler on it. Needless to say its the biggest, baddest truck on the block. My son loves it just as much as I do. I feel safe in it no matter what the weather does. I prefer to take it when we go camping or on any long road trip. I love this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love my Dodge Ram 1500. It is a really great truck. I bought mine with the Hemi and it's pretty impressive. I put a K&N air filter and a louder muffler on it and it sounds amazing. My only regret is the quad cab is small. I love the patriotic blue metallic paint, and hemi decals.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck. Not getting the MPG others brag about but acceptable. Very comfortable and easy to drive. Wife not afraid of it.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: purchased the truck for a family/ recreation vehicle.  After 1 engine rebuild and 2 transmission.  And many other electrical problems(brake lights sticking on).  Gas mileage was horrible.  I averaged 11-13 in town or highway didn't matter.  Had the 5.7 hemi and was not impressed.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is the first truck I've bought, and although my family farm has always had Dodge's, this one is easily my favorite.  We have a 2500 Cummins and my brother in law has a 3500 cummins, and we've had nothing but good reliability and fantastic performance with them.  My 1500 fits right in, and with its powerful 5.7 L Hemi can tow really whatever I need it to.  I commute to college with it, and although it's fun to drive and looks great, it's not a commuter vehicle.  Mileage is around 17 mpg total, not bad, but I hardly touch the pedal.  Interior is fresh, clean, nicely done IMO, unlike Ford's whose interior is boring.  Overall a great truck, if you need it!  Otherwise, a great toy....

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have a 30 minute drive to work with 10 min. in town, 20 min. on 55 mph sparsely traveled rural roads.  At 55- 60, I consistently get around 21 mpg with the Hemi running on 4 cylinders.  My pure hwy mpg is even better than that.  I chose this truck over a Ford mainly because the rural commute would allow me to benefit from the cylinder deactivation function, which the Ford did not have.  In town and freeway mileage is what you'd expect from a full sized truck.  I tow an 18 1/2 ft boat with no problems.  The TRX4 off-road suspension is a bit stiff on road when light loaded, but I'm overall very happy with it.  It's excellent off- road. This is my 1st Dodge truck.  No regrets.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my 2nd Dodge truck.  I had a 98 Dakota that was a great truck thru 85,000 miles when I sold it.  I leased a 06 Ram after a fight with Ford over a lemoned F-150.  I'm wrapping up my 2 year lease with my current Ram and wanted to express my feelings.  I've had 1 issue with this truck, warped rotors.  That is.  No interior squeaks, no mechanical issues, nothing.  It's been flawless and I'm actually in the process of buying a 08 right now.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had a 2002, 2004 & now the 2006 Ram 1500 which I have been driving for 1 year. I had no problems with the first two but the 2006 from the moment off the lot with under 10 miles on it the wheel shakes bad at all different speeds not just over 60 miles. It has been in the shop a dozen times and they have replaced the front struts,several wheel alinments & balance the tires. Still have the problem and it's been a year. Now the front shocks make a terrible sound when driving on even payment but they have order new ones under warranty. I really enjoyed the 2004 but this one is a lemon and I'm switching to GM in two years when te lease is up.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Many problems with this pickup, so far dealer has been good about fixing them. 4-door quad cab not much more than an extended cab with 4-doors.  Get mega cab if you really intend to have adults in the back seat.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have to say I love my truck. To me it drives better then most cars. I love the traction lock rear end. The Hemi is great. The only complaints I have is that I tow a trailer every day and the brakes do not work as good as I think they should. They need bigger brakes. Then there is the Computer. I was wanting to hop up my Hemi but it seems that Dodge has the computer locked so you can not do any real high performance upgrades. I was wanting to add a supercharger or turbo but It seems no one can upgrade the fuel curves in the computer. The ford truck guys have their Ford mostly because of this reason.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I'm not too sure what this truck is suppose to be. A work truck, family truck, both? Either way, it is a decent truck.  It's sticker was around $30,000 which I find way too high. The cab has plenty of room for rear seat passengers which it a big plus if you have multiple passengers. The bed is your typical bed. The engine is a little under powered in the 4.7.  Hemi truck was way too high of a price.  I would not lease this truck again because it's really not what I needed.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've been very pleased with my truck overall. I love the Hemi and the other features I've listed below. Nice large, heavy, safe vehicle. I put on a Rhino liner and nerf bars and that has added to the truck's usefullness and value. I wish that the drivetrain losses were less. I think Dodge could have done better with leg room in the backseat of the Quad Cab. It seems to be tight for taller adults though is ok for kids and average or short adults. Had the injector for cylinder #7 go bad after 10k miles but it was fixed under warranty. The Hemi is outshined now by Toyota's V8 but that doesn't bother me. Overall fantastic vehicle and I highly recommend.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: Love the truck, except the transmission shifts rough. There is a buzzing noise and vibration the dealer cant seem to find. And I don't have the money to keep renting trucks while thay try to figure it out. So if you buy a Dodge they don't cover rental when your truck breaks. That's why my next truck will not be a Dodge. Because looks ain't everything when you drive for a living and have to buy a new truck every year.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Checked out F150 and the new Tundra and decided to go with Ram 1500 Quad Cab with the 5.7 Hemi V8. Ram has a better feel for the road. It has a tough, yet elegant look.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: What a great truck. I now have 8000+ miles and have not experienced any "wheel shimmy" with the 20" alloy wheels as others have stated. The ride is excellent and the Hemi HP is awesome. I have added a AeroTurbine exhaust to replace the stock muffler and the sound is outstanding with a horsepower boost and mpg increase also. Nothing like a Hemi that sounds like a Hemi.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Big Horn-4 Doors Does Not a Wimpy Truck
Review: When my '99 Durango was closing in on the 70k mark and since I really and truly loathed the new style Durangos and had no need for 3rd row seating, a Quad Cab 4x4 would suit my needs just as well as my 'Rango plus w/Hemi power. It could be a blast. Keep in mind, in Aug of '05 I bought #2436 of '05s 4263 produced Rumble Bees. My Bee is a std cab and I didn't know if my 4 ft longer girl would meet expectations.  This new Hemi MDS engine thing for '06-its a fallacy. I still get 24-26 on the hiway just like my Bee. I lucked out on price tho. $41k down to $29k because the guy who ordered her refused delivery- she's decked out like a Hemi Sport-Hood Scoop; skirts, and chromed to die for.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: My first new truck in 16 years
Review: I have had the truck for just over a month now and I love it. I drive 40 miles each way to work and am getting about 17 miles to the gallon. Better than I expected! The 4.7 has more than enough power for my use and the interior provides all the room I need to get my family around. Dodge could make a locking tailgate standard. I had to go and by one to prevent it from being stolen. All in all I love the look and ride it provides. Hope to keep it for 10 years or 250,000 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This Truck is absolutely perfect in every way. No problems at all and has become quite peppy now that it's broken in. I'm averaging 17 mpg's around town and I got 21.6 on a short 500 mile trip. I only use Chevron fuel and Mobil 1 Synthetic Oil.  I am extremely pleased with this new Dodge Ram. I can honestly say that this is the best Ram I've owned, ever! My only negative is that the Quad cab Ram is smaller then the Tundra double cab. Need the Mega Cab to get more cab space then Tundra.  The Quad cab Ram is bigger in overall size but smaller in cab space.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: A good looking truck, inside and out. Came with 20in wheels which make it stand out. And the price was low.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned a 2003 and 2004 Ram 1500. My new 2006 is a whole new feel. I loved my previous two Rams. I was a bit skeptical when I went to look at the styled Ram. The first glance of the totally redesigned interior really let me breathe easy. The fit and finsh really seemed to be there. The new front end design caught my eye as well. This new Ram rides a lot better than my previous Rams. Cab noise has been cut in half as was a problem with my 2004. I really enjoy the power of the Hemi. I had a 4.7 in my previous trucks. This engine was fine but a bit under powered for towing minimal loads. I went to the dealership to buy a Chevy and left with a Dodge.  Overall I rate this truck a 10!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The ride for such a large vehicle is not bad, and actually very serene with a load or while towing.  Power is always available, although rear wheel spin is very easy to accomplish.  20" aluminum wheels are stunning, although I've already had a flat. Go for aftermarket tires, the stock ATX's are horrible.  I had experienced steering wheel shudder at 300 miles too, but never again. Transmission adapted well to my light foot. Sirius radio is great on trips and worth it in mountains or where no radio.  Brakes fade easily, be careful in rain.  Towing mirrors are well worth the price, but do get knicked by other vehicles too often.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My use of this vehicle has been primarily short trips [all under 100 miles] and errands around town.  It is great for hauling landscaping and building materials.  The ride is great, performance unbelievable, and the fuel economy is significantly better than my wife's smaller SUV.  The interior is quiet and comfortable.  Creature comforts are more than I'd expect in a truck.  The handling is better than I anticipated in a full sized four wheel drive truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Purchased one because I am a big fan of both pick-ups and Dodge, and this beast is great.  Big body styling, tons of power, and for the size of both the vehicle and the engine I really can't complain about fuel mileage.  Comfortably seats my family of 6 (taken a couple of 4+ hour road trips in it), only real problem with interior is with 3rd person on front bench you lose cup holders for legroom.  Otherwise very simply designed interior, lots of anemities that make it a snazzy vehicle still built for practicality.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My wife an I had an '04 Hemi that was what I thought was the perfect truck. The new Night Runner we just purchased is incredible.On long trips it is comfortable,  and has a smooth ride. it's powerful and more refined. Dodge is bringing a quality product to the table, and I will continue to buy them. We love HP, and Dodge gives you a killer baseline to begin with. What a product!  A+++

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned F150's for the past 26 years. Not anymore! This Dodge 1500 I own is a superior vehile in ever manner. Performance, style, comfort. Ford, Chevy, or any other manufacturer don't even come close.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: It has a great ride, good performance and sharp looks.  Mine has the optional sunroof, MOPAR exhaust system, chrome tubular running boards,  spray-in bedliner, and chrome bug shield.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Very much a joy to own. The truck is very comfortable, and the drivability is great. The new frame really seems to help handling, and the truck is very quiet. Power is great with the 5.7, and the 5 speed auto seems to always be in the correct gear. Very nice truck overall.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Very nice truck if you can feed it
Review: Have enjoyed the truck. Solid truck and I'm very satisfied with the exception of fuel mileage around town. Not bad on the road. Much better than my '04 hemi though.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The truck is everything I expected, and more. Extremely attractive, handles and rides great. The Hemi speaks for itself, all the power you need. And with a set of duals on, it sounds great.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: A great truck.  In real world driving it's returned 14.5 in mixed and 19 hwy mpg when using the cruise control.  Outstanding for a 345 HP Hemi.  It rides as well and is as quite as our Cadillac Escalade.  I have the cloth seats and they are very comfortable.  After a 700 mile trip, my back felt great! My truck was equiped with the Thunderroad pkg. I love the looks of the 20" rims.  This truck has it all...quality build, awesome looks, muscle car power, and a comfortable ride that rivals the very best!!  Combine that with Employee pricing and cash rebates and you have the very best value for a full size truck...bar none!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my 4th Dodge Ram and with each newer purchase I see the many improvements that Chrysler does to these trucks. Now that Mercedes is involved these trucks are much better with both fit and finish and design. This 4.7 V-8 is providing me with exceptional mileage at 17 mpg's around town. This is a major improvement over the 13 I got in my 2000 Ram with the 318. Overall I am very pleased with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The Dodge truck is definitely the most agressive looking truck out there today. The only thing I think they could have done better was putting a little better shock and spring set up on the truck. I put Bilstein aftermarket shocks on recently and it has gotten a lot better. Next is a lttle tougher spring. What was Dodge thinking? This isn`t a Cadillac, it`s a truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I never knew a truck could function so well as a true multi-purpose vehicle. It has excellent styling and build quality, a better ride than my 2002 Accord V6 that I traded in, lots of room, and an outstanding powertrain. Simply a great truck. The fuel consumption stings a little, but it could be worse.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I purchased the SLT quad cab 4x4 sport.  Great looking big red truck but the steering wheel started to shimmy at highway speeds at 300 miles.  Dealer tried to correct and only made the problem worse.  Truck was also unstable with a 4500lb boat in tow over expansion joints at highway speeds.  I lost trust in the vehicle after one week of owner ship and sold it back to the dealer with 600 miles on it.  My worst buying/owning experience ever.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love driving the vehicle! For the most part, I bought it for the handling and ride.Fuel mileage is adequate, although not near the advertised 19 mpg highway. I've also noticed the transmission does not shift smoothly. The truck "surges" when shifting up through the gears.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've really had a ball driving this truck.  Wish I'd have opted for the nav pkg, but other than that it's perfect.  Gas mileage has never gotten to the sticker of 14/18. I'm getting 13 to 14 mixed driving, did get 15.2 on a full tank of highway driving.  I get lots of compliments on the vehicle as it's bright red with the 20" wheels so it has a great appearance.  I've owned several trucks, this has been the best one.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my truck in Texas when my old Dodge finaly died. The water pump went and I didnt have time to fix it. I was pulling a trailer from C.C. Tx to Las Vegas NV. I was already late getting to Las Vegas. That weekend I had stared on Friday and didn't get in till Tuesday. Driving to Las Vegas there are a few step hills and the truck had to shift down to a lower gear in order to complete the climb. I was pulling a 25 fifth wheel. The avg MPG was 12.3. Its not that bad but it could have been better. In city driving, the avg MPG is 11.5 Poor rating. I think truck manufactures need to do something about this. When in idle sitting at a red light take out a few cyclinders. We have ways to do it.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I really like the design of this truck. Its easy to get in and out of. Interior is very durable and comfortable. Very smooth over bumps and potholes. Great storage place under the rear seat, and the cup holders are great too.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck, the ride is excellect, the ergonomics have greatly improved over the '05. I traded in my 2004 for this model. 100% better all around

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My truck is white, hence the nickname. It fits in my garage which most neighbors' trucks don't.  It handles very well, has great performance, and mileage better than my Durango [so long as I don't get too happy with the Hemi].  All in all, it may be the best vehicle I've puchased in the last 35 years.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love the truck, wish it actually could get in the MPG rates that the window sticker had... but I didn't buy it for gas mileage.  I'm averaging around 13- 14 MPG mixed driving.  Other than that, it's a great pickup, plenty of power.  A side note: I got sat. radio free for a year, neat service.  I'm hooked.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have got to say that I love this truck, all the towing power that I need and what an eye turner.  with 345 hp enough to show everyone that Dodge has the right idea about building a man's truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I'm a Chevy man but when I drove this truck I just had to have it.  Fit, finish, performance are all excellent.  Only minus is gas mileage.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: After 3000 miles this truck already proven itself more refined than my previous 2003 similarly equipped Ram.  The interior noise levels are greatly reduced, the ride is 90% improved (feels "nervous" over small amplitude, high frequency inputs) over the previous chassis (2002-2005).  The premium audio system has been worth the money and the new look, both inside and out, has won me over.  One improvement often not mentioned are the new cloth seats.  They are firmer, made of better material, and can be optioned with adjustable lumbar.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I looked at so many trucks finally found my truck st quad cab 4.7 with 5 speed auto .I like the redesign for '06 rides more comfortable than '05 model.I also like the room on the quad cab and being able to take the wife and kids on trips.I traded in an '06 Honda Civic and the build quality is so much better on the Dodge Ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Excellent truck, ST value package quad cab 2wd with a automatic 4.7l.I traded a Honda Civic '06 (junk) in .I could not be more pleased with my purchase. I like the redesign on '06 model. It rides better and quieter than '05 model.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: With just over 3000 miles in one month, this truck has been fun to drive.  Everything has been great about the truck so far.  The only issue that I feel Dodge skimped on was the 20" Chrome clad Rims.  DO NOT BUY them. They are PLASTIC hubcaps glued to the rim's.  In 4-5 years these rims will fade and the plastic will crack when someone goes to change the tires or valve stem.  I know, because I already had to replace a tire after having a blowout.  If you like these rim's, I'm looking to trade them with someone who doesn't like the non-chrome clad rims!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: What a pleasure to climb behind the wheel of a well designed truck. I'm 6'2" 230 lb. I have to run the seat forward to reach pedals and controls, room to spare in a regular cab. I pull a Tandem axel large box trailer. The tow haul 5speed auto works like a dream in tow haul mode. Their is 2 2nd gears so technically this is a 6 speed. Full box frame on a half ton. Independant front suspension with 4x4. Drives and handles nice. 20 inch wheels and wide goodyear rubber. Bites well on dry pavement. Will smoke tires with little effort. Be carefull on wet pavement. MDS Hemi is sweet, can't feel it change. 20 mpg at 65 mph. I waited on the MDS in the truck, glad I did. Not one problem yet, 16 months. All in all they got it right. Thanks Dodge. I have owned 3 New Dodge, 2 New Chevys, 1 New Ford if that tells you anything.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: Nice and comfortable ride.Decent sound system. Center console should have storage compartment like they had in the '8 models. Gas mileage is pretty efficient. I can go from Daytona to Tampa and back on less than half a tank (approx.300mi.). Overall big bang for your buck.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I really enjoy this truck. It has the V6 and is getting 17-20 mpg city/hwy. Very good handling when towing or regular driving. The new power package is really nice on the ST models .

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I bought my truck almost as bare as they come. Even so, I love this truck a lot. The V6 has more than enough power to keep this truck moving and the new interior layout is the best in its class in my opinion. The tranny is silky smooth. The ride seems a little bouncy but I think it might be because I drive a sports car most of the time. It's been years since I drove a truck on a regular basis. The center console does rob the use of the center seat but so does the stick shift. I never planned on the center seat being used very much anyway so this doesn't bother me too much. There is quite a bit of storage area behind the seats as well.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I bought the base ST with the "work truck" package (a $400 credit for a black grille instead of chrome).  I like the truck overall, but I don't like the huge center console and rock hard middle seat.  On a regular cab pickup, you need that middle seat!  In this truck the center seating position is almost unusable as there is nowhere for the middle person to put their feet.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: This truck i sawesome! Great fuel economy and near zero road noise. Smooth handling and great drive

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Dodge has discontinued most parts for SRT 10

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Coming up on 3 years. Definitely unique amongst all the others out there. Owned a 2003 Lightning previously and let go prematurely; this one's better and rarer. One of the last built. Loaded w/all options. Fortunate to find sitting on the lot w/less than 60 miles. Deeply devalued due to hi gas prices of the time.  Excellent all around vehicle choice - Viper like performance and equipment with the benefits of a P/U. Added a locking bed latch and a hitch & harness for a light utility trailer to haul dirty stuff. Around 15 MPG. No mechanical or quality problems. No end to the the thumbs up and positive comments when rolling down the highway. If you get the chance, buy it and enjoy driving it!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Driving this truck is awesome. From the initial start up to hitting the highway, this truck is a blast. Need passing power? This truck does real well straight from the factory. Handling is precise and stable. Braking that is like nothing else I've driven. Comfort that goes beyond a perforamnce truck's expectations. The ride is a little tough over bumps and other typical road conditions but it's well worth the trade off when you want to use the truck as it should be used, Hard and Fast. With the Viper V-10 under the hood, I have a great platform to build on.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is amazing. It is so fast it's disgusting. It is absolutely scary fast in every way. It's also an incredibly beautiful truck, which gets a lot of looks and stares. I bought this truck because I liked it and I like to go fast. Some people however don't feel the same way. Buy one and have some fun like me!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: I purchased my SRT-10 Quad Cab after much research. I could not have made a better choice for what I was looking for. I wanted high performance and my wife wanted luxury and safety. We found it in our 2006 Ram SRT-10 Quad Cab. This truck is the best handling, best stopping and head turning vehicle that I have ever owned. I am seriously considering another one in regular cab. No complaints about the mileage either. I have a 95 3/4 ton ext. cab with the cast iron V-10 and the gas mileage is about the same as the SRT- 10. I am actually impressed with the mileage. I only drive the SRT maybe once or twice a month even though I really want to drive it daily. My hat's off to the SRT engineers. Awesome

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Albeit the fact that I have made nearly $20,000 in mods to my trucks, I look forward everyday to driving it. love the sound, the looks I get. When I "matte" it at 35mph she gets sideways... can you say yeee haw!! But what do you expect with a truck with around 700hp.  It has all the sound of True Viper!  Yes, the mileage is bad on it, but I went into buying it knowing that it got terrible mileage. If you want an eco car get a Yugo! If you have the need for power and speed get a Ram SRT-10!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review_Title: Month 2 and still a blast to drive
Review: Going into my second month with this truck and it is still a blast to drive. The only down side is the mileage but you know that going in.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: I love my SRT10 Ram. It is fast and very responsive although the fuel ecomoney stinks. When clean it looks awesome and always fetches many compliments

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: More power than you should have with the kids in the back seat. Every time I would punch it the kids would just laugh! Having a hard time keeping the wife out of it. A wolf in sheep's clothing. Pure fun!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is simply a joy to drive. The equivalent of 60's muscle cars , but dignified. Fuel consumption is average. Stay out of the throttle and you'll do OK. I average 16.5 mpg at 70/72 mph on my three hour drive to my home every weekend. You can not get away from the stares and questions. Everytime I stop somewhere I feel like a  celebrity. It handles like a 5000lb tire smoking go kart. The ride is a little firm, but suits me fine. The fit and finish is very well done. I love this Dodge. No problems to date. Added performance pcm, 75 more horsepower, and a cold air intake for 20 more horsepower, whoa! I didn't need it but hold on now, fuel difference is yet to be determined. Way to go Dodge!

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Dodge's Hybrid, Burns Gas and Rubber
Review: Bought the 2006 SRT-10 strictly for fun. Already had a 2006 Dodge Ram 4x4 Hemi truck for daily use. This truck is the meanest, baddest truck you can buy. Gas mileage wasn't even considered, just like the 70's muscle cars. Anyone buying one of these for regular use has no idea about trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Truck has met all expectations as to horsepower & performance. A sports car in a truck, as they say, really nice, a head turner for sure.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: This vehicle is a definite eye turner, it makes all other trucks look insufficient.  The interior is gorgeous; the moonroof is large and interior is comfortable.  The exterior is in a class by itself, simply put sexy.  The only downfall is the gas mileage.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I know that I put a 10 for fuel economy but I mean for the kind of horsepower it delivers It has great fuel economy. I love everything about this truck and would never trade it in for any competitor. This truck truly is the best of the best.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: The truck is awesome, tturns a lot of heads.  Have a little trouble starting in the cold weather. The seat belt light and beep is obnoxious.  The wing gets in the way for any real hauling.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is awesome! I'm so glad I traded in my 2004 Z06 Corvette for it. The SRT-10 is MUCH quicker, rides better and get much better gas milage than the Chevy. I should have bought the SRT-10 in the first place instead of spending a year and a half in hell with the Z06.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Owned and enjoyed evey moment behind the wheel.  All this anticipated when purchased were satisfied. Unable to get away from onlookers and excited car buffs. Faster off the line than anything I have ever been in even Lambo. Was not my first choice for work however, once I got a look work is only 40 hours a week.

Vehicle_Title: 2006 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is the biggest waste of money I have ever spent.  The road noise inside is terrible, there is no gas mileage to speak of, and it is not as fast as published. I have had it in the shop 3 times for repairs.  Pretty bad for a truck with only 9,000 miles on it.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB
Review: I love my truck. Just got 210k miles original motor and tranny. She rides and drives great. When you drive it just put it to the floor and she gets up and goes but my friends truck is a 95 dodge and he had to replace the motor 3 times and the tranny 4 i keep telling him to get a dodge like mine but no he wont

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: This is an awesome truck perhaps my favorite. when we got this Ram it 212k and rebuilt to a decent extent. the person who had it before us was a fire fighter and floored it 24/7. It needed a new crankshaft, also anew power door actuator, and to add to that the hood wasn't latched properly so it flung up and hit the windshield so the hood is crooked. Along with all that is a very reliable engine the 318 is the best engine to put in a big vehicle. Cosmetics is pathetic Chrysler was to cheap to put something better in their vehicles. Overall it is a mean sounding truck, very reliable, and very cheap.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab WS 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: I got my 2000 dodge ram when i was 16. It was my first truck i had ever had. It is a short bed 1500 ram with a 5.9L. The truck now has upgrades,lke new flowmaster 40's on it. It make a kickass sound now. A few days ago i got in my first accident with it. I made a improper right turn and i did not see the car coming at me. It hit me at 45mph and bounced off my truck with little damage to me and for the car that hit me was a new BMW 335i and it got messed up. It is my fault but the truck did save my life because the car hit the drivers door. I would recommend these trucks for new drives for first cars because it saved my life. Even tho i'm 17 now i'm going to keep my truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: great truck. 5.2 engine--gas mileage 16 to 18 mpg.  I rerouted air from fender to right front of vehicle to improve gas mileage and power. I installed a short section of pve pipe onto existing air cleaner pipe and routed next to radiator to catch air as you are traveling.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: I purchased this truck new with 43 miles on it after a 1996 that I bought used with 3000 miles on it was a lemon. I did put over 115,000 miles on it.  I traded it in for this 2000 Dodge that has over 163,000 miles at this time. No major problems at all. I just get regular oil changes, tune up, brakes and routine maintenance. I am going to buy a Jaguar sportwagon soon but I am not getting rid of the truck. As for the mileage. On my recent roundtrip from California to Texas, the average mpg was 16 to 20.  I came back loaded to the top and the least mpg was 14.  The most major thing that I have done is replace the front spindle at about 60,000 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: Great truck to own. It's seven years old and only had to replace the transmission. After transmission replacement, it's been awesome!

I get 14mpg steady 50mph and some city driving with KN/dynomax add ons.  has 360,  good power but no comparison btwn 360 and gm vortec.  Great ride height and comfort, seats are great, with all the power options, you can cruise in comfort and style.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought this after outgrowing my 93 toyota extracab.  All 3 of us fit very comfortably in the standard cab/SB, and the truck parks easier than my old toyota (read tight turns). I have had this truck off-road, and the slid axle is vastly superior to any IFS. The 5.9 is a must for the 4WD due to its weight, and I improved the hwy mileage almost 2 MPG with a deck cover. Only problem; a leaking tranny cooler line, fixed under warranty. I have used this truck to haul, tow, and daily driving, and it excells at all, but 13-14 mpg combined stinks. Regardless, if you need a work and/or off-road truck, this is the best from that year.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: Love the looks, but am disappointed by rattles, squeaks, inaccurate gas guage, spark knock that can't be fixed, and "software" problems that cause the Check Engine light to come on periodically.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: 2000 4X4 reg./cab/sb:   I've always owned full size trucks and this one was the best.  Mine had the 5.2l V8 and the 5spd tranny.  I can personally attest that it would do a 17.1sec quarter mile and break traction into 3rd gear (not bad for a 4X4).  Extremely rugged truck, Ford and chevy couldn't match.  I used this truck hard for 2 years (30k mi).  I would drop the clutch at 3000 rpm locked up in 4hi with the truck sitting in a foot of sand...I guarantee a Ford or Chevy would've popped.  The only probs with mine were a leaky brake proportioning valve and a bent steering stabilizer that I rebounded off a huge rock...  Both were fixed free under warranty.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: Mine is a 5.9L Auto/4x4, but that wasn't an option. Overall this truck has done its duty without any major issues. My dad bought it brand new and i bought it off him 3 years ago. Took good care of it but worked it hard too. They are good for what they are if taken care of. People don't seem to treat them right, but if you do find one that has been taken care of, you can't beat them for the price

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: It's easy to say this is THE best truck ive ever driven. I'm at almost 123,000 miles and there has been no major fixes on the truck. The only things i've had to replace is the power steering pump and the brake cylinder. Only bad parts about it are the gas mileage (about 12 for me) and the fact that the paint doesn't hold up in the desert!

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
