While Dodges have great design reliability lack

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought my truck new 10 years ago and have drove 176,000 miles.  Overall a good quality truck.  I replaced the transmission at 120,000 miles but no other big ticket repairs.  It has been a good truck but has always sucked a lot of gas through the 5.9 l engine (about 14mpg).

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: i love the truck ive had it since 2006 my dad bought it on new years 2000 i have 124000 miles on it today and it still runs strong tows a 25 ft boat no problem its got the 5.9 liter gas guzzler but it sure does have alot more power than the ford has and it rides very smooth for a truck especially for one that was made almost 10 years ago i had to put a new tranny in it after offroading the truck but the motor is very strong still runs like the day i got it the only problem i have with the truck is the door panels are starting to rust but you have to remember its almost 10 years old i will drive dodge for as long as i live

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Great Truck - Still runs great in 2009
Review: I bought this truck used in 2003 with 57000 miles. I've been driving it for six years now and have accumulated 130000 miles. I had to replace the transmission at 95000 miles but everything else is still running as new. Sure, after being 9 years old, it is starting to show rust around the rear fenders and cab corners but other than that I'm still happy as can be with it. I don't plan on buying another vehicle for years to come. Tons of power and performance, great sound, and awesome looks.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: I bought this truck after my older Dodge was totaled in an accident. I wouldn't feel safe in anything else. Never had any problems with either truck except BASIC upkeep. Water pump needed to be replaced at 100k miles because supposedly the 2000 were the first year they used a new one. Other then that, no problems. Gas mileage is around 18 mpg, doesn't suck gas like other trucks. Far better mpg then my fathers '07 Titan.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I have to say that for my age (20), I have owned a lot of vehicles. And this one is by far the best one yet. I have to say that I love this truck. I have a 2000 Ram 1500 sport, with the 5.9 and while it is not the best on gas...averaging like 15mpg...it has been a great truck. With the exception of the axle joints, and an ABS sensor, I havent had to do a thing to this truck.  It pulls well and the 4 wheel drive is excellent, even if im just playing in the mud with it. I would highly recommend one of these trucks to anyone, but know that no matter what you buy, there is a chance of getting a bad one, but when you get a good one like I did, its all worth it.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: We've had this truck for 1.5 yr, have been very happy. Enjoy  the highway ride and quiteness. Fuel economy about average for this class, 13-17 on the highway. The 5.2 liter performs well. I can see if you did heavy towing that you might want the 5.9. Interior is nice and solid, not as refined as other brands. Enjoy the ground clearance and the overall stoutness of the truck. Would definitely buy again.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I purchased my Dodge used with over 100k miles on it. Shortly after purchase I found the truck was plagued with mechanical problems. Since I bought the truck I've put a mere 12,000 miles on it. Two transmissions, two sets of ball joints, a steering box, a fuel pump, and an AC compressor later I wish I'd spent a little more money on the competition.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I come from a long line of Chevy owners, but after searching for just the right truck for myself I fell in love with the Dodge Ram.  I have driven plenty of Chevy's but for comfort you can't beat the Ram.  I live in So. Cal. and the freeways are more like parking lots, but for a truck I still get great gas mileage (better than my friends 04 Avalanche).

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: MPG only real fault with Dodge truck
Review: I love my truck. It has power to spare from the 5.9L V-8, pulls our 4 horse trailer well, and rides nicer than my brothers new Chevy 1500 HD with bells n whistles out the ying yang ( i just dont like how his rides, really, bounces the hell out of you, very glitchy gas pedal). MPG is the only really bad pt on this truck. It lags way behind other comparable trucks. 13- 15mpg is about it, and that doesnt seem to change too much towing loads, drops to 10-13 or so. Other than that, I love my truck. It is reliable, drives nice, comfortable, lots of room, and nice layout. Would still by Dodge truck again, despite bad MPG, if I could leave fuel costs out of picture.

Vehicle_Title: 2000 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: A fine truck, but has a drinking problem
Review: Bought the truck used from dealer with 21K on the clock over 3 years ago.  It has given excellent service. It gives a decent ride, has very good power, is quite maneuverable for its size, and has all of the creature comforts (my wife loves the heated seats).  It pulls our 19' camper trailer with little strain. Upkeep and maintenance has been very reasonable - BUT -  Gas mileage is horrible!  Best I've ever gotten with it is 14.1 on a long, fairly flat trip. Driving back and forth to work, I get about 10.5.  Towing the trailer (no faster than 60 mph) I get 8.7 mpg.  Next truck I get HAS to get better mileage. I hope that Dodge can fill the bill, 'cause I've been a Mopar fan for 35+ years!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: It may be 12 years old but I love the truck.
Review: I have a every expanding mowing business that I do on the side and was looking for an inexpensive pickup. I found this Arizona owned truck with two wheel drive and it was priced to sell by private seller so I grabbed it up. The truck has the 4.7 V8 that does pretty well pulling around my enclosed mowing trailer with equipment in it. It does great around town mowing 40 yards a week. I get about 11mpg pulling the trailer in stop and start non stop while mowing. My only gripe is I wish it had the Hemi in it. I think it would pull the trailer better at highway speeds. It does pull it down the highway ok but I just feel like it could use the extra HP. If it is a windy day I feel like I am giving it some throttle to keep it at 60. Overall the truck for being 12 years old has minimal issues 125,000 miles. AC works great very comfortable interior. Only issue is the CD player stopped working but did not break my heart as my new laptop does not even have a CD accessory anymore to make CD's. I am impressed with how the door handles hold up on the truck. Which may sound stupid but other work vehicles I have used to mow door handles were always falling apart. For a work truck, I am honestly scared to upgrade because this thing has been so good to me. I rated the MPG low but I use this nearly all of the time pulling a trailer so hard to judge.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Trucks are not just for guys. We girls drive them too. I bought my Ram used with 53,000mi and have over 183.000 on it and still going. As a nurse I depend on my Ram in bad weather to get me to and from work because we don't get snow days. As a horse owner I trust my Ram to pull my horses safely to where ever I am going. On the farm I use it to haul seed during planting season, firewood when cutting up trees and whatever else comes along. With wear and tear I have had to replace things. But when I buy again it will be a RAM!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Where to start. I bought the truck with 89k miles on it...at 90k the rear end started to leak that was lil expensive. I had windsheild whiper problems twice where they conect one would pop off one wone would work. the clutch went out at 100k(i dont do burn outs i baby my truck-never pulled huge load) that was liek 1500$$ i love hate it the driver side rear break light works of adn on...tho when i drive the manaul 5spd 4.& V8 with the 30 series flowmsater I sit back and wonder if i coudl ever get Rid of mt truck i love the manuls:) the egine it slef is ok power rusn great i get 20MPG highway if i baby it but uslay 17-18 adn 14-15 city....in all honesty i would say go with a ford MABE chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: It's a good thing that Dodges don't hold their value!
Review: Seriously... it's a fact. Dodge's DO NOT hold their value compared to, say an F150 or a Sierra, or a Silverado. BUT... This is a good thing because that means you and I can get our hands on a really good, really appealing truck for $1000s less! I've had 3 Dodge's so far, one with a 3.7 V6, one with a 4.7 V8, and one with the 5.7 HEMI V8 (Awesome engine!), and i wished i'd kept all three. Unfortunately i suffer from, "Gotta' have the next thing-itis" and i think it's terminal. All 3 trucks were great, the V6 was really underpowered, the 4.7 was normal, but the HEMI was incredible. Got rid of the HEMI a few months ago and it had 238,000 miles and ran like it had 50k, no lie. I LOVE EM.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: i have an o4 dodge with 78k original miles, i just spun a rod bearing and dodge refuses to assist in any way meaning time for a new motor at my cost. i have had more warranty work done in the past than probably any vehicle should have, the had to fix leaking rear end, transmission failure, and replace both exhaust manifolds at the motor. my ball joints are also shot and my transmission is leaking at the yoke. i will never purchase another dodge again and i will recommend the same for anyone i meet. they were completely unhelpful at corporation when it came to warranty assistance. BUYER BE WARE!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Great vehicle, plenty of interior space. Smooth Drive. Gas Hog!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Very reliable truck.  Have had to do only normal maintenance.  If you want horsepower and looks this is the truck.  If you want a girls truck I would try the F-150.  I've had some people try their luck against the Hemi and all they have seen is my bumper as I pull away.  What a great feeling.  Will always have a Ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: 1.5 yrs still love it  QC 5.7 SLT 4x4
Review: Pros: -Great Engine! owned a 94 ram 5.2L, after this the 5.7L was incredible. After 2 yrs of driving and hauling more than I should the engine never even breaks a sweat. A 3/4 engine in a 1/2 ton. Tow/Haul mode is a + -Interior front has plenty of storage and works as it should, back seats have plenty of leg room and the fold out flat cargo "platforms" under the flip up seats are genius. -The quad cab deserves it's own comment because although it's not a true crew cab I'll never go back to not having 4 fully opening doors. Personally, I wouldn't want anything with bigger rear doors. Con: -The rear suspension is lacking when paired with the 5.7L (I upgraded with air) -No rear limited slip.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is an excellent truck.  It is everything a truck should be; it's fast, looks great, and is better on gas than some believe.  I'm getting at least 18 miles to the gallon.  As you may know, the Hemi kicks in after 35mph,saving in some gas, not a lot, but savings is savings. Older model but it is a great vehicle. Great truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: LOVE My Truck! You Will Too...
Review: I never thought I'd drive a truck but bought the SLT 5.7L HEMI after renting one to tow motorcycles.  I absolutely love it!  It's so incredibly comfortable inside, and you feel like king of the road when you drive it.  I have NEVER had mechanical problems with my truck.  It has been very dependable and I always enjoy driving it.  Yes, the engine's loud - don't get a HEMI if you don't like it.  That's where the power is.  No, it doesn't handle bumps well - don't buy a truck if you don't want it to drive like a truck - just hit them slowly and head on.  Fuel efficiency is not impressive - we all know that - take the bus to work. If that's not your objective, this is your truck.  Don't miss out

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Bought my '04 Hemi w/25000 miles on it. The previous owner babied it.  Now I have approximately 78500 miles on it and have only had to replace the front rotors. Excellent power althought new models have more.  It pulls my trailer with no problem.  This year I installed a Cherry Bomb Pro muffler to add a little "growl" to the motor.  I kept the single factory pipe which comes out of the sidge behind the right rear wheel.  Most people that I run into thinks that it sounds better than their own more expensive Flowmaster and Magnaflow dual exhaust set ups.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The Lone Star Package is great.  This is the 1st HEMI I have owned in a truck, and let me say WOW.  That is some power, off the line and on the highway, you will not be disappointed.  I have had no problems in the past 3 years, and with the great deal am not upside down on my loan :~). Just wish it had a sun roof.  For RAW power and decent mpg, its well worth the money.  This truck can get almost 18MPG highway, or down to 9mpg if you have a lead foot and love speed.  The bottom line is the power is there when you need it!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: What awesome Hemi power. Blows away most other cars and trucks. Bought used at 5000 miles and added cruise and power locks. Just drove 3000 miles in rain, snow and sleet including mountain driving and freeways. Averaged 16.5 mpg at 75 to 80 mph and a big load in the bed. Love this truck! No repairs, only oil changes since purchase.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought this 04 Dodge Hemi in April of 2007. It's a sweet truck. It's got everything but a sunroof. This truck is very fun to drive except on really wet roads with some standing water. The 20" tires seem to hydroplane too much. (but yes I do love the way they look) On snowy roads they seem to do the same thing. I never felt like I had good traction in the winter. My 95 Dakota felt more stable. The gas mileage isn't very good around town 11/12.2 is the best I've seen. Freeway is OK but I never broke 16, until I got a K&N (just the pop in filter). The cold air intake is to loud. After I put the filter in,after about 300 miles I would get high 16s and 17s on trips if I drove around 75mph.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This old boy as 53,000 miles on it. This as been a great truck so far. Most of these miles have been highway, it's the family vacation  truck. Wife doesn't know how to pack. I have no problems out of this truck. The gas cap went bad with 500 miles on it and the dearler replaced. At 30,000 miles did the service at a local shop not Dodge paid about 500 or so for it. When gas prices got high we used my wife's car for vacation this fellow only gets 15.5 miles per gallon on highway at 80 mph. People can't beleive it's an 04. It rides good and looks good with the 20 inch wheels. Had to replace the tire with 30,000 miles on them. There sometimes is a ticking sound from the engine put in Mobil 1 synthetic oil.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: No more Dodge, I bought the slt quad cab with the small v8 thinking the gas mileage might be better, mistake. I have a Ford ranger that gets better mileage and for the weight to power ratio way outperforms the slug that Dodge is, lately I have been having trouble with overheating and have replaced every bolt on part associated with the cooling system and still it runs hot,  bad gas mileage,  underpowered,  overheats,  Toyota next time

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: Hemi performance excellent, gas consumption not a concern at time of purchase. At $5 a gallon it is time to be frugal. At $8 use only for fun and necessity. If the eco wackos have tier way I still won't separate from this vehicle. I love to drive it. I feel comfortable, safe, and in charge. It handles as well as any car I have ever owned. I am satisfied and have a goal of at least 200,000 mi.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: A great Truck for the Money!!!
Review: What a Great Truck, it's fun to drive.It is a very reliable truck for the money. It handles excellent very comfortable interior.The only problem is the gas mileage. All in all a Great truck keep up the good work Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I sold my 04 a few months ago, and I miss it dearly. I had warped rotors in 18000km, never again.One bad oxygen sensor. Put 120000km on it, and loved it. Lots of trips in all kinds of weather, and the AWD never missed a beat. Couldn't lite up the back tires to show off, but I'm too old for that s$#^.I pulled 2 ATVs in an enclosed trailer very easily. 18hwy,13city,11-12 towing I'm looking for another Ram now, gotta have the full time transfer case. I put on open country toyos as replacement tires(17,265's) and loved them. MDS would be nice to have.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Great truck. No problems ever, except the front door seals chewing themselves up (replaced under warranty with the redesigned seal). The way this truck is driven, it may sit unstarted for weeks but then pretty much every time it is used for a property company, it is hauling a full load or towing. Never a hiccup, starts right up, and it gets an unbelievable number of "hey, nice truck" comments even being four years old. At Lowe's they even comment about how they see more Dodges than anything else at the commercial dock.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: No power in the 4.7, yet same fuel economy as the 5.7 Hemi? Other than the small "jeep" engine wearing prematurely, the transmission is my only concern- shifts are insecure and I know my tranny will be the first thing to go. Though, very comfortable truck, love the way it handles and drives! I'm considering a Cummins diesel version...

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck, fun to drive, handles very well for a big truck. Brakes are great, engine preformace is unbelievable for such a large vehicle.  In the last three years of ownership the only problem I have had was a leaking left front shock. That was replaced under warranty. On the hiway traveling at 120 KH the truck scoots along. But still gets about 24 mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is the first vehicle that I have ever been involved with for this long and I have had absolutely zero defects whatsoever.  Truly amazing. The only fault I can find with with this truck is the gas mileage, but given the power and torque it has, I guess I shouldn't complain about that. I did'nt buy it going in with the expectation of great gas mileage.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Very satisfied with the truck. Other family members who own Nissan, F250 and F350 trucks borrow this one for light hauling because it is so much more comfortable and easier to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is my 6th Dodge and was very aggrivated with all the problems. Water pump  failed leaving me stuck out of state for 3 days, steering wheel wobble, steering wheel radio controls fell off all at around 14,000 miles. Since then I have not had any problems and am approaching 60K .I need a truck and at the time Dodge seemed the best of the bunch but am not sure if I would purchase a Dodge again especially with the poor warranty. I'm stuck with this truck due to the poor resale value so hopefully I won't have any more problems and hope to get a 150K out of it. This truck is still better than the Ford and Chevy  I had.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Without the Cummins engine this truck would be plastic on wheels. The transmissions have always been and will always be a problem for Dodge. The interior lacks the comfort of Ford, however the exterior looks tough. The truck also rides like a truck, be prepared for back problems.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Switched from a 2000 F-150 Lariat last year for my Dodge QC Hemi, Wow what a difference. More power, no problem pulling my trailer and better comfort than the F150. Driving is far better and alot smoother. The interior has enough room where you dont think your sitting next the other person.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought my hemi quad cab with 28000 miles and the only problem I have had was a bad O2 sensor in the cat. But all sensors go sooner or later. I had a Ford explorer 4x4 with traction controll which handled well in the snow. The ram surprisingly handled better without adding extra weight to the bed.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck used about 5 months ago with only 19000 miles on it. Best decision I ever made.  I live in Ohio and took it to the Outerbanks for family vacation, and the ride was excellent. I average 13-14 city and 17-18 highway. Transmission shifts smoothly and love the rumble sound of the exhaust.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have a Quad Cab. I love the fact that I get style and power in one. With its great 20" wheels and good power. Driving it is fun and a pleasure.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have a blue 1500 SLT sport 4x4 loaded with tow package.  Bought used and since I off-road am not crazy about the 20 in dubs. Will switch to 17's later.  3rd truck I've owned and definitely the funnest. The Hemi has oh my God type horsepower. Same gas mileage I was getting with a Dodge V- 6.  After going to a full size, I am never going back.  Cruises smooth, and the Hemi is extremely tempting to get happy with.  Mileage 13-14 mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Overall, very dissatisfied with the engineering of this truck.  The front doors rub and cut the weatherstrip off.  Wind noise is worst in class.  Rattles and squeeks like it has 10 times the mileage it has.  The differential had to be replaced at 15k, and requires fluid changes every 15k otherwise.  Seat motor burned up early.  CD player ate a disk and required the Fonzerello treatment (that's a hard smack in the mouth for those of you who don't remember Happy Days).  If anyone owns one, take a look behind the mud flaps on the front wheels, the paint will be worn completly off.  The mistake I made in buying this truck was thinking that 35% off sticker price was a good deal.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Steering seizes and engine quits running
Review: As an owner of 2004 Dodge Ram I am quit scared to drive my truck because I have had two experiences of the steering seizing up and the engine eventually shutting down as I was turning a corner.  We took to dealership and they claim there is nothing they could find on the computer?

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: First full size, had Dakota's prior need the towing power. Wife and I were very pleased on how it handled on our cross country trip, 9000 miles. Gas mileage was good 21 on hi-way, 17 in city. Only downfall I have is front end suspension squeaks and squawk at slow speeds, in the shop for part replacement several times, no remedy yet. Heard alot about the Hemi glad I stayed with the Magnum. Had to have the door seals replaced, tearing apart near front window and front quarter panel trim. Overall pleased on how it handles and style.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck has a lot of quality problems. The doors rattle and window seals leak. It now has 42000 miles on it and now has starting problems. My dealer that sold it to me is now out of business and "other" Dodge dealers don't want to fix it. This is the last Dodge product I will buy.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Well so far so good, I really wanted a Ford F150 in the same year, but after driving both and looking at each they were about even (except the Dodge looks more manly man) Now I will say the Ford seem to have more get up and go off the start (I only have the V8 Mag and not the HEMI) but seems smoother all in all. Now, I have 21inch rims on mine now (bad choice if you want a non bumpy ride) but the ride is not as bumpy as my buddies Ford with the same rims and tires. Interior has space and room, I have the front bench seat so six total fit in mine.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: After owning chevy trucks the last 11 years,this is my first Dodge,and i love it! The handling and suspension is excellent! The 5.7 Hemi is great! This is the best handling truck I have ever driven in snow! I only have had this truck for 15 months, and have 19000 miles, so far no problems. I have owned 3 s-10's(1995,1999,2002)and a 2001 chevy silverado, these vehicles have been very unreliable, after the 3 year 36000 mile warranty expired, repairs were needed. I will find out in 1 or 2 years if the Ram is more reliable than the Chevys! The radio is better than the Chevys, a lot better! This truck is the biggest, baddest, and fastest truck available. This is the best truck available!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I traded a Ford F-150 for this truck. Mechanically, I have no issues with this truck. Comfort is another issue. Ride quality is extremely stiif. I know this is a truck, but the Ford is far more forgiving. Wind noise from the ill- fitting doors is unreal. I can slip my fingers in the gap between the windshield and the door. Evan after adding additional rubber to the gap the noise is still annoying. Fuel mileage is poor as well. Maybe it's just me, but 12.5 on the small V-8 could be improved.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The hemi gives good gas mileage at 65/70 highway-but-drops in city driving to 12/13. ride is excellent and room for 6 passengers except for the shift to 4 wheel drive the person  in the front seat does not have much room.  OK, for short distances but overall comfortable and a good drive/work/towing truck would highly recomend a test drive and purchase.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've found my Dodge truck to be both fun and tough.  It went through being rear ended at 20+ mph with only minor damage and no occupant injuries.  It does pretty well on mpg with averages of over 20 mpg on the highway.  I drove it through a huricane in SC through headlight deep water and high winds with no problems at all.  It handles well and with the hemi engine has plenty of power and performance.  I am very pleased with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I got the truck at 7000 miles, and have loved it ever since. My satisfaction only improved once I had dual flowmasters installed on it. My wife loves it on trips, but hates me driving, because i like to use the HEMI power. This is the first vehicle I have ever owned that she prefers to ride in over her 4cyl car.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: There will never be a substitute
Review: I love my truck!  I don't think I'll ever fall in love with another vehicle the way I fell in love with this one.  Sure, there are things I wish it had, like satelight radio.  But compared to other truck manufacturers, I love this one the best.  I love that it's big.  I love that it takes up space.  I love that it takes me 3 attempts to park it.  I love that I can fit all my toys in it.  I love that it can snow a foot and I don't have to worry.  This is the best vehicle I've ever had.  Trading it in will be the hardest thing I will ever have to do.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love this truck.  Had it a little over a year and have had no problems.  Rides great and has lots of get-up-and-go even though it doesn't have the Hemi.  I can't imagine how much power this thing would have with a Hemi, the standard V8 is that good.  Handles amazingly well considering its size.  Great ride and plenty of passenger room.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Strong truck easy to drive and handle.  Performance 2nd to none with the hemi.  Smooth shifting auto-trans, solid ride, and very capable 4X4.  Interior components solid, not shaky like my Fords wiggly windows or my GM's flimsy interior parts or mushy seats. Best truck on the road for the money today!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I think this is great off road truck! Goes anywhere! I have taken it through some tuff places and not had one problem getting me there or out! Have pulled many Fords out of ditches with it too!! I do this with no after market add ons also!!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: 0-60 in under 7 seconds.  Hauls 1800 lbs in the bed.  Seats 6 adults comfortably.  Gets 11-15 mpg:-(  If you can afford the gas mileage this is the best utility vehicle in the world.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Best of both worlds with muscle car looks and performance. Cavernous interior for my six foot three body. Mechanically reliable so far at 17k miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: After owning only Fords for years, this was my first truck and first Dodge. I have been very impressed with the whole experience. The dealership made me feel like a princess and multiple employees still come out to say "hi" when I get my oil changed. The truck itself has wonderful steering and braking response. I have almost 20k miles on it and am totally sold on it!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: So far, the Hemi has been good, but in retrospect, I would either have elected to go with the 3.92 axle instead of the 3.55 (just trying to squeeze as much MPG as possible and based on $2.09/gallon, who could blame me?) for around town driving and towing or simply employ the 4.7L verus the Hemi I purchased.  The Infinity Sound System Volume Limit and basic speakers were a dissappointment.  The ride is quite comfortable, the straight-forward cabin layout is obviously German influenced and for the BETTER I say.  I wish they would take another 3 inches out of the bed and add them to the rear cabin.  All in all, a good value for $3k less than Ford or Chevy.  Think about it.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Gotta have the 5.7L!  345 horses with amazing torque.  I added a Volcan air intake and 3 inch dual exhausts and it's pushing 360 horses and still maintains around 13.8 mpg.  If you want raw power... this is the truck you want.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love this truck. The drive is smooth and the handling is great for a big vehicle. With the 5.7L Hemi engine it has a lot of power and pick up off the line. I have the sport package with the 20" wheels, which really makes the truck look awesome. I get compliments on this truck all the time.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: This truck is awesome.  I think you need to get the 20's if you get anything.  Powerful, sharp looking and fun to drive.  I just got my first ticket so watch the speedometer.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I struggled with this purchase.  I owned a trouble free Toyota for years and wanted a bigger truck.  I heard the horror stories about certain Dodges.  After asking my mechanic and others I went for a test drive.  This has been a great vehicle - dependable, comfortable, fun, very nice.  I recommend it highly.  It has plenty of power, great comfort and good quality.  It is a beast in the snow - no problem at all.  It is well built and sharp looking too.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Is there anything else, other than Dodge?
Review: If your looking for a great all-a-round truck, can't beat the Dodge. Interior very roomy with plenty of storage. Have 4 kids, so I need lots of room. I've got the Hemi. It does get a little thirsty, but when you hit the pedal it takes off, even at 75(+). Have 35k miles in just 1yr with no problems. I will have to say it does have a vibration a little when I'm turning to the right after a stop. Feel it in the right front brake. I use Amsoil series 3000 synthetic motor oil. Great oil with less break down, which means less oil changes. Truck has plenty of torque for towing. Hate to get rid of this truck but have to go to the Dodge 3/4 with Cummins. Need the mileage since I drive over 35K(+) a year.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The Hemi engine is awesome!!! I traded in my 2001 silverdo 1500 ext cab 5.3 v8 for the Hemi, best decision I ever made. This is my first Dodge,and I love it. I was a Chevy owner for 11 years before the switch to Dodge, and look forward to owning many more Dodge's

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Lots of power, but lnterior lacks alot
Review: The power of the Hemi is great!  Unfortunately you pay in fuel economy.  The interior of the dodge Ram trucks are very boring with controls and features straight out of an 80's model vehicle.  It's time Dodge gave us a few toys to play with inside the vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: I put it to the test
Review: I purchased the truck with the intent of having an all around vehicle, but shortly after had to move 1300 miles. I bought a 32 foot enclosed trailer and made 5 trips from CT to FL in the span of two months towing cars, furniture and thousands of pounds of tools and equipment. The truck operated flawlessly. I wish I could say as much about the trailer! The only upgrade I made to it was installing a set of air bags for the rear suspention, worth every penny.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is the best looking truck on the road bar none. It is just plain fun to drive, and you do get alot of glances from other drivers.  The Hemi is awesome it is as advertised. The interior could be jazzed up a bit to match the way cool exterior.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is my third Dodge, truck, 2nd fullsize.  I really love this truck and the quality has improved every year. The interior is solid a quiet, all controls are easy to operate and don't feel cheesy. The paint and body are excellent.  The engine is the HEMI need I say more? Of course the fuel milage is poor, but I knew that when I decided to purchase this truck.  And this is a truck, make no mistake about it.  Itis big, commanding and will haul anything I have put in the bed or hook to the trailer hitch.  The only real down side I have found are poor rear wheel traction on wet surfaces (again it is the hemi) and I don't like the front end being so low on the 2x4 model. Level it out some Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab Laramie Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Very nice interior storage, especaillyunder middle seat in front, and underrear seats.  Excellent turning andhandling, but ride is much rougher thanthe 1996 Chevy CK1500 I drove for 115Kmiles. Delivered with non functioninghorn that drained the battery andrequired a tow at 300 miles.  DashboardGPS is basically worthless and nonintuitive, you'd be much better offbuying the Garmin portable GPS unit.Heated seats work great.

I was always a chevrolet man, my last truck that I just traded in on my new dodge ram was a silverado swb.  This new truck is awesome to say the least.  I wish I had switched to dodge sooner but better late than never.  I love my new truck.  I hadn't had it three hours when going out to my brothers house in the country, a deer ran into the driver door, so now I've got to put it in the shop to get my door fixed.  But it still looks great with a dent in the door.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Go easy for best MPG w/Hemi
Review: At 62 years old I drive easy (55 to 60mph)and have been able to get 21 to22.50 mpg (new truck) hwy. No jackrabbit starts and coast to stop. I havebeen GM most of my life but the Ram isthe most comfortable truck for(6'2"-240lbs)me.  The Ram offersexcellent access to engine compartmentand components like cleaning radiatorand condenser. All wiring is neatlyrouted and enclosed in plastic conduit.Excelent visibility.  Handling isaccurate.

Review_Title: Wheel fell off new 2004 Dodge Ram
Review: We purchased a new 2004 Doge Ram Quad Cab 4x4 in Sept. of this year.  With 400 kilometers on the truck, my husband headed off from Ontario Canada to Texas to pick up our son.  On the way back in Arkansas (Fort Smith) a wheel fell off the truck.  The axle, bearing, etc. was all destroyed.  The truck at this time had 3400 kilometers on it.  We had it repaired and my husband came back home with no problems.  We have written to Chrysler (weeks ago) and have heard nothing.  I guess they feel that this type of extreme failure is not worth their attention.  We have bought Chrysler products for the last 30 years and we will NEVER, EVER, buy another one.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab Laramie Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've had this truck for many years and have used it in deep snow, sand, and mud and nothing has stopped it. Mine is RWD only and it was pulling 4x4s out of sand and ditches no problem. My only complaints are the cheap looking interior and the bad mpg. Unless you need it as a daily driver for a long commute I'd definitely pick this any day. It's better looking than many other tucks in its time but is no slouch. Good for towing and hauling. Throw a dual exhaust on it and it sounds beautiful.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I love the Dodge style and ride but the 4.7 is a horrible motor. I have replaced 2 on my truck that only has 119,000 miles. After talking to techs at dealerships and looking online I see that Dodge, Jeep, Chrysler have had many problems with this motor. I will never make a purchase of any vehicle with this motor again.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The truck is a good truck dependable, nice looking, except it just barely reached 70,000 miles and just was told transmission needs to be rebuilt. Apparently this happens alot with Dodge trucks. The company that told me about the tranny has been in business 37 years and very reputable. Don't use truck for really anything than driving to and from work so it's not used often. To have tranny issues already is messed up. Other than that no other issues it's just the 1 issue is major and very expensive. Don't think I would be buying a Dodge again, unless the warranty holds up... checking on that now.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: My first dodge since my parents had a aspen. Bought it used with 23,000 now showing 56,000 and have no problems with the truck. I replacing the plugs after 20,000 and found it easy to do. Flushed all fluids and again it not expensive to do. Fit and finish is fine for a truck. Seats a little flat but do work and easy to keep clean. Plastic hard but easy to clean. Not a perfect truck but those thinking none American companies can do better they can not. Owned a toy and a kia and traded them for Ford and Dodge. Read owners manual and keep up on the maintenance and found that these truck are pretty good. Now thinking of replacing the Ford with a Charger. Most reviews are good.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab Laramie 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought the vehicle with 14000 miles on it.  I was stationed at Camp Lejeune, NC, and I took it home to Atlanta every holiday I could.  I beat the crap out of this truck, in the mud, WOT almost everywhere I went, music up all the way, in the mud, on the drag...er...highway, I was ROUGH on this thing.  I had very few problems.  The speaker on the driver door stopped working (probably my fault), and the tranny is starting to hesitate right after startup, but that goes away in 30 sec.  All in all, this truck has treated me very well.  It's never left me stuck, and though I still tromp on it (especially after adding CAI and exhaust) it is still very much alive and kicking after 114,000 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd LB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I bought the 3.7L Dodge well over a year ago and I couldn't be happier with it. It has a lot of pep on stock motor.  I added JBA headers, high flow cats, true dual flowmaster mufflers, K&N cold air intake, and a JET computer chip. The power, MPGs, and torque that it added was unreal! There is no way I will ever sell this truck. If you are looking at buying one, SERIOUSLY seriously consider buying this truck! You wont be disappointed, even with all stock parts, I promise.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I love this truck, just bought it a month ago and have already put 5000 miles on it, it rides great other than the seats that have no lumbar support. It has a gas sipping v-6 which by no means is slow, in fact I have outrun a 5.3 liter Chevy with it... And no one believes me. Oh well! It made a two hour drive to Austin and from there a 12 hour drive to Nashville! Not a problem whatsoever! It has the best air conditioner of any vehicle I have ever owned let alone been inside and this is vehicle number 11 for me! I cant think of much more about this truck because its a base model and didn't come with much, the only problem is during extreme rain it leaks under the dash a bit but I have vinyl floors

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: Bought the truck with the 5.7L Hemi and gas mileage is great. Getting between 18.5 and 19.9 miles per gallon highway driving between 60-65 mph. Climb any hill with ease and power to spare. With 55000 miles on the original tires I still have substantial tread wear remaining on the original tires, never had a vehicle with this attribute including Toyotas and Ford pickup trucks

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)

Who cares about gas mileage when you love to hammer down. I don't really have to drive far to go to work but I sure do like driving to work more than I used to.Only 22000 miles put on by the first owner he also added duel exhaust and flowmaster. Truck is like new. I traded in a 1999 ford f150 5.4 liter that was a real clean truck but the 5.4 cant hold a candle to this Hemi. I heard a 5.3 cDhevy getting down on it the other day, he sounded good but was going nowhere fast. Anyway it drives like a car, rides good, even though its 4x4

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)

Review: After leaving Lowe's one day without the ladder I needed, I decided I had to have a truck.  Traded in my baby would- be-paid-off-in-a-month Grand Prix for a Silver Hemi Ram. Everything I could ever want in a truck, and more. After hauling 3 things 4 miles in 2 months, and dropping twice as much on gas, I came to the frightening realization that I had made a mistake.  I don't NEED a truck.  Unfortunately, neither does anyone else, so I'm stuck and more upside down than a cake.  Don't get me wrong, the truck is hot and fun (in a straight line), but I feel trapped.

Review: I've had this truck for 8 months, and I've enjoyed her. I've added a CD player and subwoofer, having a camper top (bought her with it) helped when moving home at end of college year.  I'm a big guy (6'2") and I fit perfectly in the driver seat, the white faced gauges are easy to see/read. The lack of shelving behind the seats were a dissappointment, so i built some of my own. The 4.7L at times seems underpowered but gets the job done satisfactorally. All and all, she is a great truck.

For example, somebody cut me off hard on the interstate one day and I was able to brake/swerve to avoid an accident with little difficulty.  Very pleased with the vehicle.  Very drivable vehicle.

I also like the agressive exterior looks. The Ram just looks mean. Besides the good looks, what really sold me was the power of the HEMI engine and the way the Ram handles. For such a big truck this thing can is quite nimble and it also has great breaking ability.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Absolutely fell in love with this truck after test driving it. The 5.7L HEMI engine meets and exceeds all of the hype created by the dodge commercials. I was actually in the market for the 4.7L engine, which has more than ample power, but after comparing it to the HEMI found that there was no comparison. What is interesting is that the HEMI produces over 100 more horse power but only loses ~1mpg in fuel efficiency.  Besides the engine, another thing that really impresses me about the Ram is the way it handles. I was very surprised at the way such a big truck can move and handle. Overall, everything about this truck has thus far exceeded my expectations

Ford, GMC, and Chevy cannot keep up with my Dodge.  I test drove all 4 U.S. Mfg. trucks, and it came down to the Dodge Ram and Ford F-150.  The Ram's HEMI engine simply outperformed the F-150's 5.4L Triton engine.  I also liked the Rams exterior appearance much better than the F-150's.  The only thing that kept Ford in the running was it's interior features.  But in the end, the Ram's features outshined the competition.  This is one great truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is not for any beginner driver.  It will tear up the asphalt quicker than you can shift the gears.  The steering takes some getting used to.  It is very tight, and will go where you move it.  The brake dust is a bummer on it.  They work like a charm, but if you like a clean look, expect to have some towels to wipe them down when you stop.  The black is very hard to keep clean. It looks nice, but it is high maintenance.  Get a red or silver if you can.  Wear your seat belt in this thing.  It will throw you all over the cab if you don't. The gas mileage is not bad for a truck.  I have gotten as little as 4, and as good as 17.  I had a lead foot the first tank.

Review: I love this truck.  I wish it was a little lower and the subwoofer had a little more thump.  I get 15.7 mpg between city and highway.  I got 16.7 mpg on the road before I did two modifications to the truck. What truck do you know that they give you mileage figures of 9mpg and 11 mpg, and I got much more then that.  I had two new Chevys, and they were both wrong.  I got much less then what they told me they would get. I get between 18mpg and 21 mpg on the road with the two modifications that I did.  This is a 10 cylinder with 500 horses.  I love the torque.  It looks great.

Vehicle_Title: 2004 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: The new dodge srt-10 is what i think is what makes a real truck lover go crazy. This is what it is all about a viper engine in a truck making 500 hourespower. What more could you want? But i do have to say the gas mileage is a little low but hey if you can afford a 45 thousand dollar truck who needs to wory about the fuel economy. The handling is great and preformance is a great thrill to have. Who needs to go to the amusment park when you have a dodge srt-10, i sure dont. This is the badest truck ever.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my Ram 1500 April 25, 2015 in California (I now moved back to Oklahoma). I currently have 172,000 miles on my Ram 1500 and I bought it when it had 97k miles on it. I can honestly say I really do love this truck. I own a junk removal business and I use a 12 ft long trailer and you can imagine that I haul a lot of stuff with my truck. When I was answering the reviews about this truck I couldn't think of much to give it bad reviews on. I think the only thing that bothers me about this truck is the headlights, because they hardly light up the road at night. The other negative about this truck is the navigation kind of stinks. Now for the repairs, I have had to do 3 repairs to this truck. I had 1 fuse replaced, A couple of solenoids in the transmission needed to be replaced at 150k miles, and the camshaft wore out around 150k. Other than that it has been an amazing truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: purchased this vehicle and i have replaced coil packs, injectors, cam on the left side 4 lifters, and will probably be replacing lifters and a cam on the right.  do not like that the mirror leds cannot be diy replacement, and the dealership is so freaking expensive 200 hour

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: No problems in 120000 miles.  Decent gas mileage.  Comfortable interior

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: After testing all (and I mean ALL) other pickups in this class I chose Ram without hesitating. It offers everything I wanted and fit the bill perfectly. I put close to 3K miles on it on a X-country trip this summer and averaged 22MPG on the hwy and 16.5 in the city for 19.1 overall. It also will easily accommodate the 6K pound travel trailer I intend to purchase in the next year or two. Dollar-for-dollar it is the best choice available.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I'm not going into details because many other have already done so. However this is an awesome truck. I'm continually impressed by it performance and ride quality. I bought mine at the Dodge Big Event year end close-out, so I got a great deal.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Best truck I have ever owned
Review: This is truly Dodge's best truck they have ever made. It had a very "solid" feel to it when driving. Hemi power is a must, you won't regret it. I like the quad cab because it is cheaper, only downfall is the seats are not as comfortable as the crew cab seats.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Purchased a 2010 Ram.Started rattling at 6k miles.From New the gas door dosen't close.Put it into 4wd for the first time today to go over 6 inches of soft snow and now the truck has a wobble in 2wd.Never had this in driving my Tahoe for ten years.Have been driving American cars since 1976.I guess its time to rethink that.All that money 42k...wasn't worth it.been driving American cars since 1976.That will end. close

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Good But Not the Greatest Ram I've Owned
Review: This is my 2nd Ram. I had a 2008 4x4 Regular Cab Sport that was a great truck. I saw this 2010 Quad Cab in Blue (online) and gave it a look-see. The power was even better than the 2008. I did well on the trade (the Red 2008 was in perfect condition) so I took it home. I started noticing the body creak/rattle almost immediately. Everything else is great-features, colors, interior fit and finish-just that creak. I go next week for a 3000 mile service (yes, the manual says 6000) so we'll see if they can correct my problem. More to come (good news-I hope)

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My first RAM purchase was in 1995 and I drove that truck for about two-years and then went to Jeep products. I LOVE this truck - it looks AWESOME, the ride is incredible, the interior is well-appointed and the bed has plenty of room. I have had a small issue with an under hood cap, but all in all no issues to report. Oh, with the HEMI and factory dual exhaust - it launches like a rocket and sounds/performs better than any other truck on the road...period. I have went up against or drove all of the Domestic and Foreign trucks and the Dodge RAM is hands down a better value, best ride and performance is second to none.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I was recently in a car accident and on the market for a new vehicle. I used to drive a Nissan pick up and loved it. I wanted something larger and have owned a Durango years ago and never had any problems with it. I rented the 2010 Dodge Ram 1500 Quad cab just to check it out. My dog weights 166 pounds and needed a truck anyway to get him to his vet appointment. I loved this truck so much I bought it a week later. It handles great It's a smooth ride and has plenty of room for our three kids. We can't wait to take the truck to Mt. Hood and play in the snow!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have bought Jeep / Dodge Trucks since 93 and loved em all but this truck is truly the first major purchase I have ever made without any buyers remorse at all. I love it. Had a couple recalls already but they have been precautionary checks only as I have not experienced any problems at all. It pulls my 67 olds down the road on the trailer like it is not even there.  This truck solidified my loyalty to Dodge. I drove the GMC with the 5.3 liter and was not impressed at all (I even qualified for the GMS pricing).

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Upgraded from 2009 to 2010 SLT Bighorn pkg with 5.7 hemi.  2300 miles and there is a distinct accelerator related, very irritating whistle or whine at around 60 mph.  Took it back to dealer, Folsom Lake Dodge, and typical response said nothing could be done because this is normal with the hemi.  Did not do it with the 2009 hemi.  Do not know whether to believe them or not.  This is my 4th dodge pick up, and the first not totally happy with.  Seems like this should be a correctable problem if they would only acknowledge.  Help.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Had a Dodge many years ago and it was not a dependable car. I was not going to look at Dodge Ram trucks although I love the way they looked. Then I was swayed by the huge discounts and boy am I happy I did. This is a well made vehicle and is super comfortable. I had a Chevy truck years ago and really enjoyed it until the transmission dropped out of it after 65,000 miles. I have missed a truck so I am happy I went with one and very happy I went with a Dodge Ram!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Our truck has the 5.7 Hemi. The MDS system took some getting used to, especially in town. The power is impressive and the available storage is nice.  The ride is very comfortable.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Two years ago I sold my '04 Porsche Cayenne S with 340hp.  As time went by I needed my fix.  When Dodge advertised it's purchase incentive program, I test drove a fully loaded 390 hp Laramie. What a treat. I was sold. Great vehicle and saved $50K in comparison to a new Cayenne.  Can't wait for the snow to arrive.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased this truck 3 days ago and have already had to return to the dealer to get a it fixed. I would caution anyone from buying one of these. Check the Dodge Forum about the death shake steering wheel problem at 60-70 MPH and also 40-45 MPH if you start off like this, it could be ugly.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Best truck ever owned, and in 40 years that's saying a lot, drove them all, hope to retire with this truck. People who I don't know walk up and comment on the beauty of this beast. If you need to pass another vehicle hold on it's like riding in a rocket. Move over vets there's a new King of the road. If you don't believe me try one, puts fun back in driving. This truck owns the road, Chevy and fords and the over rated tundra can't even stay in the beasts shadow. I'm elated.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Being a former Chevy pickup guy my last truck was a Nissan Titan. Let me tell you here, Dodge has really gotten it right with this truck. I did a lot of research on this truck and when it came time I special ordered to get certain options. Backup camera, sprayed in liner, Brake Control, Inferno Red Crystal Pearlcoat, Tow Hitch, Chrome Accents Group, Leather Bucket Seats & Trailer Tow Mirrors. The ride with the coils springs is by far the best in any truck I have had. I have to admit, I love driving this truck, from the quick acceleration on launch to just cruising. In my opinion Dodge has really exceeded my expectations.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I traded in my 2002 ram quad 2wd for the 2010 quad 4wd trx4 in deep water blue. First thing the ride is like no other. I took a real good look at the tundra, but it's made cheap. The sheet metal is thin. I got the 4.7 cause of the flex fuel and 87 octane. I don't tow heavy loads, but if you do please go hemi. If you are thinking of buying a truck, go test drive them all and I bet you will buy the ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I drove them all and much to my surprise the Ram came out on top. The F150s are slow, noisy and thirsty, the GMs just aren't put together as well as the Ram and have a terrible interior. Won't ever go back to Tundra! This is the best riding & best performing truck I found. Towed 5600 lbs. so far, handles like a dream. Lots of power! The engine & tranny are super quiet & smooth. Very smart looking & quiet interior. Doors close solid & all hardware seems a notch above others. Impeccable assembly quality. Handles great with the 20-inch tires. Excellent braking, even with a load. Best gas MPG so far was 21.4 MPG. Local average 17+. Total average is 17.9. Never liked a truck so much!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I was towing with a 2004 Jeep GC with the 235 horse/ 295 ft lbs  4.7.  I had a chance to move up to the Dodge truck as a more stable towing platform.  I didn't NEED the hemi so I opted for the 310 horse / 330 ft lbs  4.7  ( big difference).  I did get the 3.92 anti-spin rear and the full towing package.  It is rated to tow 7300 lbs. I got 15 mpg around town and as of yet haven't had a chance to drive it solo on the highway.  I got 10-11 while towing my 28 ft trailer.  I should be able to knock off 20 mpg on the highway as it is taching 1800 rpm @ 60 mph. I towed in 4th gear pulling 2500 rpm at 61 mph.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've had my 2010 Dodge Ram Laramie for about six months now and am glad to say that I'm as excited today about driving it everyday as I was the first day I bought it.  It is loaded with every option to include satelite tv, dvd system, alpine stereo system, leather seats, heated seats and steering wheel, a/c seats...the works.  It has an aggressive exterior look and the interior luxury of much higher priced luxury vehicle.  No complaints!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I traded my 2008 Bighorn 4.7 for my new 2010 Bighorn Hemi.  Man what a difference!!!  Only one word comes to mind to discribe the 2010; WOW!  Totally different from the 2008.  The comfort and drive can compare easily with any of the 13 Lincolns I have owned over the years.  The touch- screen is too cool. 30 Gig harddrive.   I can record 6700 songs.  I have been copying my CD's.  I have 8 so far on my Playlist.  The quality of the sound system is the best I have heard in any vehicle. Not to mention the 390 hp Hemi.  Beautiful truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I went to Dodge looking to trade my 04 Chevy S-10 and left with an amazing vehicle that I am amazed with every time I drive it. I love the color (Mango Tango Orange) and the big horn package (with all the chrome and the 20" wheels). I get great mileage driving in the city and get lots of comments about the look and the color. Dodge did a great job making this truck. You can tell a big difference from a 09 to an 10. Love the dual exhaust and the eco feature and the gear selection (gets even better mileage putting it in 4th gear).

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have only had my truck less than a week and I love everything about this truck. I traded in my 1998 ram that had 250000 miles on it. So if anyone says Dodge trucks aren't dependable long lasting trucks they are wrong. The gas mileage on the truck is awesome for having 390 horses under the hood. Right now I am getting just under 19 miles per gallon. I would recommend this truck to anyone that is looking to purchase a new truck. I test drove Chevy, Toyota, Ford and Nissan and none of them compare to this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I replaced a 2001 Dodge Ram 1500 4x4 ext. cab. with a small V8 and manual trans.  WOW, what an upgrade to this truck!  The HEMI (love the eco mode where it shifts down to 4 cyl. on the highway - don't even feel it!).  I actually like the look of the 2001 a bit better but, the interior on the 2010 is awesome!  Extremely comfortable, user friendly, great back seat storage with the flat floor with all controls having a nice feel to them.  The tranny shifts nice and smooth too.  So far, we are averaging 14.9 mpg in / out of town.  I feel on a long trip, it will be as the sticker says...18 mpg which is fine with me given the size / comfort of this truck.  The information center is great too!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Hold on to your hat, the Hemi rocks!!
Review: I researched, tested, and worked the deal on all of the full size 1500 series trucks. My need for 4 wheel drive was not there, and had to look hard and long for a 2 WD. Finally found one with the right equipment, plus a Hemi. My initial requirement pointed to the 4.7 liter, but when the 5.7 upgrade was free, the decision was to upgrade. All of the dealers in my search (and there were more that 10) were very professional, but Dodge of Blaine had the edge on professionalism. When I arrived to take a test drive, I was greeted enthusiastically, and that set the pace throughout the entire transaction. My words of wisdom are to do a lot of homework, study for the big test, and execute wisely.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I hope the "new" electronic vehicle display (EVD)on the dash saved money for Chrysler.  Unfortunately, its misery for users.  Just try to read the odometer if you're not an electrical engineer.  NOT intuitive.  Further the users manual is thin, BUT heh - they supply a DVD (that's always useful when you're driving or broke down on the highway).  The manual refers to the DVD and the DVD refers to the owners manual.  Not good for customers.  NOT recommended.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought an 09 Ram with the 4.7 V-8.  This truck had difficulty pulling an 18 ft. travel trailer in Colorado.  It would run for miles over 4K rpm to maintain 60 mph on I-25.  Traded the 09 for an identical 10 with a Hemi.  No trouble pulling a 20 foot travel trailer or a flatbed with a Jeep and 4 wheeler.  Lots of power.  Gas mileage is slightly less with the Hemi, about 15 city and 17 highway vs. 15 city and 18 highway for the 4.7.  A trip from Oklahoma to North Carolina averaged 16.8 mpg at 75 mph.  Drove into the wind both ways.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Just purchased, so far love it. Came out of a 2007 Toyota tundra (great truck). Shortcomings so far are head light brightness and transmission. Bought brighter (whiter) bulbs-no big deal. Can't get used to transmission (compared to tundra). Tundra has 6 speed trans with great gear ratio, - Dodge has 5 speed and 2nd and 3rd gear only have 300 rpm diff between them. Can barely tell diff between them when manually shifting. Can anybody give insight? Why would ratios be so close?

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Interior features are more refined and updated. All knobs and radio flush against dashboard. Two tone color interior makes my ram feel luxurious. More cup holders, bigger mirrors, 1 yr sat. Radio. Get the big horn package-20" rims, billet grill, and warning signals. I did't need the hemi 390 hp. I only use my Ram for driving to work or the hardware store. Since I bought it, my wife has driven it more than me,so be careful,if you have a mate, they're going to drive it. I own a Dodge 01w/ 150,000 mi no problems. I decided to buy this Ram because of my previous experience with my last Ram. Don't be fooled by other brands, this Ram 2010 is powerful than ever 310hp/good looks.Drive 1 & test it against other

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Very pleased with this truck. The company may have had past troubles, but it doesn't show up in their product. Right as rain.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is the smoothest truck i have ever driven. The power is excellent and the value for your money beats almost any truck on the market.  Test drove pretty much every truck on the market before i bought the ram. Best power, interior, options for the money.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Bought this truck used with low miles,and i must say it is so far my favorite. I've had toyotas, chevy's and other dodges, but this one takes the cake by far. If your on the fence about what truck to buy this year, dont let this one go to the way side, I almost did and am very glad i didnt.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I never should have traded my silverado in on this piece of crap! I will NEVER own another piece of garbage chrysler EVER again! Total garbage!!!!!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 4A)
Review: I got the 3.7 liter V6 in my regular cab short bed 1500 ST. I thought I might be making a mistake not getting a V8. I read a few reviews that said the V6 was underpowered. I was pleasantly surprised with the acceleration and highway cruising of the V6. I use the truck for general property maintenance like bringing loads of brush to the dump and for personal transportation. But if you haul big loads or pull a heavy trailer you definitely want the V8. The short bed makes it easy to park but is still big enough for my needs. I can lower the tailgate carry a sheet of plywood when I have to. Only time will tell how reliable this truck will be, but so far I have been completely satisfied.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had zero problems with this lovely beast. I purchased it used last June & I have driven over 20k miles. I have been a Ford man my whole life, but this Ram won me over! I will give you the things I would improve upon first, then more of the good. First off,  this is a truck, so it rides rougher than a car & if you are not a truck person, you might not want this truck. I find the steering to be weak in comparison to the F-150. This beast feels amazing going in a straight line, buts lots of body roll on turns. Next, the back seats are just about 2 steps above bleacher seats, lol. Even my 2 little ones want to sit on pillows. Also, the a/c does not really cool the back off that well. Front seats are amazing though. I am about average height 5'9", but I am a brickwall & the bucket seats are wide enough to feel comfortable! Dodge made the center console a shiny silver paint with chrome trim rings. This was asinine! I am going blind during the day! The rest of the console is amazing though. Several charger ports, 2 glove boxes, 2 consoles cubbies. Matter of fact, Dodge did a good job with storage period! Great storage area under the rear seats & 2 storage areas in the rear floorboard area. The brakes are spongey, had the brake fluid flushed & refilled, which helped a tad. When it comes to power though, this truck does NOT disappoint! The 5.7L Hemi can pretend to be meek & mild while cruising, but the moment you give it full throttle, it wakes up and attacks the highway! I have noticed I average about 13-14.5 mpg in town, but I also like hearing the motor, so I get a bit heavy on the throttle sometimes. On the highway, I have seen 22-23 mpg, if I set the cruise at 60 mph, but at 75 mph, she still gets approximately 19 mpg. My wishlist would be for improved handling, better brakes, better rear seats, stronger blower for the rear a/c, & a system like Ford builds into their tailgate for climbing into the bed.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: STAY AWAY FROM RAM AND FCA
Review: Owner has now attempted 3 separate CDJR MOPAR Service Dealers regarding uneven vehicle/frame concerns and/or rear axle concerns.  The first service attempt was with selling dealer Thompson’s CDJR Placerville the following day after vehicle purchase.  Owner reported concern with vehicle lean at driver’s front and significant vehicle vibration at highway speeds.  Owner did not test drive vehicle on highway prior to purchase.  Owner was scheduled for MOPAR service 3 days after purchase.  While waiting for service appointment, owner took vehicle to America’s tire in Roseville.  The factory tires were identified to be out-of-round.  Owner replaced factory tires with new tires at owner expense.  This drastically reduced the vehicle vibration, but not entirely.  When owner serviced vehicle at Thompson’s CDJR, owner updated Service Advisor of tire replacement.  The service obtained at Thompson’s CDJR resulted with no work performed and reported vehicle was within factory specs.  Service focus was suspension related, mainly control arm distance to ground comparison from left to right control arms.  This service department did not assess or inspect the vehicle frame.  Service Advisor at Thompson’s appeared disinterested and bothered by owner concern about new vehicle.  The second service attempt was with Folsom Lake CDJR.  Owner notified Service Advisor of service at Thompson’s and offered to provide the service report from Thompson’s.  This service department resulted in no work preformed and report vehicle was within factory specs.  Service focus was, again, solely on vehicle suspension. To their credit, they appeared to assess suspension components more thoroughly than Thompson’s. This service department did not assess or inspect the vehicle frame. Frustrated with no resolve from MOPAR service, continued vehicle safety issues, and new safety issues arising each day, owner privately scheduled Shark Blackhawk Computerized Vehicle Measurement System laser frame inspection from MOPAR certified techs at Gamboa’s Body and Frame of Rancho Cordova, CA.  Gamboa’s Body and Frame in Rancho Cordova is a MOPAR Factory Certified Body and Frame repair location.  Shark Blackhawk Computerized Vehicle Measurement System evidenced multiple areas of vehicle frame were out of factory specs.  The report findings indicate 8 frame areas outside of factory specs for RAM 1500 Pickup Crew Cab 5.5’ Bed 4WD 2013-2016.  5 out of spec frame measurements are weld-on permanent frame locations.  3 remaining out of spec frame measurements are located at left and right lower control arm bolt locations.  These 3 bolt locations are drilled into vehicle frame cross rails which are welded to main frame exterior.          When owner requested bid from Gamboa’s Body and Frame Service Advisor in order to assess cost to resolve frame specs, owner was instructed Gamboa’s was unable to correct vehicle frame to factory specs.At this time, owner was working with FCA Case Manager Greg, who indicated FCA would reimburse owner for frame inspection and rental car costs.  Owner submitted frame inspection report and owner payment invoices for services listed.     Owners third attempt, and third dealer location, for CDJR MOPAR service was with AutoNation Roseville CDJR.  This service appointment was at the direction of FCA Case Manger Greg and reported to be the next step following the Shark Blackhawk Computerized Vehicle Measurement System frame results.  Owner scheduled service and documented initial frame concerns, new safety concerns related to rear axle and differential, and additional issues with vehicle (see attached).  Owner provided AutoNation service department with copy of Shark Blackhawk Computerized Vehicle Measurement System laser frame report findings.  Upon owners third attempt at MOPAR dealer service, Service Manager Brian Morrow and Service Advisor Greg Stebbins of AutoNation CDJR Roseville assessed MOPAR service unable to resolve documented frame related issues.  Service Manager Brain Morrow contacted FCA Case Manager Jennifer at 1-800-763-8422 ext 40381 to report his vehicle service assessment.  To date, owner has no resolve and is unable to operate vehicle safely.  This vehicle is owner’s primary transportation and is used for driving owners 4 and 5-year-old children.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Was a For man, now I'm a Dodge man!
Review: I absolutely love my Ram 1500. I use to be a Ford man, but after my f150 started falling apart on me, I decided to upgrade. This truck is amazing and I am convinced I have the best truck out there. It has plenty of power, it rides smooth, interior is awesome, exterior is even better.. I literally have no complaints about this truck. It is definitely worth every penny!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Loved this truck at first, then I started noticing a lot of annoying issues and outright problems. The users manual says it goes 6,500 miles between oil changes. I got an alert to change the oil at 3,000 miles and another at 6,000 (haven't done that yet -- got 6,800 miles on the truck and I'll get to it when I get to it). Air sensor is hypersensitive and goes off frequently -- takea a couple of days after filling up tires for the sensor to go off. Also, the stock Goodyears are garbage. Oh, and the thing now pulls to the left after (yes) 6,800 miles and sticking solely to blacktop. Dodge got my money and I got suckered. Gas mileage is far worse than estimated, too. Horrible purchase.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Initially, the Ram was not even on my option list.But after driving F150 and Silverado, I decided to test drive one on a whim.I could not have been more surprised by what I experienced.This truck is so far superior, I can't believe it - and at first, I didn't want to believe it.If you are in the market, drive them all and you'll see for yourself - Dodge has grabbed the truck market by the horns.I am completely converted!
