Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Chrysler may still have a lot of work to do, but I think they're headed in the right direction with the Dodge Ram 1500. The 3 points that guided my decision in purchasing the Dodge Ram instead of the Ford and Chevy trucks were value, power, and design. The price of the Ram was way below Ford/Chevy. The power of Rams 390 hp Hemi with 407 lbs of torque humbles anything Ford/Chevy has to offer.   Interior fit and finish of the Ram is good and the outstanding exterior design attracts jealous looks from Ford/Chevy truck owners. And with the rear coil spring suspension the Ram soaks up bumps without bucking you like a mechanical bull. This truck is a winner, even Truck of the Year in my book.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Just bought a 2010 Dodge Ram 1500 Crew Cab 4x4 with the Big Horn package and SLT with the 5.7 V8 last week.   It is the Light Sandstone and I get so many comments about how it changes colors depending upon the light, etc.  The features are top notch and it rides/performs like no other truck on the market.  Right now is the best time to buy the remaining 2010s (the 2011 are unchanged basically)!  I was able to buy my $41K sticker truck for $31K!  ($5,500 dealer discount, $3,500 cash back, and $1,000 Ally financial offer)

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I like everything in this truck. You don't feel moving at 70 mph. Lots of power on this truck. Should get all the options.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The ride is the smoothest of any truck I tested.  Performance is strong and responsive.  The fuel mileage has been better than the EPA rating as well.  This is a vehicle that each time I drive it I find more to like about it.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: The Best Truck Work Or Play!
Review: I got to tell you, for someone who said he would never drive any thing but a Chevy, the Dodge Ram 1500 made a liar out of me quick I got the crew cab. This is the best looking best driving best riding truck that I've ever owned. My wife is not very big on any truck, but she love the outside and inside of my Ram 1500. I'm a big fan of 5.7 Hemi and, yes it's a little tough on gas; but you right feeding 390 horses, right? Dodge did a great job with putting a lot of storage space in this truck.  It's just a great truck if you're working it are painting the town on a Saturday night! To the men and women over there at Dodge keep doing what you are doing because this truck is a 10 across the board

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I traded in my 2006 Toyota 4Runner V8 Sport 4x4 on this beast. I don't regret it one bit and I LOVED my 4Runner. This truck rides almost car like. I say almost cause it is still a truck. Hemi sounds good and is very strong. Plenty of power for this big truck. This is the first vehicle I have purchased that has a learning curve with all the options. My only negatives are 1. paint quality is poor compared to my Toyota. Orange peel, fish eyes and over spray. I had to buff the entire truck to get it to look decent. Also, no side steps making it hard to enter and exit. At 46k this thing should come with side steps standard.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck, not so great on gas though, but you should be aware of this prior to purchase. Ride comfort is excellent, not bouncy through the turns. Hemi 5.7 is plenty of power and tows anything without a problem. The dual exhaust in the rear bumper gives the truck a great way to tell between a hemi and others.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I cant say enough about how much I enjoy driving this truck.  I was in the market for a Silverado when I sat in the Dodge and was truly impressed with the comfort and spaciousness of the crew cab.  If you want a similarly appointed Chevy, you should be prepared to spend about ten grand more.  Once I drove it, I was sold.  The 5.7 has tons of power and the coil spring rear suspension keep the truck firmly planted over the bumpiest roads.  I needed a car that could do it all comfortably, and this is it.  Theres plenty of room to stretch out, enough room in the SB to stow the gear, and plenty of towing capacity for whatever you have to pull.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have a 2004 ram 4.7, still have it with 60,000 miles on it, never had a thing wrong with it. 2010 very strong motor, quality is good but not perfect, few things the window rattles a little going down, few plastic pieces in motor, cheap, cover for battery etc, just looks like its going to snap off, the ride and handling is excellent, the features are great, as the hands free phone is my favorite, and the computer in front of you easy to read, all ready had a few people roll down Windows and say nice truck. This is a hemi motor, I expect it will last as long as I want to own this truck, nothing beats a hemi, also love the new look in the front, looks mean like a truck should. 5 star truck :

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Mine is a 2010 Ram 1500 Bighorn with the 5.7 hemi - 3.55 gears - 4x4 - bucket seats and console shift auto. I have owned it for 4 months+ and I Love It! I pull a 20' loaded car trailer quite often and it does it with ease! Great power and torque! Excellent brakes and trailer towing capabilities. Super interior, the layout is excellent and it has good controls (not those annoying electronic controls that some of the competing trucks have) you know the ones that you can't see when the sun is shining in! The controls have man sized knobs that are easy to use.  Very well thought out and laid out interior. Exterior styling is awesome.  I test drove other trucks and bought a Ram. Best decision yet

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: All Around its a Decent Truck. Undoubtedly has the best highway ride out of the bunch. Cummins diesel sounds good.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This vehicle really turns heads  no, really. I never thought my personality would change while driving ANY vehicle but I have to admit, I feel like Im on top of the world when Im driving this truck.  Out of all the vehicles Ive driven/had this one I cant wait until I drive again.  And with the 5.7 Hemi well, when you press the gas pedal  youre going places.  The crew cab option is very much worth its cost, as you have plenty of room both up front and in back to spread out and relax.  I like the little extra storage compartments, cubbyholes, and drink holders.  And although the transfer case isnt a new idea, I like its simplicity so my wife can operate the 4x4 when needed.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Traded a Ford Escape which I hated for this truck.  Ride is smoother and quieter than most cars I have been and I love the sound and power of the Hemi engine when you punch it.  Build quality is good with a well laid out dashboard. My only complaint is the seats are narrow and can be uncomfortable.  Overall, love the truck and a seat cushion will remedy the narrow seat issue.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The engineers at Dodge have finally gotten it right. Although I was lucky enough to find this truck with just about every option included, in my opinion the suspension changes and exterior design make this the finest Dodge to date by far. (I have to admit, the extras are pretty nice too.) I absolutely love driving this truck. From the smooth,comfortable, extremely quiet ride, to the surprisingly quick  acceleration, my new Dodge has far exceeded my expectations. Fabulous truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned 14 full size pickups. Ford, Chev, and the even all plastic Tundra. I have never enjoyed driving any vehicle as much as this Dodge truck! Even my BMW stays parked. My avg economy is 18 MPG and I have a heavy right foot. I LOVE THIS TRUCK!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Since the first of 5 test drives and a lot of research this truck has been my favorite. The interior quiet, the smooth ride and car like turning, the Nice sounding Hemi, the amazing sound system, Easy to use Nav, Sirius radio, and the amazing Blue color. All of it was a perfect pick. I was going from a 92 Ford Exploder (yes I know its an explorer) and after driving this I will never drive another Ford again. Toyota and Chevy were a nice second choice but I wanted the features that Dodge offered. Worth the wait for the custom order. My wife loves her new toy and hates it when I borrow it hehe.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Hemi has the power, the truck handles like a car, and the cab has enough room for everybody and their gear.  Test drove FORD and Chevy first but loved the feel of the Dodge.  Price was way lower than both Ford and Chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have the Big Horn Package obviously. 5.7, Nav. w/Camera,iPod, 4x4, 20's and 60/40 cloth. I am amazed at how long the stigma of Dodge's quality has kept me from buying one. 28 years to be exact. This my 4th pickup so, I'm kind of a newbe in this arena. But, from what I can tell after 4600 mile's. This truck is extremely well thought out and put together. If this is Chryslers swan song, than it's going platinum. IT IS the best looking truck on the road, bar none. The only other drive train that beats it, is the 6.2 mated to GM's 6 speed. So far, I have absolutely no buyers remorse. Especially after paying $31K and change. Oh, I am averging 17.3 MPG's combined even working in D.C.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I special ordered my twd slt 1500ram with the5.7 hemi bucket seats got what i wanted and have not regretted since i got the truck the ride and handling is second to none the build quality is excellent any looking for anew truck should look at the new ram1500.I look forward to driving it every day it is such a pleasure to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love the interior and design, ride height on the 20" wheels, dual exhaust, and especially the 390 HP and torque of the Hemi motor. Unbelievable rear leg room and space with the crew cab. Storage spaces everywhere. Never thought I'd buy a Dodge, but you can't beat the package and price. Cant wait to go to work.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I don't have Laramie but there's no 5.7 SLT Big Horn catagory here.  Beautiful, a performer! Not gonna pass a gas station..I had the 4.7 for two weeks and I don't know how they really rate power, I can't reccomend that ST, it just doesn't perform well. Mango Tango wears off too and then your left with an neutered slightly clumsy looking orange truck..If you can do it, go for a little more, because when you wake up in the next day you don't want to look at a half good machine and think for a few bucks more I coulda had a ride I can be proud of.  You don't even save anything on mileage so go big or go home on this one

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Had a Tundra and traded in for the Ram, this truck is head and shoulders above the rest. Best truck I ever owned!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: If you can over look the price tag, this truck is more than you could have asked for. Like every truck complaint i wish it had better fuel economy but once you get over that, you wouldn't want to trade this truck in for anything.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Previously owned 07 Dodge Mega Cab - best truck ever!  2010 Ram Crew Cab is a far cry from the 07.  Serious amounts of rust on all exterior surfaces, especially front bumper after only a few hundred miles (currently have 2100).  Transmission shifts HARD when hitting the throttle to pass. Drives and handles more like a smaller SUV - this is not a truck for true truck lovers and is definitely an inferior truck to previous Dodge model years.  Make sure you take time to look at all trucks before buying a new Dodge 1500.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my third Dodge Ram, the most expensive and the largest.  It is also my favorite.  Just love it.  I did all my research before trading in a much loved 2007 Ram - Quad Cab - and don't regret my decision.  The truck is a real head turner that happens to drive/ride as well as it looks.  The Hemi is, well a Hemi, and very potent.  If you've been looking for a great truck, look no further.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab ST 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Nice looking truck but look closer, have defects in the paint in 3 or more areas, CD gets stuck in player,came with driver seat mirror blurr, all tires and rims had to be replaced after 3 days of driving and last but worse of all hood made of very light material when driving 65 plus looks like going to come of hinges.Do one thing before buying do your home work on all trucks and compare quality. Looking to see if Dodge is going to make good on all items

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck truly disserves all the top ratings!  My Ram is a 10 out of 10!! The guys at Dodge really exceeded my expectations here.  When I think of trucks I think of performance and though I didn't step up to the big dog Hemi, I am still getting 310 HP from my 4.7L.  It has the power to haul what I need and the speed and agility to cruise on the highway.  It all comes together once I hop into the cab though. The very best thing about this Ram...  the rear suspension.  The payload on this truck is at or better than GM, Ford and of course Toyota, and yet the ride is 10x smoother.  It's not typical to describe a truck with words like comfort and control, but the Ram is clearly tops!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: What a Ride! A Charger on Steroids!
Review: Purchased last day of the year '09, took immediate delivery. All it took was a test drive. The forward look of the grille, the power of the 390HP Hemi, and the 20" wheels...This thing rides like a dreadm, handles the corners great, and steers with one finger. It's like driving a car on steroids!

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: 5k miles in and still love it
Review: Traded a Dodge Dakota for new Big Horn edition Crew Cab 1500 4WD.  Has 5.7L V8. Drives really well.  Better than others that I looked at.  Toyota was 2nd choice.  Really comfortable and quiet down the road.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The only truck in its class that truly, finally accomodates taller people. The bucket seating actually supports your leg to your knee, awesome for long trips. Especially if like me your not 5'5 or have a sciatic nerve that rears its ugly head on long trips. They have hit the mark on the interior design, a quiet firm ride. I think the fuel economy is consistent for the truck, right where I expected it to be. I was sick of sitting on chopped seats so a manufacturer can brag about leg room sacrificing my comfort. My Ram is just plain fun to drive with 390hp, long drives go by to quickly with the excellent interior comforts and ride.  Overall best truck and ride I've owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I absolutely love this truck. I have only had it for about 2-months but I cant get in and drive enough. The ride is unreal, like riding on a cloud and for a truck that's saying something. The feel of the road is fabulous. And it pulled my 21' fiberglass bass boat like it wasn't even there.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I test drove this pickup twice before I bought it. The first time I was amazed. So I tried it again to make sure and was amazed again. So I ordered one set up like I wanted it. Although this truck has a hefty price tag it it is really a great truck. The hemi motor has plenty of power and is soooo smooth. The truck is very quiet in the cab and has a great ride. We live on a gravel road that develops "washboards" and this truck goes right over them like they don't exist. I ordered the navigation radio with uconnect and the cell phone paired up right away. Also the door opener in the overhead console connected right up. This is a great pickup and very functional.

Vehicle_Title: 2010 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: When I first test drove this truck I was really impressed with the ease of driving it. It is a big truck but it seems so easy to get around with. The power of the hemi is awesome and the ride quality is really good. The interior is very stylish and it has lots of storage areas. Dodge really made a lot of improvements when they redesigned this truck and they have made a quality truck. If anyone is interested in a new pickup I would recommend test driving this truck and prepare to be impressed.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have had this truck for 6 years now and still love it. The places I have gone in it off road have been amazing and I have yet to get stuck in any conditions (been close but never stuck). The only time I have had to put her in the shop where due to my abuse and there has been a great deal of it. When I first got the truck it was hard to find good off roading tires for the 20in rim but now days I can find them every where. I will be driving this truck until the wheels fall off and then I might just ductape them back on for another few hundred miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I am the second owner of my Dodge ram and have owned it for five years. It has the 4.7 liter v8 backed by the 5 speed manual transmission at 140k now. I average 20-21 hwy and 15 in the city. I have the 17 inch stock tires and its 2wd and I follow the maintainance to the book. It pulls our 18 ft travel trailer great at a weight of 3450 lbs loaded and hauling a family of five. I will probably die with this truck as it is very reliable and comfortable and they no longer offer five speed manual transmission which is the best for towing. The dash is simple and the knobs are big and easy to see and read. I also love all the storage under the seats and the flip out shelf in the back. Happy cust.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I still own my dodge ram since 2004, bought it from a salvage dealer main reason it's a salvage title because it auto thief. It had 26k miles and right now has 99k miles and no mechanical problems at all. Recently I only drive it on the weekends and use to work only. But it was my daily truck in my college years and cruise around town. It does have poor mpg I average 11 city and 13 hwy with combine 12 mpg mixed driving. I personally like the 3rd generation design 2002-2009, don't like the new design it resemble to much of Toyota tundra not that I don't like it but it just look alike. I'll try not to sell it no matter how high gas prices is. Is going to be classic soon.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Been driving this truck for 8 years and still do. It was my first car when I graduate from high school in 2004. My dad bought it from a salvage lot. The only reason it was there cause it was a stolen had the seats, wheels, and stereos. Everything else was there. I love how big it is and with 4.7 V8 love how it sounds. It just has 95,000 miles, mostly from my college days and I now use it for work which is less then 12 miles where I live. So far no mechanical problems. Overall I like this truck and will keep it until I grow old.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Almost immediately after the initial 3/36 warranty the dash cracked in 6 pieces. No problem since I purchased the 10 year/100K warranty. When I took the truck in I was told the dash is not covered since trim is not covered. (I dont feel the entire dash is trim). I was also told by the service manager that this is a problem they have never seen before, but they would see what they could do to help. The help turned out to be replace the dash at $600 each for the two parts! So I contacted Dodge directly and asked what could be done. Next I googled Dodge truck dash cracks and discovered this is a widespread problem. The Dodge rep never called back after he promised to.My last Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Almost immediately after the initial 3/36 warranty was up the dash cracked. Im not talking a small crack the dash looks like a mine field and is actually now in about 6 pieces. No problem since I purchased the 10 year/100K warranty. When I took the truck in I was told the dash is not covered since trim is not covered. (I dont feel the entire dash is trim). I was also told by the service manager that this is a problem they have never seen before, but they would see what they could do to help. The help turned out to be replace the dash with me paying for the parts at $600 each for the two parts! So I contacted Dodge and asked what could be done I googled Dodge truck dash cracks

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I'm not sure what to say other then get a warranty. I bought my Ram used and have had nothing but problems with it. I'm not sure if it was abused before me but is surley abusing me. I bought it with 47,000 miles and have replaced the motor, rear end, radiator, and now have to replace the AC condenser fan and a control module. The check engine light is on more then off. Love the truck but it is getting pricey to keep and the warranty which covers very little is almost up.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My wife wrecked my front end when she took out most of a guard rail in Kodiak, AK. Without anywhere decent to fix the truck, we were left with waiting until I got transferred to another station to get it fixed. We drove it for a year and even from Alaska to Michigan with the damage and it still performed like a champ. 4600 dollars worth of damage and it still ran beautifully. I have yet to have a single issue with it still today after having it fixed. 4x4 works splendidly, but it does shutter a little bit when accelerating to highway speeds. One of my only complaints. All in all, I would definately purchase another dodge based on this one's reliability.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased my RAM with 123,000 miles in May 2006 to use it as a workhorse at my first job in residential construction. Lost the job, but kept the truck - and what a great decision it was! This was my first American car (after a honda and a BMW) and I loved the utility.  Lots of storage in the cab, great towing power, and the previous owner put a single-pipe flowmaster on it (and it sounded mean). Towed a 4,000lb boat no problem with a full bed of cargo. True workhorse! Only non-wearable part I ever had to replace was the radiator (and it was DEFINITELY a do-it- yourself job). Keep the fluids changed and this truck will treat you well!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Gas prices not withstanding... my paid for truck bought new has given me a great run for the money and I never complain about a warranty item fixed for free. It is true that Dodge never made a vehicle they didn't want to make four engines/trans/trim levels for. One of the reasons the imports seem to have an easier time with repairs. Even here my vehicle is an slt not a plus but the only option is a 4.7 for the slt unless the add for the engine comes up .. The real problem with any vehicle like this is the repair dealer you deal with .. the real survey should be how the dealership handles the problems that are covered. At 80,000 miles my paint on the roof was repainted from Dodge. Thank you ..

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Sport is a beautiful truck and excellent ride with 20' wheels.  Interior is spacious with quality materials, excellent heater and A/C.  Short Bed adequate.  I have towed up to 3,000 pounds (boats, snow machines, 4- wheelers) with no problems.  Works hard when using a truck camper.  Horrible gas mileage with 5.9L unleaded.  Only 12-13 mpg on highway and can drop to 9 mpg when carrying truck camper.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck is AWESOME!!  Most comfortable ride in a truck I've ever had.  Seats many comfortably.  Towing capacity is wonderful.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: It drives very nice and is comfortable. Very room inside. Gas mileage a litte lower than hoped for. Installed a cold air intake and noticed a difference in power and gas mileage has increased 1-2 miles per gallon. Overall very happy with truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Bought this truck with only a 1500 dollar rebate.. now they have 6000 dollar rebates. But guess what just finished paying for it and I dont need another vehicle because it is still working great! At the time had a seven year 100,000 mile powertrain..I took the complete warranty ..did use it on the windows and some minor radiator repairs. Now tempted on the lifetime warranty but the gas might prohibit me from keeping it twenty years if I only use it to drive! Still lifetime warranty on a truck is might tempting.. especially since the first one off the line has had so much good reviews and results. 5.9 engine has been great.. wouldnt have a 4.7 if gas was the same.. kudos Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Bought when it first hit the lot. Had some problems with the speed sensor, but fixed. Still get 15+ MPG in city and 18-19 hwy. Replaced front and rear bumpers like all good Texans.  Now it is a tank.  Have had nothing but compliments on its looks and ride from friends and family. Hauled may loads of hay in Texas heat with no problems. Tows like there is nothing behind it. Could get better MPG but as said before it is a truck and one that even Tim Allen would be proud of.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is a great truck. I have had no problems whatsoever. This is the ideal truck to have because of the amount of storage space in the cab.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: If it got 30MPG I'd never buy another car
Review: Was hesitant to purchase vehicle in June of 2006 with 123K on odometer. However, I have driven it like it was new (trailering and offroading) and it doesn't skip a beat.  Though it doesn't deliver awesome acceleration, it will tow up to its capacity without a problem.  The only thing that I don't like about the vehicle is the rear end suspension. It does not adequately dampen bumps and the rear end can get squirrelly at both low and high speeds (can be a little unnerving on the highway).  Great looking vehicle. Mine is black with the sport package (all black, no chrome) and 20" wheels.  I get compliments all the time about how cool my vehicle looks.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck new and have complied with all maintenance schedules without fail, using a Dodge dealer for all maintenance. I love the truck - when it's not broken. I've had the following failures in the first 88,000 miles - electric fuel pump, instrument cluster, rear axle seals, throttle position sensor, upper left control arm, right tie rod, front anti- sway bar bushings, and right front wheel bearing. Dealer has botched routine front end alignments, exhaust system repairs and front end repairs. Lack of durability/reliability has me looking at a sale/trade.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love this truck because it gives you the ability to haul stuff and/or people.  Just this past week we had visitors in town and I can honestly say it fits six adults comfortably.  Two days later I used it to haul an entire kitchen worth of cabinets.  The 4.7 liter engine is a good trade-off between being powerful enough and economical.  A few months ago we drove 1200 miles across country in this truck, it cruises down the highway very comfortably.  The truck has about 60k on it and it made the 1200 mile drive home non-stop without trouble.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased this truck last year and have loved it since. Yes it may not be the best gas getter vechicle out there, but come on, it's a truck. It's not a sports car so don't expect it to accelerate like one. Would you buy a Corvette and tow a boat with it? If you want a truck that is all truck, this is the one for you. I have never had one problem out of it, but I change the oil every 3k miles and the air filter every 7.5k miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: I'll never have another make of truck...
Review: I've made some normal hot-rodding mods to my truck. It can almost run even with a Hemi Q/C, yet now gets 19 MPG on the highway. I love this truck, and can't pry my keister out of the seat (hence the abnormally high miles on it per year). It's reliability is rock-solid, and I can easily drive twelve-hour days or more. I'm a GM convert, and will always have a DCX Ram from here on out.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love my Dodge truck! I drove my Dodge to Chevy dealers and test drove brand new trucks, but got out and back in my used Dodge truck and drove off so happy. I love all the storage, the head and foot room, the comfort and the ride. The seats fit and adjust perfect to me. I drive 35000 miles a year and wouldn't want to drive any other truck on the market. Mine is four wheel drive and I use it hard. I pull trailers to my construction jobs or race car to the track. It has never let me down. I look forward to my next Dodge truck. On the down side i have had to change one radiator hose , a power steering hose and the rack and pinyon steering unit. Total repairs were less than 600 dollars

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I finally got the opportunity to get a new body style when my '00 Dodge's engine was about to blow and got a decent deal on this '02 SB Quad Cab 4x4. Now, the head light switch has issues and I'm constantly "flashing" people unintentionally. Or, the parking and fog lights are constantly on. Sure I could get the $130 brand spanking new light switch. Then there's the issue of averaging 10 mpg with $3 gas, and a 30 mile commute each way daily. I will probably end up trading this truck in tonight for an Avalanche or Xterra. At least they average 16-18 mpg. Also, there is no real "frame" on this truck.  There's a special towing hitch that you have to buy.  I'd be scared to tow our Airstream with this.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased this truck new after trading in a 98 Quad cab. Excellent design...give a few flaws that were corrected later. Great ride and reliability.  Mirrors had always been a sore spot for me with Dodge vehicles, the tow mirrors are a plus. Very minimal maintenance in four years. The 4.7 litre engine is great, but not a big improvement in mileage over the hemi.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Radiator hose blew at 29000 miles. Blinkers don't work properly. And now the head gaskets blew at 36,800 miles and I don't even tow with it. Also the rear end hops real bad at highway speeds.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Traded my 98 Ram Quad Cab for this because of a great trade-in offer. No regrets or major mechanical problems in four years of ownership. 4.7 liter engine has lots of smooth power for non-towing situations. Highly recommend to anyone.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Great truck!  Fun to drive and great ground clearance for off roading.  I just wish it got better MPG!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is my 5th Dodge. This thing will pull the hinges off of the barn door and look great doing it. The ride is 100 times better than any "Z71" as you go around them in the mud to hook up the chains to drag them out. 90,000 miles so far and no problems. I tow a 31' travel trailer and it does the job.  Mileage is 16-18 hwy, 15-16 combined 14-15 city, 7-11 towing (31' travel trailer)

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I definitely love my truck. It is quite comfortable except for the long reach to the radio from the driver seat. Plenty of extra creature comforts. Gas mileage is terrible, but it's a Quad Cab V8 5.9L truck. I didnt buy it to be a Toyota Prius. It has hauled and towed everything I have needed it to. Steering does make a funny noise, and just a little slip in the transmission at 60k. I would reccommend it for power over the F150's I've driven and for creature comforts over the Titan from Nissan.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The ride and looks of this truck are good, especially with the sport package and 20" wheels. Lowered mine 2" front, 4" back. Really makes it stand out. The 5.9L lacks in power and performance. It is a gas hog! 10/City 13/HWG with 2 wheel drive. It's been back to the dealer 7 times for emmission system problems and an entire new front steering rack. Not overly impressed with Dodge trucks mainly due to gas mileage. This was my first & last one. Can't wait to get back to GMC

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My Ram 1500 is basicly a good truck over all, but I think that it is severly under powered with it`s 4.7 liter engine. As far as driving and handling goes,  it does allright. I think that the rear seating area could use some major attention. The back of the bench seat is by far too straight up and down. It should lean back to a more relaxed position, and unless you're a short person and have a small family, the back seating area is going to be pretty cramped for you!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I just bought my truck last month and I love it.  The only thing that I could say that I don't like about it is that it lacks good acceleration.  Other than that I think I am going to be happy with my new truck.  The new body style is a great change.  The new front end makes this truck stand out above the rest.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Buy this truck only for it's looks.  I have gotten many compliments on the appearance which I thank them for and then tell them it is the worst truck mechanically that I have ever owned.  I had to replace the rack and pinion at 45,000 and from the feel of it the transmission will need to be replaced within the next 2,000 miles.  The engine lost all power getting off the line at about 40,000 miles.  It has good pickup when the truck is already going at least 10 miles an hour and the accelerator is slammed to the floor or when passing but hesitates from the line.  Fuel economy is killing me with these $2.00/gallon prices - I average about 8 miles to the gallon in town and 13 on the highway.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Where do i begin! Truck has constant shaking problems that the dealer claims they cant feel, windshield wiper flew off, stalling problems, two brake jobs before 30,000 miles, complete rear end overhaul, rear end jerks to the side when hitting bumps which makes highway driving fun when you have to do the two handed recovery, windows rattle when half way down, recalls, and finally the damn thing was stolen for those stupid 20" tires, I was praying for a torching but of course not!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: We have immenseley enjoyed our truck.

column1: It has been problem free for 2 1/2
years except it needed a visor
replaced. We tow occasionally and it
does a great job towing.  We have
travelled with it and it makes for a
very nice trip.
The only complaint we really have is
the paint on the truck can virtually no
abuse.  You barely touch it it seems
and there will be a scratch.  I really
do wish they could somehow make a
tougher paint that could withstand a
small branch (for example) touching the
truck and would not leave a scratch
that has to be rubbed out.
Other than that Dodge has agreat truck
and would recommend it proudly to
anyone.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I had a 94 Dodge 1500 and purchased my2002 Dodge Quad Cab due to reliabilityof my other Dodge. My friends haveChevys and Ford but their truck can notrun idle in the Texas heat more then 2-3 minutes. Dotheir temperature gauges will be in thered, while the Dodge is still runningnormally.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: It seems to have the most room in the

column1: front for 2.  I liked the dash/ stereo
area compared to others.
I wish 02' had lumbar support and the
back doors could be a little bigger.
Overall I still think it is the best
looking truck on the road.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have been very dissapointed in the gas mileage of this vehicle.   The window sticker stated that it gets 14-17 mpg.  However, I get 11 mpg in town and only 13 on the Interstate.  I would urge anybody considering this vehicle to make sure that they are willing to put that much money in with our current gas prices.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have the Quad cab slt 2wd with the 4.7 engine. I have had great service from this vehicle.It dosen't even have any rattles.There is plenty of room in the cab for everyone.The under seat storage is great as well.I have the standard stereo with cd and it performs exceptionally well for a stock unit.I considered putting a different exhaust,but the factory exhaust has a great rumble to it,so no need to spend the $.I would change only 1 thing and thats the excelleration from zero to 60,but it's a truck not a sports car and I knew that when I bought it.Overall it's a great vehicle that is incredibly fun to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love every feature of this truck even the 20" Wheels,Its a great ride and gets alot of attention.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've owned my 2003 dodge ram 1500 quad cab for about a year now ,I have 18000 miles on it and my family and I couldn't be happier.We live in a very snowy area and I've gotten tired of pulling all those chevy and ford guys out of the snow. You couldn't get me to give up my truck for anything.I have a large family and due to the room we have started to use the truck as our family vehicle (at least thats the reason I gave my wife,the truth is I just like driving it to much to drive anything else @ we look good to.)I have the last of the 5.9's and I think it's pretty good I could use more ,but then that's just me.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I had been looking at 2004 Ram, when I recieved a call about this truck. It is a 2002 Ram Quad Cab with sport package. I've only had it about a month, but it rides great, it's like and SUV with a truck bed on steroids. The fuel economy is about 12-15 miles per gallon, but that is what I expected from a truck. It has a 5.9 liter, it doesn't have the same "pep" as a HEMI, but it is a blast to drive. Overall, I am very happy to have made this purchase

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: easy acess under the hood.nice ride doesn't like bumps at higher speeds. seats need to recline all the way. when you open the doors snow falls on the seats. back seat good room,no head protection from rear glass.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Although I really like my Quad Cab 4x4,the gas mileage is really terrible. Rides well, has adequate performance.  Igot the 4.7 engine specifically, as Idon't use it off-road too often, andwhere I live there's a lot of snow inthe winter.  But the gas mileage is justterrible!  I get about 8 mpg in thecity, and 12-13 mpg on the highway. Wouldn't have done too much worse withthe Hemi engine.  Although it's beenreliable, stay away from the 4.7 engine.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Truck handles well, steering wheel feels good, and with the fully adjustable seats, the truck is easy to drive.  It was a great looking truck when it was new and it still is the best looking truck out there.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Thus far I am absolutely 100% satisfied and pleased with this vehicle. When I purchased I was torn between the GMC, Ford and Dodge. I ended up with the Dodge and still believe this is the best choice. My next truck will definitely be another Ram but this time it may be a 2500 or 3500 with a HEMI.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My experience has been very good. Theonly thing that needed service was arecall on the a/c blower motor wiring,outside mirror recall, and a hole wasworn in the drivers seat where thelumbar support bar rubs the seat cover.Chrysler was nice enough to let me paythe full cost of this repair due to themileage at the time of repair being  38000 miles(it didn't happen overnight).The seat cover back alone wasapproximately $400.00. All otherexperiences has been great.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: In the shop more than on the road
Review: Dealer ship great, service department great, parts supplier sucks.  AC broke, side mirror recall, sensor recall, some other sensor replaced, headlights had problems, the rear axle broke under hard breaking on a gravel road, as of this review it has been 2 weeks and they still can't get a new wiper motor, fuel economy just keeps getting worse.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My truck has been used to tow boats and

column1: cars to Florida and no matter the size
the truck pulls it like it is empty

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Purchased the vehicle Feb 2002; I drove this new truck on a cross-country road trip starting in June 2002 which consisted of summer weather, 4 months constant driving, and 17,000 miles total trip.  Midwest to New York to Miami, Miami to San Diego, San Diego up old Hiway 1 to Seattle, and back to the Midwest starting point.  I purchased this truck new with 9 miles on it; it's red SLT Plus (now called Larmie) and had the Sport package (20" wheels).  New retail price was $38,915; it had every option available.  Other vehicles I own:  Lincoln Navigator, BMW X5 and Mercedes S600.  My favorite: The DODGE; why?...I had no problems with it what-so-ever. NONE!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: if you buy one the only problem you may have will be the rotors. the front rotors warp . mine warped 3 times since may, and it's only dec. for the 03 model year dc put out a fix but not for the 02 model. turning the rotors will cost about 50-60 bucks . the rotors where only covered for first 12000 miles. after that your on your own. get the dealer to replace em. that way they stay covered. turning them will work for a while.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Overall a good truck.  Just

column1: disappointed with the 4.7L engine.  It
has enough power but no acceleration
when you want to drive for fun.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love this truck, pulls my Mastercraft like a dream.  Looks great, always get lots of compliments on it.  Love the storage in the back.  Rides like a car and has much more room than the Ford and Chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Not gonna own it when the warranty is up
Review: Never had so many quality problems with a new vehicle EVER!  Never had so many recalls on a new vehicle either.  Electrical problems galore, mechanical problems with engine, A/C compressor, side mirror, gauge cluster, computer, and others.  Pretty truck when it runs, but I have no faith in it on the road.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: 2002 Silver quad cab SLT. 17 inch wheels

column1: Bought from brother in law with 18k
miles. I have 30k on it now.
I really like the under rear seat
storage. more is better.
Four full size/Fully opening doors.
4 Fully opening windows.
The over all looks of the truck & the
ride.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Much improved from 1999 quad cab owned previously.  5.9 liter is still too hoggish on gas, mileage not up to par with rest of the truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Thought when I first purchased that the4.7L V8 engine would not tow my trailer. Wrong!  This may not be a Hemi, but Itperforms well and has pickup.  Interiordesign won out all other trucks I lookedat.  Warranty was good, but when I got a84 month, 100,000 mile warranty foralittle extra it kicks all over the othertruck warranties....and NO DEDUCTABLE!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I really like this truck overall. I was a GMer, but the Ram has been so far the best truck I have owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Anybody that says the 4.7, is better than the 5.9 doesn't know what they are talking about. Check out the towing rating for the 4.7, and 5.9 on dodge's website, almost 3000 lbs less than the 5.9. The 360 has been around for along time, all bugs are out of it.The 4.7 l is also much noisier, i had both. The hemi, aluminum this aluminum that, to me that spells dollars. Dodge did cheap out on the interior on the 2003 as well, more plastic, less stuff. I owned the 2002, now own 2003, was vey dissappointed when truck arrived, dealer says thats the way they come know.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Dog loves it, so do I
Review: This is my first truck purchase in the 25 years since I left the farm.  Drove the Chevy Avalanche and comparable Ford F150 models on test drives, but overall Dodge package was a better value.  Have had great luck with Chrysler products in the last 7 years (2 with over 150K miles on them, still no problems), so I was predisposed to Dodge.  My Jack Russell loves to sit on the back of the fold-down center front seat while we tool down the highway, but his little white butt gets thrown all over the cabin when we go off-road.  He loves it anyway, and so do I.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Handling is near Audi like in poise and cornering. With the 4.7L auto trans, truck seems quicker off the line than my 5.9L 2wd. Shifts are imperceptable. The 20 inch tires make a huge difference in stance and handling. The monochrome sport package with dealer installed Brush Guard, and side steps. Lots of compliments on how well they intergrate into the truck design. Added  Vortec intake, Power Chip, and dual exhaust. Stock the truck sounded great, now awsome. Controls  well laid out, interior room (quad cab) is great. No problems.  Almost 4K cheaper than a comparable  Chevy/Ford, and neither touches the  refinement,  style, or ride quality.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Gas hog, but what a truck!
Review: I just love this truck.  The styling isexcellent and the ride is great.  2ndtruck I've owned and this is by far thebest.  Back end is a little light so youhave to watch the bumps.  Fit and finishis good and the interior is supercomfortable.  Bigest draw back is theTERRIBLE gas milage out of the 5.9Lengine, what a HOG. 8 - 9 MPG aroundtown and a max of 17 on the open roadwith no load in the bed. Plenty ofpower, passes everything but a gasstation.  But I didn't buy it for thegas milage.You're gonna love this hog.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: found out it's made in mexico. oh noooo. but the truck is great only a little jittery over rough surfaces. also i need to warn others of the rotors, they will warp. your first roadtrip and it will happen. go to dodge truck world.com and look under forums and brakes. warping rotors have 4 pages. plus this defect is only covered for 12 months or 12000 miles. after that, the local dealer for me chages 100 bucks to turn rotors.no aftermarket company makes em yet, so be forewarned.but other than that i love my truck. i have a 2002 qc with the 17 inch alloy option wheels

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck used in Nov 02. It now has 22,000 miles on it. So far, great truck at a great price. I bought this primarily due to the safety crash results so I could have peace of mind carrying my kids around town. I have taken it to Canada to fishing trips on rough dirt and gravel roads with no problems. It just keeps purring. I had already replaced my brakes on my GMC at this mileage point a couple of years ago. My 5 STAR Dodge Service Dealer has already given it the once over and so far it hasn't cost me another dime since I got it (I couldn't say that about my Ford Explorer and GMC Sonoma that I had in the past).

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This  has been an excellent truck.

3000 miles and everything in the truck
stopped working.  Took the dealer 4 days
to get another computer installed.  Got
the high end infinity sound system that
is horrible and a real waste of money.
Gas milage 12 in town 17 highway---not
good for a 2-wheel drive and a driver
that tries hard to get good MPG out of
their vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck for pleasure but to

column1: work when it had to. So far it has
exceeded my expectations on every
level. I was always a Ford man but this
new Dodge has me looking to other
directions. Dodge has really outdone
theirselves!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Overall, the vehicle is very nice to drive.  Within first 2 months, drivers door developed rattle.  On the downside, the fuel economy is terrible.  By coasting down hills and losing speed on inclines, I can get around 16.7 mpg tops.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Rides and pulls great - horrible gas

column1: mileage

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is the best looking, best riding 4 wheel drive truck on the road today.  The only draw back was that the HEMI was not out when I purchased it. Thinking of selling it and getting the HEMI.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Great vehicle hands down.  First time Dodge owner and probably will buy again. The 5.9L needs more punch and gas mileage per cubic inch (willing to accept low MPG for more HP). Sport Package should come with header/exhaust system upgrade. The 4 speed Auto shift/downshift points need another look at (would be fine with beefier motor). CD player skips on bumpy roads. Excellent built vehicle, ride is comfortable, and room for everything.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I have owned 2 of the 2002 to 2008 Dodge Ram 1500 ST trucks and loved them both - zero issues outside the normal maintenance on both - no complaints and find the truck reliable, fun, comfortable, and an overall fantastic truck.  I've tried Fords in the past and find this a much better truck myself.  Gas mileage is about 15 average, but I'm ok with that with a powerful V8 and expected.  I love the truck and feel you won't be disappointed.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck has such a great look. It's a shame people beat these trucks up. Trucks today are really too nice abuse. No wonder so many people complain. But this model Ram is one nice truck and holds up well if you take care of it. Simply love it.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD LB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: Bought it brand new and now paid for but the gas mileage is about 16MPG. The dash has cracks all over it after only 5 years. It was realy upsetting that they couldn't have foreseen that. The AC did go out after 5 years too. Just when the warranty was out. I have done all maintenance and there have been no other issues. I haven't even changed the break pads. Overall it's been good but Nissan and Toyota seem to be better these days.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: In the first 10K miles:  transmission failure, drive shaft out of balance, bad brake rotors. The 4.7 is underpowered, a gas hog, the ride is rough. So, it sits in the garage a lot, only 40K miles. Looks like brand new. Oh, and my 2003 Town and Country is worse. Any wonder that the US car companies are in trouble?

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Bought this truck 18 months ago at a Dodge dealership as a local trade in. I got it off the back lot before they were able to detail it and hide anything. The 5.9L 360 V8 is very powerful and reliable. I hardly ever lift the hood (just for oil changes). It has an after market Imco dual exhaust and sounds mean. K & N filter.  4x4 works great. Truck handles great in corners even though it has 35" tires. Drives smooth on the highway at high speeds.  Fuel economy is decent (15-18) and I don't do any city driving.  It'll haul a car on a trailer without any effort. The hard tonneau cover I put on it looks good. I really dig the interior too, heated leather!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: My views about this truck changed drastically since I paid it off. I paid the 5 year loan and then all hell broke loose. I guess I was lucky getting 129000 miles on it before having to replace the engine on a 5 1/2 year old truck. Thanks oil sludge prone 4.7L.I next had to replace the fan clutch and radiator at about 6 years old. Now I have to replace the front control module and the power distribution module due to both of them shorting out for no reason. I am one to keep a vehicle beyond the 5 year payoff. I have an 11 year old ford aerostar with 159,000 miles and I have only had to replace an oxygen sensor and one other emmision control valve. With 150,000 miles on my Ram, $5500 since I paid off.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD LB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased by Ram 1500 "Sport Edition" truck new in 2002. In the six years of ownership and 131,000 miles later, this vehicle has seen the service department just twice - blown fuse and cooling fan. It is by far the most maintenance-free vehicle I have ever owned! The 4.7 liter engine supplies plenty of power for the type of work I do. Personally, with gas prices the way they are, I don't think the much-heralded "Hemi" is worth the money or the sacrifice in gas mileage. I average 16.5 MPG in the city and have reached 19 MPG on the highway with my 4.7. It is as silky-smooth driving as the day I bought it. Selling it is not an option - it is my "toolbox" for life!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I am sure that my taste in automobiles has changed since my purchase of this truck. The truck is acceptable, and that is all. The gas mileage is horrible! Gentle driving 14 mpg on the freeway, but it is 4wd. Reliability is less than spectacular. I have had a few issues with it, including a recall for brake brackets. In all honesty, if I were to buy a truck, I would look at Toyota.  Overall, I am disappointed in the truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I've read through all the previous reviews of the 2002 Dodge Ram and I was surprised to see so many average 5.0 and higher.  My transmission was rebuilt at 20k miles, my dash started to seriously crack at 3-years-old (completely cracked now), the truck can't seem to find a resting idle and the dealership is scratching their heads, wondering, why didn't our first 3 recommendations fix the problem. I know what you're thinking. This guy hasn't followed the regular maintenance schedule.  I have, and to the letter specified in the manual.  Perhaps I drew the short straw and the new guy worked on my truck at the factory, but I'll never trust a Chrysler product again.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I love my Dodge truck.  It is fun to drive and is extremely dependable.  It always starts on the first or second crank of the ignition, and it handles like a dream.  I also love it because it sits up high off the ground so a person can see extremely well.  It has a short turning radius, so tight corners are not a problem.  Finally, I love its overall appearance.  It just looks good!

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: My Dodge Ram is now three years old. I have 49,000 miles on it. The only problem I had was the AC went out, but it was under warranty. I will drive it for at least another three years.. won't trade her until she reaches 100k. This is my daily driver and gas is a pain, but what can you do? I knew the gas would be ugly when I bought it. This is my second Dodge Ram and it's been as worthy as my first.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: I bought the Dodge RAM 1500 ST Short Bed pickup in Oct 2002.  The truck has been nothing but exceptional.  Quality is very good.  Acceleration for the 4.7L V-8 allows plenty of speed on the highway.  The cab is exceptionally quiet.  I like the strong door pillars.  The AM/FM Radio Cassette player gave out around 40,000 miles and I had to replace a resistor in the A/C fan at around 30,000 miles.  Towing capacity is good for small trailers/tows using the bumper.  Suspension is a bit tight...you tend to feel the bumps on the road; enough to remind you this is not your Daddy's sedan.  As for looks, this baby is top- notch!  Even after 2 1/2 years I get lots of looks from admiring fans.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: To those of you looking for a toy- keep looking. This monster is too big to be a toy, especially if your playground is the urban jungle. The truck is managable-the turning radius is good- but at the same time, the enormous mirrors (I have the trailer tow) and wide body make maneuvering in tight spaces difficult. Acceleration from the 5.9 is average at best (esp. on the highway) and gas mileage is subpar.  Handling is very good,(I have the 20s), but the ride is terrible. The truck crashes over everything and will change lanes if you don't have two hands on the wheel. All in all, it's a good truck with three bagfulls of character...just know that one of those bags WILL be offensive/bad/annoying.

Vehicle_Title: 2002 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 2WD SB (3.7L 6cyl 5M)
Review: My truck has been fantastic.  I get tons of compliments on its appearance.  It offers good performance and has been reliable thus far.  The truck handles far better than one would expect from a vehicle that large.  The ride isn't the best, though: you'll get thrown around a fair amount over bad pavement.  Other than that, it's been fantastic.
