Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this truck almost 18 years ago and have grown attached to it. Has it's quirks (have to learn to work the tranny manually so it doesn't search for power) 318 is a rock solid engine. Don't get me wrong, truck is slow as hell, but it always starts, always goes. Lots of salt in northern Illinois so it has all the typical rust you would find on a Ram of this year. Have 266000 miles on it now. Typical dash cracks. Truck still does truck things, hauls, tows. Like an old dog, I just can't contemplate putting it down. I'm probably biased by now, even though all the new trucks have surpassed it in tech and performance, I'll keep mine. Love it. Brakes aren't great even when new, but I've adjusted. Lights have always been poor. Steering wonder is a long known issue with old pitman arm setup. Very smooth running at hwy speeds (about 1900 rmp at 70mph with 3.55 gearing). Good light duty truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: Bought it at 250,000 thought I was an idiot but it was the exact opposite. I live in Texas and like to fish a lot so the terrain gets rugged. The 4x4 works great, does kinda stick a little but it'll still go in gear after I put it back in 2WD then crank it back to 4x4. Haven't had any issues with it since I've had it besides general maintenance except for the passenger window motor going out. Other than that it was a great buy. I've never had a problem towing or hauling either. Gas mileage city blows but I don't drive that much during the work week so I only have to throw in $30 every two weeks or so.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought my truck brand new in 1999, truck has performed awesome!4x4 is fantastic in the snow, handles great.truck has 158,000 miles now with no issues other than regular maintenance like brakes, battery etc.clear coat failed but that's not Dodges fault!!!this truck was my 3rd ram and two weeks ago I just bought a 2015 ram 1500 and absolutely love it!!This has been an amazing truck...durable...rides great..never left me walking.I will always recommend a dodge truck to anyone who asks!

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Bought a 1999 Sport model with the 5.9L with 135,000 miles. Never had a truck before, but I love this vehicle. I'm a bigger guy and I have more than enough room. This truck is the definition of toughness. I like to take it off-roading and it handles itself very well. Best looking truck on the road too, in my opinion. That 5.9L V8 is a beast too. Love when I step on the gas and hear that engine roar. The 4X4 works extremely well too. Where I live, we get pretty deep snow and I've never once gotten stuck in 4WD. Overall a great truck and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a stylish, powerful, roomy pickup. Will look to buy another one when this one dies on me.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this truck new in 1999 and have had nothing but problems from day one. I had 4,200 miles on it and the serpintine belt failed. I have replaced the intake gasket,all the u-joints,front wheel bearing,brake lines,idler pully,another serpintine belt,the fuel pump is going out,cat conv,front speakers,has a broken latch on inside quad doors,headlights get water in them,,trans slips,replaced speed sensor,replace trans pan rust caused a hole,clear coat on roof is gone. i have 83,000 miles on this truck and I would never buy a Dodge truck again.Note to owners on the auto-trans, put in (nuteral) and run for 2 min before driving the torque conveter drains fluid while sitting and ruins trans.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: I bought this 5.2L truck used with 14,000 miles for $14,000. I loved it until it had about 70,000 miles on it. Now it has 111,00 miles on it and the following has had to be replaced: plenum/intake gasket, clutch, tie rods, ball joints, catalytic converter, heater core, main computer, brakes and rotors (three times), steering damper, and shocks. It now needs the front and rear transmission seals, and new front wheel bearings. It is parked until I can sell it.I have always maintained this truck and never really hauled anything with it. I expect a bit more life than this for the money I pay. Shy away from this one.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought this truck in 2002 w/40,000 miles on it, and the transmission was slipping the day after I got it, replaced brake lines, coil, crank sensor, battery, transmission, intake gaskets, water pump, rear u-joint, front axle u joints 3 times now, replaced front seals 2 times and they still leak, truck will not run more that 10 minutes when it snows, and once a week or so, the truck will not start, cranks though, repaired door locks/latches, replaced caliper, brakes 3 times front and 1 on rear brakes, delayed wipers stop on middle of windshield, Dash board cracked, light on key switch would not turn off-had to pull bulb, upper compartment on ceiling broke easily, muffler been rusted out 5 y

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: My dash has never cracked! (must be that armor all hahaha) I bought this truck because of the way it looked back in 2001, big and mean.  Very reliable truck, she has always gotten me back home, not afraid to go driving long distance. regular maintenance goes a long, long way. The only major repair I had to do was the torque converter (replaced with aftermarket high stall) and added a transmission cooler because the transmission started acting up at around 120k and haven't had any problems since. Strong 5.9 magnum will spin 35's no problem and still have lots of horses left to pull that moose out. Next truck will definitely be another Dodge whenever this one goes, not for a long time.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Bought used with 95,000 miles.  No problems, so I deceide to invest a little $$$ for the next 100,000 miles.  Tune up $100: plugs, wires, rotor & cap.  Exhaust: $700 new cat converter, O2 sensors and exhaust.  High flow air intake, $120.  Bed liner: $100.  Fluid Exchanges $200: oil, coolant, Trans/filter. Molded floor mats: $80.  This truck hasn't given me a lick of trouble and now gets 15mpg city & 18.5mpg hwy with the 360.  Will take on first tow trip trip to NM in 2 weeks.  Not worried.  Lots of room, comfortable ride, quiet for a truck & hauls everything I need.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: Bought from my next door neighbor with 100k on it, has 105k on it now. He kept great maint records and always followed oil changes, tuneups and fluid changes, as I have since I bought it. No problems except and transmission valve went out, $15 part and 10 minutes to replace! Would drive it anywhere.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review_Title: Can't keep the RF wheel on
Review: Right front hub failure twice.  Dodge won't own the problem.  Very dangerous to drive.  A/C leaks.  Electrical system stinks.  Will NEVER purchase another Chrysler product.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: My girlfriend bought this truck out of impulse at a used car leader. It looks really good. But there are a number of things wrong with it and she has only driven it for 20,000 miles. it now has 171000. The transmission had to be replaced at ~160,000 which is really good for that transmission. Unfortunately the transmission is going out again.  Also has an exhaust leak, heater core went out and doesn't have a block heater (which stinks in Montana weather) This winter the gas lines froze so don't forget to put Heat in the gas. The four wheel drives sticks really bad too. Just a warning for this year truck. Transmission usually go out between 50,000mi to 120,000mi.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Had this truck for almost six years. Never had a vehicle anywhere near that long. Great power, pulls my horse trailer, my camper and has power to spare. Transmission started shifting erratically at about 150,000 miles, (although it was a tow vehicle since new) 5th wheel hitch was installed before I bought it.  Best seats in a truck ever!  Bottom not sore after trip to Iowa from Michigan. Wish it had more rear seat room, my family is outgrowing it.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought it used with 60k. Tranny problems started right away. Replaced intake gaskets, wiper motor, front knuckles. Plastic interior pieces broke in cold weather. Tranny finally went out and sold it. Some say the tranny problems are not true but I don't buy that. I knew of 5 other 99s in a 10 mile radius with the same tranny problems. Heck i didnt even use mine to pull anything!

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Fun to drive, but high maintenance
Review: I bought this truck because I love the look, the power, and the sound. It seemed to drive well, and the interior was spotless.  So it went home with me. Then it began. I had to replace all of the brake hardware at the wheels, O2 sensors, cat convertor, full tune up, idler pully, belt, etc. I did this all myself, fortunately.  Then, the track bar and a tie rod end was bad.  I replaced them.  Next, the transmission went.  The rebuild was about 2500 bucks. Fortunately I bought an extended warranty, which paid for itself 3x over. So I basically have a new truck. A lot of this stuff could be expected at the age, other things not. I still love the truck and plan on keeping it a long time.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I have had no problems with this pickup. The only time it has seen the garage was to replace the driver bench seat that had a manufacturers defect. The gas mileage is not so good.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: I have bought this truck from a gentleman that had it for about 3 years and he told me it was a good one.  I can say he was right, strong engine gives you the power you want when needed, I feel confident on it and is quite comfortable. You can haul tons of stuff, the folding back seat allows to do so, even when in a rainy day. I am having a little bit of an issue with a leak on the transmission fluid, but other than that this is an excellent vehicle. I will get a newer one as soon as I can.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: So far I have not been able to get my wife out of it so I can drive.  She never wants another car, don't know what to do about the price of gas? now I drive her van.  It's made driving fun again . Only problem is the speakers don't fade on the knob, might be a lose wire.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: If you're looking for a used p/u don't look at this one.  I purchased our Dodge Ram 1500 Sport for $12,000 in Nov of 2006.  I've since shelled out at least $7,000 in repairs.  My main purpose to purchase this truck was to tow an 18' travel trailer.  Sure it has no problems towing it, but the gas consumption drops to the floor!  On a trip across Canada I had to stop every 250 KM to fill up the thirsty 85 L tank.  Should have spent the extra $$$ to buy a used diesel truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Burns a lot of oil, lifters ticking, blows a lot of blue smoke out of the exhaust

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Other than the well known cracked dashboard syndrome these trucks inherited, I love my truck. Must have cat back duel exhaust. The sound and performance gain is well worth the $300. A truck that never failed me yet up here in upstate NY(knock on wood)

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Transmisson problems, dashboard cracked to pieces, paint on the hood and roof lost clearcoat and started to rust, catalytic converter had to be replaced...besides that, nice truck. Buy at your own risk

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: I'm happy with this old Ram!
Review: Okay, it obvious, this Ram is not going to give you great gas mileage. But to be honest this vehicle is not giving me much less than my 1999 Ford Windstar!  I sold my 2006 Mazda5 to get this Ram (the M5 was too small for us and the gas mileage was eved worse!) This model seems to turn heads! Many people think it looks great. I have to agree. When I purchased this truck in late October 2006, my mechanic noted that there were no big problems. Not bad considering the mileage!     There's more than enough room in our Sport model to take the the kids and their instruments to lessons.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: It has been one of the best trucks I have ever had and I have had a lot of trucks. Also it is real reliable it can pull almost everthing and I have never had a problem with it.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Purchased new to tow 3600lbs boat. Traveled to KS, TN, KY, VA, FL inside of 2 weeks and really enjoyed the trip. Great power, acceleration, and pulls like no other truck I've owned. A smooth ride on the Michelin tires; not so using Bridgstone AT. Dash top cracked after about 5 years. Minimum worrisome problems with regular maintenance performed. I did rebuild transmission at 84k; replace A/C system at 79k. Now I feel confident it is good for several more years and another 80k miles! Yes - I would buy another one.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Bought this vehicle with 26,000 miles on it. Best truck I have ever owned! Have had no problems with transmision or engine. The power driver seat has enough options to give a very comfortable ride. Looking forward to many more years of great service from this vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought the truck new in 99 and have had good luck with it. I use it to pull a 3,000lbs boat all summer and do some intense off roading when ice fishing. I have had some warranty work for the intake manifold gasket and have changed brakes and tires from normal use. The suspension seems to be a bit soft as it sometimes will bottom out with load in bed and steering seems to have some extra play in it. The truck overall has performed good and has been reliable. I have always liked the styling which was the deciding factor to buy.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Good ride and great handling capability. Reliable. Those with bad experiences with the motor/automatic transmission, all I can say is proper maintenance goes a long way.103,000 miles and the motor and transmission (using the approved tranny fluid )are still strong. Not a dime spent other than fluids (oil changes) and 1 tune up on the engine, tranny. I would strongly recommend a tranny cooler added. The front seats are comfortable on long/short trips. This truck hauls loads with great braking and drive train capability. Only the evaperator, speed sensor, water pump, and light switch have been replaced .Not bad for 103,000 miles. Next truck will be another Dodge after this one wears out in 15 years or so.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Only 17 years old and bought the truck last month. 160,000 miles on it and it runs great.  A lot of power, and can tow my pop's 28 ft boat with ease. It's hard on gas, that's it. Rides nices too. Just hope the tranny wont go like people say.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This truck has been awesome. Taken it off roading, had to pull others out, and tows awesome. I use this truck to go to work, school, and travel. Only flaw is that it uses too much gas, but it has a lot of power so I guess that's where the gas goes. That, and also because of the gear/axle ratio.

Vehicle_Title: 1999 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: My ST has the 318 5spd and had been a great basic truck so far. The 5-speed helps with the gas mileage and avoids some of the nasty transmission problems with the Dodge automatics. I too have the spark knock on heavy acceleration with load, which can be improved with premium fuel every now and then. This is a solid no frills truck with 160K on it and likley many more good KM to go.

Review: The 4WD works. This vehicle has never left me stranded and has always started. Transmission sounds like a handfull of nuts & bolts in a clothes dryer when engaging reverse. Huge oil consumption problem and spark-knock under most any kind of load. It uses a quart of oil at every other tank of gas in city driving and a quart of oil every tank-ful on the highway. The dealer re-set the computer to reduce the spark-knock but caused the 5.9 litre V-8 to behave like a slant six. There is rust beginning to show on the bottom edge of the doors and on the rear bumper. Like anything else in today's disposable society, pay your money and take your chances.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review_Title: Best, Most Dependable Truck I have Ever Owned!
Review: I bought my 1997 Dodge Ram Sport 4x4 in the fall of 1996. It currently has 224,000 miles on it and it runs like a top. The only things I have ever had to repair/replace is the usual stuff...alternator, fan belt, u-joints, thermostat, etc... in addition to the routine maintenance and servicing. I have had to do no major engine or transmission work, although I did lose my 4 wheel drive and cruise control due to the plastic vacuum lines eventually rotting and cracking. Got the 4 wheel drive working again, but still no cruise control which I'm ok with since I rarely ever used it anyway.  The truck has never stranded me or failed to start. Ever.  Performance wise, its not the quickest off the line in terms of raw power but its no slouch either. And it tows whatever I need with effortless ease.  Roomy and comfortable with excellent visibility and responsive steering. I don't know if its because I own a short bed or because its a solid axle or whatever, but the turn radius on this truck is unbelievably short. This truck "corners like its on rails", as they say.  The ONLY negatives I can say about this truck...the cup holders are terrible!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB
Review: I love my Ram. I've always heard people complain of death wobble or trans problems and I've honestly not had any of those. Truck has 327k miles on it. She just keeps on trucking. The seats are the most comfortable ones I've ever had the pleasure of sitting on. Gas mileage isn't the greatest but it's a truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: I bought my truck new in 1997 and have had it ever since. Very dependable , Pulls a bayliner dual axle boat trailer with no problems. Have done most of repairs myself. After 14 yrs I only have to drop the tranny and rebuild it. I am very proud of this truck and if I can afford it I will buy another.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: This lemon is currently in the weeds behind our shed. (Waiting for scrap value to go up). We replaced the transmission twice, plus spent about 6000 on misc repairs and countless breakdowns in the two years it was actually on the road. It was purchased used, so its condition could have been due to prior mistreatment. However, I will NEVER buy a Dodge again. Ever. What a money pit.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: Just got this black and silver 1997 dodge ram ss/t.  I always have been a fan of dodge, but this has to be one of the nicest trucks out there especially with as many years it has. The throttle is still very responsive, and it's tight like a new truck.  A big 5.9 liter engine is plenty of power to haul this baby around.  May be somewhat tiny but don't be so certain you can run over it in your huge trucks on lifts.  The napoleon affect.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB
Review: I love this truck.  I got if from my Grandfather after he passed a couple years ago, had 35K on it now has 78K.  Nothing big has gone yet. replaced shocks (70K on them!), steering pump (65K on it)  Truck is getting me 17.8 MPG in town.  Starts everyday no matter the weather, nice smooth ride.  I've got the 5.2 L which could use just a tad more power to really move, but I don't do much towing so it's fine for me.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: I've enjoyed this truck. I would buy another. My income puts me in the used market so I don't have huge brand loyalty.  I used it to tow a 28 foot travel trailer on holiday weekends - decent power for that.  Four wheel drive in the snow is great. I did spend money on some repairs. Intake mainfold gasket replaced, front wheel bearings, and front end steering parts twice. I think that it's just part of the 4WD thging.  I live in Wisconsin. It's starting to rust - go figure.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: Bought the truck new 'cause I fell in love with it. Happy to say I still am 124K miles later The truck is still the benchmark for styling and has performed almost flawlessly. The exception being the brakes, which was fixed with a higher quality pad. It has towed my boat or my camper for about half of those miles.  It still runs like brand new and delivers 17 mpg at 75-80 on the freeway. With platinum plugs and 8 mm wires. Very happy and will probably never let it go.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: Bought my truck from a friend with 30,00 miles on it. Had a 8' western snow plow on it. I put my 7 1/2' western on it. Been an incredible truck.  Plowed snow with it every year since I bought it. Every one always says Dodge Transmissions were junk, but mine went strong. Rebuilt it in Feb. of '06 with 128,000 miles on it (not bad considering what snow plowing can do to a truck). Still has original alternator in it. My snow plow's hydraulics are powered by the battery (electric). My dodge now has 150,00 miles on it and is still a great truck. Wish it were a crew cab. Single cab w/ 6' box. Short Wheel base makes plowing very nice though. But now have 2 kids and no room for the whole family.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Reliable, good looks, fun to drive
Review: I thought it would be good to give a review after 6+ months of owning a 1997 Dodge Laramie SLT SB 4WD pickup. I bought it with 182K and now have about 188K. It has been reliable, I did have to replace tie rod ends & track bar (PA inspection), but it has a 3" lift and I don't know the past history-so no complaints. What has impressed me is no rust (Northeast is tough on trucks), paint looks still shiny, interior needed a good cleaning but I'll be installing a new headliner and mat for the floor. I used to own a Ford F150 w/a little higher mileage (205K) but the tranny was shot and it rusting fast. Ram ++Great looks, +comfortable. Motor is real quiet,(not like the Ford)-gas mpg 16/13-just OK ;/

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: Excellent truck, the women always love it. Very sexy (black with silver stripes). Runs like a Dodge, and keeps on running. I'm selling it only because of the price of gasoline (she can't help it if she loves to chug, it's how she was built!)

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: This truck is a gas hog, 13 mpg all of the time, I do have the 4x4 package, I have bought fuel saving products, none work, the trucks sounds great, blows Chevy and Ford out of the water in sound alone. Truck has been reliable other than the transmission going out, but thats the risk you take with any used truck.  Remember 60% of people do not keep up the maintenance, so someone else down the line has to pay for it.  I would recommend the truck to anyone that doesn't care about gas mileage

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB
Review: Say what you want, this particular truck has delivered the good through all kinds of conditions. I've owned Fords and Chevy's but this has hung together better than either of them.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought the truck with 61,000 miles on it, drove the wheels off of it, this truck never gave me a bit of problems, just routine maintenance. The body style is awesome. The paint has held up great. The cup holder is in the worst possible spot. The interior has lots of room compared to other trucks

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: I have owned my Ram since new.  I have used and abused this truck more than the average person would ever consider doing to their vehicle.  The whole time I have owned it, the only problem I have had was the starter died at 120,000 miles.  The 4wheel engagement is strong and possitive, you don't have to guess whether it has kicked in.  You can't beat the solid front axle in the 4WD for strength.  The body refuses to rust, even through 6 NorthEastern winters.  I have driven it in salt water that was up to the waist line of the truck, with no problems, and no body rust.  The interior space is unmatched in any standard cab.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: I love this truck!  I bought the Ram as a much needed replacement for my 1990 Ford Bronco and I just think this is an awesome vehicle.  The interior is very roomy and very well laid out.  The paint is still bright and shiny even after 7 years.  The transmission is smooth as is the steering with over 75,000 on the vehicle.  I bought this truck used, but it is very reliable.  I also love all the room the vehicle has under the hood.  My only complaint is that the clear coat is very easy to damage.  The top of the bedrails clouded up were I had a toolbox installed.  There is a TSB out for this problem, but I solved it by getting bed rail caps.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: That was how my 5 year old described his first ride in my truck.  After driving an F350 all day, I get into my Dodge and realize how much nicer it is to drive.  The interior is setup as it should be, convenient and comfortable.  The ride is outstanding for a truck this size.  And last but not least, my SS/T hauls butt.  The 5.9 gets up to speed quickly and smoothly.  As for offroad performance - well the SS/T wasn't exactly made for that, but I'll take a great looking, fast Dodge over my muddy F350 4x4 any day of the week !!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: Fun to drive. Strong. Tough

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: Had lots of good luck, I do lots of off road work and this truck does it all. Better construction and design then Ford or Chev. Lots of power.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: an eye catcher, but extremely overpricedmopar parts. weak drive train.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab LT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought the truck brand new and have 66000 miles on the truck.  It has been very dependable, rides good, and has not caused any problems to date.  The gas mileage is not good at all, but I supposse you sacrifice that when you buy a truck that is four wheel drive

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Owned every make, owned every model, I treat my truck like a work horse and it delivers every time.Most reliable thing on the farm...You won't go wrong with this rig...got 310,000 miles on it and just came back from a 1200 mile trip pulling a trailer...never missed a beat.After owning this rig, I can't even remember what a Ford or Chevy looks like.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: The Love: I love how this truck looks, especially in Black w/the black f&r bumpers; why Dodge put chrome mirrors on this one is beyond me? Grey interior w/a beige headliner is also weird! Nothing I can't change easily through the use of after market accessories. I also love how this truck sounds after adding a "TRUE" dual exhaust system with flow master American Thunder mufflers. The power was lacking so I installed a K&N FIPK, a JET Stage II Chip, JET throttle body spacer and Bosch +4 spark plugs, and fully synthetic Amsoil engine, trans, case and diff oil and the truck breaths fire now. It has been very reliable so far. The HATE: The dash is cracked all to Hell. After market!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: First off, I want to say it is an ok truck. We bought with 167K miles on it and put bout 12K on it. But we have only owned it one year and already replaced fuel pump and a wheel cylinder. The dealership said it had one owner. We feel like that we have been ripped off! We cannot even trade it in since we can only get 2000 for it and still owe like 4000 on the loan. So now we are stuck with a truck that could break down any day!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: This is the best truck I've ever owned. I had no problems at all until 279,000 miles. I would recommend a Dodge to anyone that needs dependability. I carry an average of 2500lbs in the bed at all times. The down side is I get 13 miles per gallon if I'm empty or pulling a trailer with 10000lbs.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought it with 100,000. First Dodge truck I ever had. Wow! I will always stick with Dodge from now on! What a dependable truck. Same engine & transmission, no rust or clear coat peel, I wax it a lot. Replaced, brake line, pads and rotors, battery, oil and filters. Just regular maintance. Daily driver. The carpet is worn and stained from Michigan winters and mud from off road. I pull a boat in the summer (17 feet) and my boy's lawn service equemptment. I change the fluid and filter one year and flush it the next. Also, use the +4 transmission fluid. It's more pricy than most but it is recomended by Dodge. Has not failed me yet!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: When i bought the truck i was skeptical at first about gas mileage but i soon came to realize that the 5.2 L is really a pretty economic motor. My truck has 119K on it and i haven't had any problems since buying it in Feb. of 07.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: All I have to say is, Wow. I bought this truck from the original owner, 65 yr old male. Drove the truck like a baby, took awesome care of it, all synthetic liquids throughut the truck. It has 235,000 miles on it and runs like you wouldn't believe. Original everything. Tranny, engine/fuel pump, everything. He kept regular maintence and kept her running beautifully.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This is the best truck I have ever owned. It is extremely realible. It is the heavy duty version, so I have not had any transmission problems. The only thing that is bad is the gas. I have did a little work on it to get batter gas mileage so it's not as bad.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This truck is reliable and the build quality has surprised me, But the very poor mileage takes all of those benefits away. I get about 11 mpg on the highway right now with 97,000 miles on the clock. It's tuned up always has fresh oil but the gas never gets better. Oh well.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: We lived in MN and drove this truck there for 6 years. This truck did everything we needed it to do - even through the worst winters in Mn history. We recently bought a travel trailer that is just too much for the 1500, so must sell it. Using hindsight, I should have bought the 3/4T at the time and I would be OK. Many, many great outdoor experiences with this vehicle. Very dependable.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this truck new in '97. very reliable. Only high dollar items that went bad were a pinion bearing and a fuel pump. This truck had a lot of life left in it, until some old lady ran a stop sign and totaled it! I will be buying another Dodge for sure!

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought the truck from an old man who had all the service records.  The truck had 67,700 miles on it.  In the last year I only put 3,700 miles on it and every time I drive it I end up having to go to the mechanic.  Last time the power steering pump shaft broke, this time it's the transmission.  It's the biggest money pit.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this truck with 65k miles on it and it now has 90k after 4 years. I have had it in the shop at least twice a year since I bought it, mostly for big items (tranny, fuel injectors, etc). I like the look of the truck but it's the biggest money pit I've ever owned! This truck may just be a lemon, but I would suggest doing my research before buying one. I've heard similar tales from other Dodge Ram owners.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I actually bought this truck off ebay....flew to Houston, Tx. and drove it back 734 miles (to Alabama) in 11.5 hours.....and I've got a bad back!  Most comfortable truck I've ever been in!  Have had a few squeaks but otherwise, just fine.  Would like more mpg from the 318, but not bad @ 15/16 local.  Doesn't go up much on the highway though.  Overall, a good truck.  Quiet and comfortable....looks good too.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Purchased the truck new in 1997. Have had 1 front wheel bearing assembly go bad at 50k miles and just replaced the O2 sensor at 85k miles. Routine maintenance - change oil, trans, axles, etc. pulls my 19 ft boat just fine. Very pleased with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: 94,000 miles so far, no repairs yet except regular maintenance and wear parts.  Very pleased with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I reviewed this about a year ago. It is still going strong, however, I have had about 3 instances of the Check Engine Light come on over the past year. It was all minor stuff. One of them involved a vacuum seal that was also causing the Cruise Control to not work. I also need to replace the carpets because of mold. Not Dodge's fault of course, but I wish I had gotten those rubber molded floors instead of carpet. Why do they put carpet in a truck anyway? What a waste. Anyway, I am still very impressed with this Dodge and the only thing that drives me crazy is that now I want one of the newer ones.

Also, already need rear-main replaced, and sometimes the cruise will not stay steady on highway.
