Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: im the second owner of this truck,only part changed has been the starter at 88000. It has been real dependable.the first owner was a friend and he just changed oil,nothin else had to be replace,except like brakes and tune ups.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: My Ram 1500 is really a disappointment.  I met more 1500 Ram owners that say the same.  My truck has 37,000 and the cruise control, steering pump, electrical system, and power locks all had to be repaired.  If that wasn't bad enough the front brake pads and rotors had to be repair/replaced at 12,500.  From what other dodge owns tell me the transmission should go out soon.  Before buying a RAM ask the owns that have one what they think of their truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I got my Ram with the 5.9L V8 over the 5.2 because of the increased horsepower and torque.  Although it doesnt seem like 10hp and 10 lb-ft would matter, the 5.2 was very underpowered for this size vehicle.  I get about 13-15 mpg with this guy.  It's pretty wide and long, even with the Short bed on the ext. cab.  It barely fits in my garage.  Only problem I have is the bottom of the doors are rusting because of poor design on Dodge's part; they failed to have enough drain holes.  Aside from that, this is a great vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 1997 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I have not had this truck very long but so far it has been great.  I really like the looks of the truck as well as the roomy interior.  The truck seems to run good considering its size.  My only complaint is the costly gas milage (13/17), but I was aware of it when I bought the truck so I guess I can't complain.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Feel like your on top of the world driving

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is by far the best truck I've driven or rode in. The 5.7 has nothing but power. Fuel economy around 18 on hwy at 65. Around 14 in city. The backseat is huge. I have a friend that's 6'4 and has plenty of leg room. The heated leather seats and sound system are awesome. I have no complaints. Compliments everywhere I go. I. Bought with intentions of a family vehicle and it will serve great for that and work. The rear room is more than any SUV or car. By far the best vehicle I've ever had.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is by far the best pick-up on the road. Laramie mega-cab, has by far the most comfortable rear seat in the business. The nav is straightforward and easy to use. 5.7 hemi has incredible power when you need it. With 8,500 miles so far I average 16.5 hwy at 80 mph. The only bad news is 12.5 city. But I love this truck and so for knock on fake wood not a single problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck, it's so comfortable inside and it has a Hemi! I love how this thing drives and my daughter thinks its a limo with all the room inside. I drive this every day about 70 mile round trip(mostly highway) and love the comfort and eazy way it handles. This is my first truck and Dodge and I am so glad that I picked a winner from the start.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I got the truck to tow a travel trailer. I'm sure it will do that just fine. The mega-cab has great room for everyone to sit comfortably. I traded in a Dakota quad-cab on this truck. I had the 4.7 V-8 and got 19 MPG on the highway. Im very dissatisfied with the mileage of the 1500. I know I got the Hemi.  But Im only getting 12.5 miles per gallon of mid-grade gas and I dont gun it.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my first Dodge and so far am extremely satisfied with the exception of the fuel economy.  Best I have gotten on complete interstate driving at 70 mph is 15.6. Mostly I average around 13. That's after installing a Magna Flow exhaust system (added 1 - 1.5 mpg). Color, trim, wheels, etc. are amazing and people are always telling me how great it looks. Rides like a dream and plenty of power.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Amazing truck to drive. Very quiet and the ride is very controlled and fair but firm. I have the 4WD Megacab.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Laramie Mega Cab - Great so far !
Review: Happy after a month of riding this monster. Very quiet inside. Engine audible only during fairly heavy acceleration. Impossible to hear the Hemi while cruising. Powerful, comfortable. Responsive, sedan-like steering. Great braking ability. Stable in sharp turns. Love the Bluetooth handsfree phone system. Interior free of rattles or visible defects. Feels like a livingroom on wheels. For a smart shopper, the Laramie is worth the extra money. From other reviews it seems the SLTs have some interior quality issues, not the Laramie. Great truck for my family and our three dogs. It's early for conclusions but at this time the average gas mileage is 14-15 mpg - mostly freeway.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had the MegCab for 4 months and have been nothing but pleased with this purchase. I purhcased this for towing/people hauling and it definitely fits the bill. Fuel mileage is about what I expected (18mpg). I would strongly recommend this to anyone looking for more versitility than a minivan.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab SLT 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My Dodge has all the motor performance you could want. I've had both Ford and Chevy and it beats them hands down. The one area seriously lacking in the Ram is the fit and finish. I've had trouble with door seals, rattles and a poorly opening center console.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Mega Cab Laramie 4dr Mega Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love this truck. It's the most comfortable truck I've ever owned. It's huge and parking at times can be a challenge. But I get noticed.The only bad thing is fuel economy. But you must expect that in a vehicle this big. It's very well built, no rattling or annoying noises.The radio has great sound. The truck has exellent vision. Mirrors are large and well placed. I highly recomend this truck! This is a man's truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Has the Hemi engine tick. Exhaust manifolds tend to rot out. Comfortable to drive, tows  a 15 foot camper and a 16 foot car trailer with the occasional car on it with ease. Had a 2004 model for 7 years that never left me stranded. Will see how this one does.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: This Truck Never Had Any Problems
Review: The truck will be 11 years old in February and the only time it has been in the shop was for an air bag recall.  This is my first Dodge/Ram truck and it has exceeded all of my expectations for being a reliable vehicle.  I was sure I would have replaced this vehicle but it still looks good and runs just like it did the day I got it.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: 148k and still like new.  Very big truck with 20's. Almost too big.  Drives well,  looks awesome.  Mpg are not good with hemi.  But,  I wasnt expecting it to be a Prius.  Gone thru two radiators and rear end bearings.  Other than that great truck.  Would rather have 4.7 and a few mpg increase. Can't really justify having the Hemi,  others might.  To each his own!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I usually only keep a vehicle for two years. I have had this one for 8 years. It's still like new. Unbelievable durability. Will buy another Ram 1500 Quad.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: Truck is a little slow on pick up when towing, but then again it's a v6.Does great mpg on highway (I get 22mpg avg) & unless you tell someone, you can't tell it's a smaller engine.If you want a full size truck without the full size mpg, I recommend it.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: OK. I come from a GM family. So when I bought the Dodge RAM 1500 w/HEMI, I was a little apprehensive, well a lot apprehensive. I bought it new, well a demo. After driving it as my daily driver and work truck, I love it. The truck has had two maintenance problems. First the water pump went bad at approximately 90,000 miles. Then the wheel hub bearing went bad at 110,000 miles. Both easy fixes, I did it myself, cost me less than $200 each repair. Stay away from the dealerships. They wanted $700 and $1200 for each repair, respectively. Fuel Mileage is great for this size truck, HWY: 20mpg(at 65mph), City: 16mpg (minimize traffic stops). Overall, Great truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased my ram 1500 new in 2007. I loved the truck as soon as i sat in the seat. one of the first things i did was tinted the windows and added vent visors. then added dual exhaust out the corners of bumper. The only part of the truck that I didn't like was the mds system it did nothing for gas mileage all it did was make the truck jerk every time it cut in and out. and also the transmission was to smooth for my liking, I bought an Edge programmer to take care of that, adding extra power and firmer quicker shifts, night and day difference. eventually wore through the crappy good year tires they had on it and added cooper zeon ltz tires this also improved ride stability. Loved that truck

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: A Well Built Truck That Does The Job
Review: I have a 2007 Dodge Ram 1500 Crew Cab 4.7 V8. It does have a very good ride & I believe that it's built very well compared to older dodge vehicles. The Ac freezes me out & stays COLD even at a dead stop. A lot of GM trucks I had ran hot & Ac went to crap after 15 mins of sitting time. The 4.7 does struggle but if your not a major tow guy it's not a problem. The trans does also seem pretty solid for 60k miles & no problems. A good truck over all. I also love the aux fans that run. This way I know my AC is cold when I get in & my temp gauge isn't HOT.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I made this purchase due to the fact that it looks like a real truck and not something from the future. Great looks and plenty of power. One negative being vibration problems that no one can seem to figure out. After a new set of Michelin tires and trans check and drive shaft check the problem still exists. I have one more who wants to take a look at it and if nothing develops to correct problem I guess I will take a major hit on trading it for something else. Not the experience I expected for something described as Ram Tough.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a great truck for someone who doesn't have to have a truck. It struggles pulling my 5000 lbs boat, my 3000 lbs trailer. squats real bad if I put over 300 lbs in the bed. The interior looks like it started out with good intentions but falls real short for usable spaces, like the cubbyhole in the dash, anything you put in there will fall out the first time you take off. I have a blackberry phone and I cant set it anywhere because it will end up under the back seat. At 82,000 miles the the motor that controls the transfer case went bad, at 89,000 miles some transmission part went bad that made me have to shift it manually, at 95,000 I lost a front axle.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had this truck for about 90,000 miles now and have all of them trouble free. I wish that the gas would be a bit better but other than that, i cannot complain

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have a 2007 four dour with the 4.7 V8 flex fuel.  I'm very impressed with its power.  I'm so impressed with it that if someone told me it was a hemi, I would have believed them.  I got a good deal on this truck used.  It   rides like a truck with the 20 inch wheels, but it's fun!  It's a real man's truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Nice truck but hard on gas
Review: This is my second Ram and third Dodge. I do like driving it, but it doesn't get near the mileage the window sticker says it should (I had a V8 Dakota and the mileage matched the sticker's figures). The truck is pretty much loaded and hasn't given me any problems. It starts great in cold Canadian winters. The 20 inch wheels look nice, but you get a bumpy ride with them. The rear bumper and side steps are starting to rust already. Will probably try another brand when the lease is up.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: We haven't had this truck very long but so far we are very impressed! We expected horrible gas mileage after reading reviews but it gets about 15 in town and 20-21 on the highway. That is all we can ask of a 4WD truck. We bought the 2007 Dodge Ram 1500 4WD Quad Cab Big Horn Edition and it seems to be built well and it is fun to drive. It did not have a tow package on it so we told the dealer that we would not buy it without one. They put one on for us immediately :) Ours has the 4.7 V-8 and it has plenty of power. We traded in our 2002 Ford F- 150 with 170,000 and it was tough because the Ford still had no issues. We are happy with our choice though!! Hoping for MANY MANY miles of enjoyment!!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: when I bought this truck I drove a Ford and Toyota.They all drove nice, the dodge seemed to have more space in the Quad Cab. but out of fairness to the other two trucks they where extended cab trucks. but the pricing was the same I feel that I got more truck for the money, by me buying the ram. fuel mileage is on par with the other manufactures. after all this is not an economy car if your looking to save gas buy Honda civic,or something similar.I would recommend this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've had Chevs, Fords,and Dodge's. This Dodge is by far the most poerfull,the seats are comfy,not quite as comfy as the chev but once they break in they are good. If you drive with a heavy foot it will be hard on gas. On the highway cruising at 110 km/h I avg. 23mpg, at 120 km/h I avg. 20mpg.In city avg, is 14mpg. The rear suspension is a little soft if hauling travel trailer or other heavy loads, recomend a set of airbags, the truck will pull my 32' travelair no problem.I love this truck. There was some basic electrical issues with the $x$, a ne reprogram of the computer solved the problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Have driven it for almost 3 years and 48k miles with no problems.  Hemi gets 21 mpg in the freeway if I stay under 70 on a long trip. Still comfortable and rattle-free with original tires/brakes/spark plugs doing fine.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: i been own my dodge ram for 2 and half years now and i only got 21000 miles on it now ...gas milage not really good when i first brought the truck ..but ..someone told me put k&n air filter and dual exhaust with magiumflow and got 2 half gal more ..right now un getting 17 in city and about 19 and sometime 20 on hwy...this truck being a good truck for me i which dodge would bring the 4.7 back to 318 ...i got 20 inch wheel which it came with truck..i got $5000 into this truck ..almost a show truck

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my fourth Ram, and the best so far.  This is my first Laramie and my first Hemi.  I have had two with the small 8, and one with the 6 which I was very happy to part with.  The Laramie is very comfortable and fun on the inside, it is hard to believe you are in a truck with all the features.  It is a far cry from my first Ram with steel floor panels and manual windows with a cassette deck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have had this truck for two years with no issues.  I have a 6" lift, 35" tires, magnaflo exhaust, airaid intake and throttle body spacer, and I pull a 7x14 enclosed trailer loaded with toys and I get about 14-15 mpg, that is going up many big hills, and going about 65.  I didn't buy this truck for gas mileage I bought it to play with and tow with, great choice.....at least my dodge doesn't have spark plug issues.....(5.4L)any guesses?

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded my 2005 Dodge SLT 4x4 in on a Cadillac for my Wife, and regretted doing so as I missed it so much, so I bought the 2007 when I had the opportunity. It is a 2007 SLT Sport 4x4 with the Hemi and it is a fantastic truck. It sits outside day and night in uncovered parking in the hot Arizona Sun, and it has never let me down, doesn't over-heat, and the truck still looks like Brand New. The Arizona Heat can cook an interior, but so far, nothing has warped, nor faded. Now mileage totally stinks, and it gets worse mileage with the 8/4 Engine than the V-8 Hemi did in my 2005, and gets roughly the same mileage as my 1973 Dodge Powerwagon did with a 360. It averages only 12 MPG, which stinks!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Before I bought this truck I read every one of these reviews.  Now after owning it for a few months I'm surprised they were so positive.  I thought I'd add my 2 cents.  Put simply, if you buy a truck to use a truck.  Avoid this one.  I tow and use my truck alot off road. Build quality is extremely flimsy.  Tranny has very irritating and weird shifting tendencies. Road wander is horrible in this thing.  The slightest little bump will send it bouncing all over the road.  If you just go to and from work, and Home Depot on the weekends and don't mind the bouncing into the next lane when you hit a bump.  This truck is for you.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Love my RAM - Big Horn Edition
Review: Never had any issues with the truck.  Truck came with the 20 inch wheels which is what I liked.  It also came with the Hemi motor, and its really response when the pedal is floored.  The Hemi is sensitive on the brands of gas, so its best to use a popular brand.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: For the most part I really love this truck!! Awesome looks and can't beat the power of the hemi! But it is headed to shop for the fourth time for leak in back window. When it rains, the storage buckets under the back seats will have water in them. Can't seem to get it stopped. Also, truck comes out of reverse occasionally. Doesn't happen on a daily basis, but just enough to worry me. Thank goodness I have the lifetime warranty on the powertrain so that it will be covered if it gets any worse. Really hope they can get the leak fixed because I love my truck and don't want to have to end up trading it due to one issue!!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Great truck so far. Very dependable with respectable power from the little 4.7, but horrible gas mileage. I  don't drive it too hard and have never got much higher than 15 mpg, even on the highway. I think it drives pretty smooth for such a big truck. The best part to me is the look it has. Mine has the chrome 2o's and i think it looks better and tougher than any other. I would recommend this truck to anyone.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have to say overall I love my truck.  It's not perfect though.  The gas mileage has never really improved that much, the driver door doesn't seal very well and at highway speed there is a lot of wind noise.  I have a leak from the front (probably by the looks of it the front trans axle) which is going for service next week, the Hemi engine when driving at highway speeds and switches to 4 cylinders will cause wheel spin on ice/black ice.  This is a major problem for those of us north of the border in the winter! I also pull a 29' camper trailer with my truck and I wish I upgraded to the 2500 when I purchased my truck 2 years ago.  Overall I am happy, but I will consider a Ford next time.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Overall I have enjoyed this vehicle.  But I am having a ton of problems with the tailgate.  It is really hard to close at times, or it won't even stay shut.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: We have owned GM vehicles always and we were looking for a good lease deal. Dodge was the greatest.  We hesitated getting Dodge because what some people say but that truck had such an extreme hard life and never left us stranded. Never any transmission problems or anything. Up huge hills with 5 snowmobiles on the back of a trailer to the rug, burnout competitions, snowmobile trails you name it and it did it. It went awesome but the lease is now up. At 33k it still goes like new!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Truck ran fine until it hit 2,500 miles, then it was a check engine light, after getting truck back from dealer all warning lights would come on at the same time when the temperature got over 95 degrees outside and the truck would start cutting out and would not start on occasion. After being left stranded three times and no fix from Dodge we took a loss and traded it. Might have had better luck at a different dealer service department.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've only had it for about 2 months so far but it is truly awesome!  I got the "ThunderRoad" edition, which (as best as I can tell) included bigger/better tires/rims, better stereo/speakers, and nerf step up bars. The ride is quite smooth and the interior is very comfortable. Obviously the mileage isn't "peak", but it's a V8 truck for heavens sake so that really shouldn't be a complaint for any owner - that said, however, I've averaged about 18.5 mpg so far and even have a cellphone snapshot of it hitting 21.1 mpg at one point (all highway driving obviously - but 21.1 in a V8 pickup truck...awesome!)

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Decent truck but 4WD is not that strong
Review: Overall this truck has been excellent for the money. My 07 4.7L Ram 4X4 has plenty of space and offers a very comfortable ride. Have had no problems except for with the 4WD system. I have 25K and have already had a problem with the front drive axles slipping off the front diff splines making it very difficult to drive in the snow. As of yet no word on whether Dodge will fix it under warranty. Transmission does shift difficult at times but other then that excellent mpg. ranging anywhere from 12-22MPG depending on city or freeway driving.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've always been a muscle car guy. When I test drove my 5.7 Hemi (Big Horn Edition) i enjoyed having that power on demand. This truck was the best value for the buck. Hands down. Plus the lifetime warranty is unmatched. I've had the truck for over a year now and have not had a single problem. Great for Hauling my muscle cars around! Actually gets better fuel economy while towing on the hwy! This is my first truck and what an amazing truck it is!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: I wouldn't buy this truck again
Review: I own the 07 Ram 1500 SLT Quad Cab with the 4.7 V8 automatic. About every 2-3 months there's always something crapping out in it. Off the lot it had a module bad, that wouldn't allow the keys to program. Starting issues that are still not resolved because it wont duplicate when the techs are looking at it. Both fog lights broke. They fixed that.  About 3 months later check engine light. Some canister failed. Took 2 weeks to fix that.  9 Month mark, trucks starts to pull. They replaced a bushing. Took 2wks for that, still pulling. They aligned my truck to a faulty machine..they admitted their machine was bad and got that fixed. Radiator fan will grind under heavy stress and engine temps.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my first Dodge.  I love the truck but will not be able to keep it after warranty.  The engine light comes on with regularity.  Luckily warranty has covered the new computer, all the code checks, leaking shock, wind noise adjustments.  Warranty has not covered my TIME to bring the truck in and wait.  If Dodge could fix this issue I would love the truck but will not be able to afford it after the warranty.  My advice, lease one.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my 2nd Dodge Ram and I purchase the 2007 5.7 hemi.  The engine gets great gas mileage compared to the 4.7.  On a flat highway going 55 to 60 mph this truck clocks 30 to 31 miles per gallon.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Nice truck, mpg is better than my Ford Ranger that I traded, The 4.7 engine looks to be well designed and has plenty of power, Transmission seems to have a mind of its own shifts are inconsistent and jerky at times, but if it becomes a bigger issue I always have the peace of mind of the lifetime powertrain warranty

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Works like a truck, drives like a car
Review: I have owned 5 Dodge Rams, and this is the best one yet.  The ride, handling, reliability and comfort are unsurpassed.  This is the only half-ton truck to offer ESP.  What a life saver! ESP has saved me many times this winter driving down narrow country roads.  The seats are a perfect fit.  The rack and pinion steering makes the truck fun and nimble.  I have had no trouble at all.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: First truck my cousin had to remind me in Texas a ram is not a pick up, it's a truck. I have has thirty comps about the look, I have had all types just looking. No problems at all this is my first new vehicle that I haven't had to take back in for something. I want the duel exhaust better radio little more quality in the cab and more paint choices like cool vanilla. I would buy 09 with that color. Looking at 09 when they come out. Great truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Bought this truck after looking at the Chevy, Ford, Nissan, and even the Toyota. Out of all the other trucks this one had the most features and room and was cheaper than the rest. Also if we live in America we should drive an American truck right? Suppot the local economy.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Poor performance and 4x4 weak, 19,000 miles and transfer case went south, very poorly designed transfer case, 48,000 sticker price, paid 38,000 new, and less than 6 months later dealers only want to give 19,000 trade in, fuel mileage on hemi is pathetic, 10.9 to 11 mpg, this is the worst car buying experience I have ever had, and that most money I have ever lost on a vehicle through depreciation, come on Chrysler! We are at record high fuel prices, inflation killing everyone's wallet and this is what you do for your customers! Thats crap!I Dodge thinks they have owner loyalty because people keep their dodges a long time, but that is because when you buy a Dodge you owe way to much to sell

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a great truck so far. I was immediately attracted to the truck's appearance, but when I drove it I was very pleased with the ride and comfort. Nice quiet ride. I previously owned a Jeep Wrangler, and needed more room and more cargo space. The truck works quite well with our Child Seat and the occasional trip to Lowe's. I purchased the truck with the 4.7l V-8. It's a good engine for getting around the back roads where I live. I don't do much towing, although I did pull an enclosed trailer with ease. I also really like the simple and functional interior. I was raised on GMC's, so purchasing my Dodge was a risk, but so far I am very happy with my choice.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love my truck.  It's so smooth and quiet, and handles like a car compared to old trucks.  The build quality is amazing, I had given up on American automobiles and had sworn by Japanese cars when it came to quality and affordability, but Dodge has changed my mind with this truck its built every bit as good as a Honda and is much more enjoyable to drive!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Excellent truck, if you need it.
Review: I can't really say anything bad about the Dodge Ram. Its a very nice truck overall. Fuel mileage is about what is expected from the 5.7L Hemi. I average around 15mpg on constant short trips. The interior is very nicely layed out in 07 compared to past trucks. The radio is adequate. The amount of storage space in the cab is just amazing. Overall, if you really need a real truck, this is the one to get. If your looking for good gas mileage, look elsewhere. This is one truck that doesn't hide what it really is.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Bought the truck as it looked great in dark red with chrome 20" wheels/boards and the Hemi. No disappointments, averaging 17 mpg, have driven 20k miles and have not had any warranty repairs or rattles. No complaints

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Ths is by far the best vehicle I have ever owned. I would have bought the truck regardless. However the incentives were the best around.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my first Mopar, and I love it (SLT 1500 BigHord w/5.7 Hemi MDS). I've always been a Ford fan, but with the price and all of the opions, it cannot be beat. Also, since DaimlerChrysler helped design parts for the U.S. Army's M1A1 Tank, they should be able to produce a great truck:) Need nurf bars if you or your spouse are shorter than 5'10" or a free hand to help pull yourself in.  Love having 345hp if and when I need it. Gas mpg is acceptable for the power that can be unleashed - 17-20hwy 12-14city, learned to be more light footed.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my third Ram. I really like the fit and finish. Truck is solid and sure. Towing is very good. 20 inch rims are awesome.  Had a LWB and got a SWB this time and it makes a difference in the parking lots. Plenty of Power..MPG has something to be desired but I knew that when I got it.  Make sure you use the cruise otherwise it has a tendancy to take off and you dont know it.  MDS works OK. Rear tail lights are awesome.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck, Getting on average 18mpg, Has lots of room, lots of power, and yes its got a Hemi! Has cheap stereo system and seats.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just traded my 2005 Ram SLT1500 with 4.7 liter V8 for a 2007 Ram Big Horn Edition SLT1500 with 5.7 liter Hemi multi-displacement engine. I was looking for the higher tow rating and the lifetime warranty (however my 2005 had a nice extended Mopar 7/70 warranty on the powertrain). The 2007 is a wonderful truck. The Big Horn comes with 20 inch wheels that look super but may take a little away in the towing department. The Blue Tooth hook up is great as is the satellite radio. Both of those items are in demand and appreciated. The chassis is excellent for driving and pleasing to tow with. Nothing beats the look of a big Ram. I got a great deal too as the 2008's (with less rated HP) were here!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: More than avg mileage on it first 9-months. Around town, yep, MPG falls to 13-15. My truck has Hemi with multi-displacement engine, since a lot of my 14,500 miles highway I see nearly 20 MPG! Thats pretty great considering size. My former vehicle a 4-Runner got around that MPG but 'hated' that thing! I have the big-daddy 20's and aluminum rims, look much hotter than chrome! All in all I love this truck. OK, one bad part, has had weird transmission issues. When placing in reverse a grinding meshing sound occurs sporadically. Its actually in shop now, I hated to take it in I love driving it. Providing that isn't a major long term issue I will be more than happy to recommend this truck 100%!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought this Dodge based on the styling, a short test drive and aggressive pricing I was able to obtain. After 3,600 miles, I am wishing I had checked a few of the options boxes differently or gone with the competition. I liked the looks of the 20" rim and tire package available as part of the "Big Horn" package. Living with this wheel and tire package on a daily basis is tough. The ride quality is horrible, especially on broken pavement but its not smooth even on fresh pavement. I have seen this complaint on other reviews and I would recommend not getting the 20" rims and tires. I also find the seats very stiff and lacking in upper lateral support. If your bigger this will be fine.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Purchased my Quad Cab 1500 Laramie after looking at all of the major competitors. Each one offers nice features, but, the Dodge gave me the most for my money. Got the leather, premium wheels, Hemi, satelitte radio, power seats and much more for the same price as other Brands base models.  It was too big of a difference to pass up!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my fourth Ram P/U. First one was in 1999. Last one was in 2004 and was stolen. took a while to replace it,but was worth it. Hard to compete with Chryslers discounts. My seconed Black one, this time with Added Chrome Bling. Love the ride and HP on Demand. Great for Towing my new Searay. Will be Adding new chrome wheels soon to replace Factory 20" Fake chrome. Buy a black one and make it shine.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love this truck.  I test drove different models of trucks for 3 weeks before I decided on the Ram.  I could not be happier.  Power, looks, style, you name it, this truck has it. The ride is so smooth it's like gliding down the highway.  Expecting my first child and therefore took a close look at all features of the trucks I looked at. Hands down, Dodge took the cake. I get a safe vehicle for my wife and child.  And, I still get to ride in a very sporty and great looking truck. Already had a garmin so didn't need the nav system or bluetooth.  However, all of the other upgrades make this truck the king of trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Love it and so far is the best vehicle I've owned. Powerful, sharp looking and reliable. Works great towing boats and the 4x4 is as strong as a Ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have the 2007 Big Horn SLT 4Dr Quad Cab SB 5.7L HEMI. And I love that truck.  More power than I need, but I like having it.  The truck looks great sitting on those 20in rims. All around a very nice truck.  I have not had any trouble at all with fit or fininsh, that was the only thing I was worried about before buying it.  I guess the guy that put my truck together was on top of his game that day.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is the 3rd new truck that I bought, the first Dodge ever.  Why a Dodge, well, it was the cheapest! It has power, plenty of it! Even with the upgraded 20 inch wheels and 35 inch tires it can tow almost anything with its Hemi. However, it has three problems, fuel is the biggest, never has it come close to what Dodge says it does, on average it gives about 11 MPG, 13 on the highway if the wind is behind you, 10 in town no matter how you drive. Another problem are the stiff seats, they are very uncomfortable after seating for about 30 minutes, I get off and sit in my brother's Chevy 2500, and immediatly notice the diference. The other problem is the off- center stearing wheel to the driver.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love this truck. It has great get up and go. I have towed with the truck multiple times, never a problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Well this truck is just outstanding. With its 8,500 lbs in towing copacity it will easily cary my 4,600 trailer camper, and our 2,200 lb boat. It has room for all 5 of us with room to spare with its six passanger seating arangement. A real big look too. My neighbor said it looked like a little Mack truck. With a few accessories this will be a truck that turns heads, and hauls like a Ram. The short turning radius has even my wife happy. Thank you Dodge

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love the look of the Dodge Ram 1500 Hemi. It has that man's man truck look and the power to back that look. Match that with the massive 20" chrome wheels and the truck has that "Git-outa-my-way" attitude that the competition works hard to protray,but never achieves.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Everything you'd want in a truck
Review: Looks, power, comfort. This is a great truck. I love the navigation, heated seats, and the Hemi! I would hate to live without the Bluetooth feature. It is a must have. Power is always on tap, and the truck is very smooth on the interstate.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Have had three new style Dodge Ram 1500s. O2 O4 and my new '07 Amazing truck. Never had a problem with any of them. I pull a 9000lb car trailer. Truck is amazing, tons of power without initial expense of a Cummins Diesel. I call it my huge sports car. Handles like a dream, great styling. Huge interior (I need every inch of it, so if anyone would know its me..lol). New features such as remote start, sun roof, lane change signal flash, power delay relay after engine shut off are wonderful additions. People can't believe such a big truck can be so fast. Build quality superb.Nice fit and finish. Totally happy. Will buy another!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck represents the best in the automotive world. The handling and towing is far superior to anyother truck on the market. Believe me I've owned all three of the major domestic brands. Also, the resale price was very suprising compared to the Chevy and the Ford.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned 2 Ford F-150's and have nothing negative to report about them. However, I didn't know owning a truck could be so grand until I purchased my new Ram 1500. The difference in power is amazing. I barely touch the accelerator and the Hemi can throw you in the back of your seat. Styling? I get looks all the time! I highly recommend the Dodge product - the truck represents raw, rugged power. And isn't that why you want a truck? I just got this truck and already looking forward to my next Ram (the Mega Cab!) in a couple of years, if things work out anyway. Go get the Dodge Ram - you will be very happy you did.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is the 7th Ram that I have purchased since 1993. This is the strongest of the bunch with a responsive Hemi and the 20" wheels. All of the turcks have been reliable and ready to work.  The '04 and '07 trucks have the Hemi and driving the truck 20000 miles a year has never been so fun. Just need to find a cab larger than the quad and not as cumbersome as the mega.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I would suggest to every man, that is a true man, get the 5.7L Hemi!  Awesome power. With a cold air intake, throttle body spacer, true dual exhaust with Flowmaster muffler and a power chip the truck is hard to handle. Pushing around 440hp. Ford and Chevy haven't got anything on that hemi.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab LB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: excellent truck

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Poor fuel economy for small V8.Rough ride on factory 20"Previous owner installed dual performance exhaust, sounds like a beast.Way more roomy than my old 97 reg. cab Ranger.Nice large cubby behind the seats, 5-6 bags of groceries easy.Over all very happy with truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Now a Dodge fan till the end
Review: I have had a lot of different vehicles most being Chevrolet. I bought a 2006 Impala SS and had so many problems that both my friend and me went out and bought new trucks. This time we tried Dodge. Why do you ask we switched well I really had bad luck with everything else my Chevy truck lost the rear end and then the tranny started to slip and my Impala lost it's engine at 50,000. My Impala was covered my truck wasn't. I bought another Chevy truck and lost the tranny in that and said enough. I talked to several people and they said try Dodge they have had good luck with there's so I did. This truck is so well built, classy looking and so damn tough it gos everywhere and is amazing offroad.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: First off I must mention this truck has the old model 4.7L motor and not a Hemi or the 250HP 4.7L that came out later in 2007. The truck has been fun to drive aside from being a bit underpowered on the freeway. I have used the 4x4 on weekend excursions and the truck is plenty comfortable for longer vacations.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Drives excellent, smooth, quiet, snappy throttle. tripped from NH to NC and back again and averaged 25.9 mpg with the 4.7 Magnum engine (that's not a typing mistake)

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: I feel like a man again
Review: I owned a 2000 Dakota and went to a sedan after that. When it was time to buy my next vehicle, it was a no-brainer. I went out and bought the Ram and I haven't looked back. Let's face it, Dodge full size pickups are the best looking trucks on the road. I love having 4x4... it's my first time. Driving around KS in the snow and ice has never been more fun! Oh yeah, I also hauled more than the recommended payload and it didn't even blink. This Dodge is built Ford tough!

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck!  I have owned Chevy, Ford and now...Dodge.   Dodge has great everything except fuel economy.  I got the smaller V8 thinking better econ, but the Hemi seems to get 20 mpg, I avg 12-13 with city/hwy mix. Get power options (long reach to pass window), but get the cheapest radio they have and put your own system in. You think it won't matter, but with windows down at speed, you can't hear it. The 20" wheels look great (w/shortbed rough ride..but fun), get the 15" stock and put your own 18" wheels on.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: A loyal Ram 1500 4x4 buyer: 1990, 1999, 2005 & most recently an '07. I had an '05 Ram 1500 quad 4x4 w/Hemi and was disappointed...Poor fuel mileage and a terrible ride. Fitment was also poor. Because I rarely used the 4WD I opted for the 2WD this time. I am very happy with my choice. I got a very good deal at the Dealership (a lost leader deal). With the 4.7 eng I get 20 MPG on the hi-way and it is still new. Off the line it keeps pace with the Hemi, but the Hemi is superior at higher speeds for raw get up and go. Never the less the 4.7 seems to be more than adequate. This revamped model seems to have ironed out the product line's prior deficiencies. It seems to be a very good value.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I got the SLT reg cab w/the Hemi, only one I've seen. I was looking at quadcab but suprising amount of room behind seat & I feel that it looks better; a real hot rod stance. Truck is big; size & ride hight seem a lot larger than Ford/Chev. I love the  black prl (the crimson color is pretty, but couldnt get 1 w/the Hemi around here). The rack & pinion makes for easy manuvering over old-style idler/pitman arms, parking is no prob. I've put 6500mi on it -city traffic around 14-15mpg, I got 19 yesterday on the hiway at 85mph (thank you MDS). best was 23 on 40mi drive at 55mph. The Hemi is awesome! It pins you to the seat & goes right now. I hung with a Vette from a stop for 1mi. Get a radar detector.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: There was no option for this trim level/cab config. with the 5spd auto, so I had to put this under the 6spd manual.  This is my first brand new vehicle, and I love it.  I've already put 850 miles on it in the first 8 days of ownership, had 30 when purchased.  The 4.7 is more than adequate for the truck, despite a 4,500 pound curb weight.  The 5 speed auto shifts smoothly, almost imperceptibly.  Nice V8 rumble, even through the stock exhaust.  Fit and finish seem to be top notch, on par with or better than my mom's '06 Sonata. Gauges are big and easy to read, nice aqua back-light. Enormous cab, more than enough room for even the tallest person.  Roomy center console with the split bench seat.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Economy would most likely improve with a taller 5th and 6th gear. Can be painful in freeway traffic. Handling is good, build is very good, and seat comfort excellent.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: My new Ram replaced an '03 Ram Quad Cab. I am very pleased with the performance, handling and comfort of this vehicle, which is smaller and more fuel efficient than the Quad. The smaller 3.7 V6 engine is ideal for me as I do city driving but have the need for a full-size truck for hauling. I have owned Ford and GMC trucks previously and none of them gave as much power with a V6 as this truck does. Dodge has made a lot of refinements in looks, style, appearance and comfort with this truck. My vehicle has the SXT package which is a notch above the base ST model. It is well-equipped with power options, cruise, Sirius, offers good value and good looks for a very reasonable price.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Hard miles with the minimum maintenence has stuck me on the Dodge truck. I purchased a used Dakota with 150k miles and sold it two years later with 214k before buying my Ram 1500. I was hoping that the Dakota wasnt a fluke because you know sometimes it just depends who was working the factory that Monday when you get those trucks that just keep on going. But my 1500 has not dissapointed yet, I've put a hard 52k in one year and it runs like it just finally got broke in.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab LB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Great Pickup without all the gadgets
Review: I have been out of trucks for 10 years but found this one to be an excellent value. I really liked the design and feel when I drove it so I bought it as a way of getting back into trucks. It may seem like a base model in price but it definitely has the look and feel of a much bigger truck. Excellent value in a new truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2007 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: So far I am very impressed with this truck. I have the 5.7 litre Hemi, Edmunds doesn't list that engine size for the regular cab trucks. My dad has a Chevy w/ a tonneau cover and gets 20 MPG highway with it on and 17 MPG with it off, my truck without one gets 19 MPG, I'm looking to invest in one to see how good I can get. Tons of power and torque. I love this truck!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SS/T 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: My wife got this truck for me on Valentine's day. What a great gift. I have had this truck from Ohio to Delaware on the east coast where her family lives many times and this is the best riding, best handling, and best performing vehicle I have ever had. When I got it I was getting about 12 mpg, after installing a K&N filter and Z-Max I'm know getting about 16 mpg. Who cares it looks great and runs great.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab ST 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review_Title: Fix A Few Things Wiil Ya Dodge?
Review: Dodge cut some corners to save pennies and made a truck of lower quality. Cup holders are 100% guaranteed to break at the hinges.   Paint is very thin at places.  My work truck (read no carpet) floor mat pulled from doorsills in first few months. Dodge could have left 2 inches more material and eliminated this problem.  No front end grease fittings from factory. My local Dodge dealer added them for me. I had the top of the dash crack on a cold morning. I live very close to Florida!  Again a cold morning 40F! At that point not covered under warranty. I bought a cover  A good truck that could have been better.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab WS 2dr Regular Cab LB
Review: I have owned 2 Ram trucks. The first one was a 1986 2wd 6 cyl 1500 standard. This was a good truck it did have it's own set of problems Transmissions! The 1998 is a big disappointment. The first problem was tire wear.Had to replace front tires at 10,000 miles. It always ran ruff,ate breaks,poor mileage, rear window always leaked, and now needs a trans job at 100,000 miles. This is the last Dodge I will own. I have owned 4 others. Their quality has hit bottom and it's a shame. I was a Dodge diehard/no more.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB
Review: I have had this truck for almost 2 years. It has 90k miles and giving it a tune up and changing fluids is the only thing I've ever had to do. It is very dependable and tows my 18ft fishing boat with ease. Very impressed with limited-slip rear end and engine torque. I can pull boat up very slippery ramps with little or no wheel spin and it's a 2W drive.

Review: Bought used 10/00 with 36k miles from dealer 5 hrs. from home. Halfway home, checked oil. After pouring in 4 quarts of oil, called the purchasing dealer. Replaced headgasket at nearest dealer. Limped truck home, still burning oil, brought it to local dealer, who replaced valley pan gasket, upper & lower intake gaskets & thermostat gasket, all warranty work. 10/02 replaced radiator & thermostat after overheating ($600). 5/02 replaced water pump & did brake work ($490). Review: Have had small electrical problems from the start, eventually resulted in transmission overhal and replacing computer. This with just 66,000 miles.  I had planned on keeping this vehicle forever, now I am dumping it. Worthless piece. I am so disappointed... will never buy from Dodge again.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Suspension, drivetrain and durability very poor. History of transmission and electrical problems, quality is TERRIBLE. Would never buy another one should be sued for false advertising

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Love my 98 ram. My wallet ehh not so much
Review: I have a 98 SLT Laramie 4x4 quad cab with 5.9 magnum. I love this truck but just dropped $3000+ into repairs few months back. Got brakes all around. drums, calipers, put cross drilled slotted rotors. Helped a lot with braking. Truck has 3in lift with bigger wheels/tires. Doesnt help! Replaced almost all front end. ball joints, idler, pitman arm, Center link, etc. Water pump went out just recently. I've had this truck about 3 1/2 yrs  and all this stuff basically happend at the same time all within 1.5 months. But i do drive this truck like a RACE CAR every morning to work and 4 wheel it time to time. Bought it with 110,xxx OG miles now has 138,883. Gas mileage isn't the greatest but i don't care if i did I would buy a prius. Interior is compfy and spacious back seat not so much. a/c is ice freaking cold. I've never had any electrical problems. And I have a killer sound system with upgraded engine ground and power wires. Towing I don't do much but the two times I did was with a car hauler with furniture plus the bed filled. It did great in my opinion5 hour dr from NM to AZ. Ya dodge could work on this and that but so could ford or gm or even toyota and nissan no body's perfect.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: I have 98 1500 4x4 drive it is in great condition but I have put $200 in transmission sensors because dodge transmissions suck it works now until the tranny finally blows out like all dodges maybe they will get there act together some day

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review_Title: a rock solid sexy beast work truck
Review: I own a gas 5.9 liter extended 4 door 4x4. No lift, slightly larger tires then stock. This truck was a 1500 covered to a 2500 or 3500 by putting more leaf springs in the rear. I am currently trying to figure out if it was 2500 or 3500.This truck was used to haul a 11,000lb camper cross country. It has plenty enough power. Although that is not a lot to us now, in 1998 the 3500 diesel model could only tow 12,000! Now with that in mind I think its 3500 springs. This truck tows almost any realistic thing any modern family needs with no problem. I do wish it had a ya more horsepower because you'll get to 30 mph even while towing like lightning, but anything above it has trouble gaining speed. Once my uncle bought it he used it to haul cars to his shop saying it towed better then his 5.7 Chevy 3500 1994 model. It does burn about a quart of oil per 350 or so miles but its towed a lot in its life. I get on highway about 17-18 but most people call me a lier but after reading these comments I know 90% of you say the same. I recommend this truck to anyone with a budget but needs something that is a brick, can tow a reasonable amount, and even to someone with a family with small kids. Remember tho, I've never had this truck with the 1500 original springs so idk about those. But what I do know with the beafed up springs, it will tow anything, id say, without breaking anything, safely tow no more then 11,000 and you don't do it to often either because you will bend gears in the rear after a long time. But besides towing, I have the Beachwood brown leather interior, wood dash, looks great. Auto seats still work great, even the compresser to air your seat harder. Very comfy highway ride. Grips good. Have a carpet cover over dash but I dont even think about it, looks great. Overall interior, great. Very comfy. Thats personally what I care about most coz thats where I'm spending my time. Take this thing hunting, off-Roading, anywhere and it will definitely go. I've done it. Overall 5 stars. Love this truck. I hope this was helpful. Btw also planing to put a 5th wheel ball in the back to haul gooseneck trailers with hay and cars. And also mine doesnt run hot at all. In fact, if it gets up to half, I get worried but it only gets that high when idling. So hope this was helpful to people, especially for those wanting to know how it tows.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab LB
Review_Title: Last Long, Drives like a Champ
Review: This is a outstanding truck. I bought this in 99, and it has not had any bad problems. Around 133,xxx miles my front U-Joint went out. But i have not had any other problems. I would recommend this truck for a first vehicle if you have kids getting ready to drive. Its Something they can have fun with, beat up, and still run hard.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: This is the 5th dodge ihave bought of this body style. The auto trans dodge missed on but with the 5 speed this truck is the best truck you can buy. Good power, great towing, and comfortable. I drive this truck every where. bought at 192k and at almost 300k now. Back seat is kinda small but I dont ride back there my gear does "firefighter". I put this truck through hell and back and keeps going strong. As for steering and all the little stuff people complain about if you maintance your truck, car, boat what ever like you should this problems will never come around. Buy A Dodge!!!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: I've had my ram for a while now and I absolutely love it. It's like a tank, nothing stops it. If you want good fuel economy buy a prius not a full-size truck. If you compare the 1500 to a diesel then you're a retard because of  course there is no comparison. Diesels aren't all they are cracked up to be either, had one, didn't care for it.  My paint peeled but hello, it's 2010, it's a twelve year old truck, that's actually pretty good.  Never had any tranny or engine or suspension issues. Break's don't last so stop whining. (buy a prius).  Put a nice exhaust, bigger tires, and murder it out and you have the toughest looking truck ever!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I got this truck with 7 miles on it and I now have 315,212. I would buy another one if I could find a new one. The has been the best thing I ever bought new.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought my truck when I was 19. I put 75,000 miles on it. I sold it at 175,000 miles driving her from Phoenix, az. To San Diego, ca. To Austin, tx to Houston, tx. & to Kansas City, mo. I hauled cars on trailers around az. & tx. I also hauled my stuff in the bed from Phoenix to Austin. I drove the hell out of that truck going 100 mph+ from Phoenix to San Diego. Of course I took it off road and raced some cars & trucks on occasion. I did the work on it myself & she had all the power, towing capability, & even drove her while I delivered pizzas at domino's. I could pull 16-18 mpg in town. I can't own another truck now, since she was easy to work on, had enough power and towing, & I could scare little cars too.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review_Title: Not As Many Problems As Others
Review: My dad bought this truck in 2001 and we haven't had to replace anything but the water pump, and we had to fix the AC. Other than that, the truck has run great. The clear coat on the paint is chipping off but what do you expect it's been a while. Fuel economy is better than our newer 2005 Ram. It hauls a full load of roofing waste material almost every weekend easily. The truck is great.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: i have a 1998 ex cab 2x4 1500 sport with a 318 and auto trans  the truck rides good and looks good but that were it stops the wiring had been trouble since day 1 in and out of the shop about ever 2-3 mths or so  the trans is pure junk  the motor is strong but the cooling sys. ant very good  and the miles per gallon stink

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought this dodge private party from the original owner at 213,000 miles the original clutch lasted until 205,000 miles before it got replaced. I owned it for 2 months it now has 221,000 miles on it since I owned it I had to replace a headlight switch (push pull type)replaced the upper and lower intake gaskets, valley pan plenum gasket, power steering pump after i replaced the askets myself there is absolutely no oil consumption. the truck starts great in cold weather, never overheated in hot weather, climbs hills great and blows by other trucks. truck has performance mods but runs like new for the original miles on everything. I will never buy another ford again, dodge 4 ever!! great truc

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This vehicle has never performed well we spent over 15K since we bought it and it still needs 5K worth of work. Our family bought three and none of them performed well.  I will never buy a dodge again.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I purchased this truck from my local Dodge dealership.  It was used but in great condition.  I have owned this truck over 4 1/2 years with no major problems.  It has a great ride and handles like a dream.  I've owned other brands of trucks, but this Dodge is my favorite.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Still nice driving down the road even hitting bumps other than my Flowmaster 40 I put in it, very quiet.  My issues are with the upper and lower ball joints, the AC evaporator and the heater core.  The AC has been out for years, the heater core leaks and the ball joints went two years ago.  To get to the heater core and evaporator you have to take the whole dash out, about $400 in labor alone. The ball joints were replaced with actual ones that CAN be greased. Failed rear seat lever.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD LB
Review: This truck has been amazing since new. I pull goosenecks loaded down cross the midwest and drive this truck everyday. It now has over 400,000. Suggest buying this model over any of the other full size trucks made.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: I had this truck for about 3-4 years now. I like it, but It keeps breaking down from something; first, an electrical problem, then the transmission, then the water pump, finally, another electrical problem; Whatever you do, do not buy one if you do not want to spend a lot of money on it so it could break down on you

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought this truck brand new in 98. I am sure the newer ones are better. Granted, this truck has a lot of miles on it now, but the realibility was suspect from new. Had a lot of problems with spark knock. Dealer messed with the computer, throttle body, intake, spark plugs, wires, higher octane gas and still no fix. Computer would fix it for 1k miles or so then it would knock again. Rear main leaked since about 60k miles. Transmission replaced at 70k. Bad bad brakes. Right front wheel bearing two times. Sway bar two times. Steering box. Stereo replaced under warranty.Bad paint. List goes on. I still have the truck, but only drive it now to haul trash. Buy a Chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I have owned this truck for 3 years. Love it, fun to drive. Who can beat that sound? Issues, bad paint, brakes, fuel mileage. Replaced catalytic converter at 100,000 mi. Brake issues front knuckle replaced at 110000 mi. Paint started to really go bad this year 9 years old. So over all, good truck, with some mechanical issues. Worst issue is the fuel economy. 14- 16 mpg. But what do you expect with a big truck and big engine.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: Got it to pull my 4200# travel trailer. The 95 Chevy with 350 would only do 50 mph up some of hills. The 318 has no problems keeping me at 65. Lots of room in front cab and all controls easy to reach, back area could be bigger. The 318 is great, plenty of power, mileage is what I expect out of a truck, better than the Chevy 350 and I got more power. I do my own maintenance (including anual trans filter and oil) and never been left standing on the side of the road.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: Plenty of power and solid drive.  Avg gas mileage for truck.  Felt more solid than the other major two trucks.  Guys truck to drive.  Not dainty.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I have owned this truck for a little over a year, and have not had a problem one. I drive 50 min. one way to work 5-6 days a week. The only thing is that the mileage tends to change from one fill up to the next. 14.5-16.5 mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I lost my S10 in the hurricane.  I have been a Chevy guy but I really like this truck. Powerful roomy and great styling. You ride up high get the step bar to make it female friendly. Dodge did an awesome job putting this truck on the market.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: All anybody told me was "dont buy that truck." But after three years and 40k, my used (1998 model, purchased in 2003 with 60k on it) 1/2 ton Ram never let me down. Not once. Fuel effeciency is not great. I went from a 4 banger to the small block 8cyl Magnum, so the smaller engine was plenty of power. I towed 5800 pounds from Colorado to Pennsylvania, going 75 the whole way, no problem. Only complaint is that the anti-lock brakes tend to lock up when the weather is cold and real wet. Not winter, but late fall, early spring type stuff. It survived a winter in Crested Butte, Colorado and temperatures as low as -27 degrees. It still started. Good stuff.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review_Title: Don't  buy if you plan to tow!!
Review: I purchased this unit new, on price only.  It was left over from 1998 into 99 sales year and discounted deeply.  Now I know why.  12 - 15 mpg empty and 6 mpg towing a single car carrier (trailer gvw is 7000). It is a nice looking truck, but I could have purchased a diesel Ford and saved the difference just in fuel. Fuel guage failed recently, $800, thank you Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought this truck used with over 100K on it; rebuilt engine and tranny.  It's been a real workhorse.  Love my truck.  Hauls good, though not as well as a 'heavy duty'.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: The 1998 Dodge Ram is an exceptional truck.  There is more than enough power and is a VERY comfortable ride except that the back seat could be a little better. So far the only problem that I have had with it is the U joint going bad on the right side.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This has been a very good truck, very reliable. I haul building supplies etc. with it very often. I have a slide in camper. The truck seems to handle weight OK after air bags were installed. I find the steering to be poor and non responsive. Engine runs well and has adequate power, but fuel economy is much worse than expected.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I bought this truck new in Feb of 1998.I didnt order it because I needed a good reliable truck right then. My 85 Ford 4x4 was breaking down faster then I could keep up with it. So I bought my Dodge off the lot. The truck has preformed great. Very comfortable interior, great looking exterior. These trucks are like the vehicles of years gone by when you could tell the make and model from a 1/2 mile away. Now most vehicles all look the same. You have to walk up close to see the name badge to see what it is, but not the Dodge Ram.  You can tell it's a Ram from a mile away

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I have a 1998 Ram with a 5.9L V8.  I bought it stock and now it has 6" (3" Rancho, 3" body) of lift, 35" BFGoodrich All-Terrains.  I use my truck hard and it has proven to hold up to my abuse.  The only things I have had to fix are normal maintenance issues.  I tow a 5500lb K5 Blazer on an 18' trailer with my truck now, and I can pass F-150s with the Triton 5.4L while towing.  This is a great truck and will do what you need!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: Ihave dumped about 3000 in tranny alone,not to mention the rear end that sounds like i have giant tires on back (constant roar). Overall this truck looks great, however it is little more than a big fancy turd. Iwill never buy another dodge again.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this truck with 100,000 miles on it.  It was still in excellent shape and has given me three great years of service.  A few minor problems, but what vehicle with this many miles doesn't have a few quirks.  My only true complaint is that the fuel mileage is less than Ford or Chevy for the same size vehicle.  I would definitely buy this vehicle again, especially if it had better gas mileage.  Another inconveinence is the lack of leg room in the extended cab.  It is alright for children, but teenagers and adults are going to have problems.  My wife rolled this truck last week and it is still driveable.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I've been very happy with this vehicle. I originally bought it for its looks. But after 5 years I'll say I'm glad I have it for every other reason too. It has everything you'll ever need on a vehicle, passenger room, hauling room and great comfort too.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I love my truck! bought it in 98 no problems, had rotors changed at 52,000mi. strong 5.9, although it sips gas...awesome power! Dodge Trucks RULE!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Good From Far...But Far From Good!!
Review: My sister-in-law leased the truck new, I purchased the truck with 35000. In less than a year I have had to replace plugs & wires twice, flushed the fuel system twice (professionally), installed a K&N Air filter, and replaced the intake manifold gasket.  That was all to get rid of cylinder 8 misfires. The Front main seal was leaking oil at 38000 miles. The rear axle was shot at 37000 and the factory made me pay $500 to replace verything. The trim in the interior feels like It's made of cheap plastic..oh, it is. I thought the bigger 360 would have some guts to it...not really.  Im going for a Chevy or GMC...soon.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: This truck has been nothing but trouble

column1: since the first week! It has had three
trans' put in it in two yrs. It ended
up at $2560 to fix it all! Its been
stolen its been broken in to and all my
cd players were stolen. That cost me
950 to replace them. My advice is not
to buy one.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Dodge Trucks are Ram Tough?  My data says different.  Not only did the thing break down on me at 63K miles, but the so-called "power train" warranty really didn't cover the power train.  That is unless you don't consider the heads and head gasket as part of the engine.  Also had a pass through window that leaked, brakes and bed that squeaked,and had the fuel pump go out at 30K miles.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab LB
Review: I personaly love this vehichle, it's not only a blast to drive, but i turns everyone's head while im driving down the street.  I recomend this vehichle to every truck lover in the world.  I have 130,000 miles on my truck, and it is running stronger than ever!!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: What a great truck to drive! Power to spare, comfortable, quiet, roomy, rides like a luxury car, and the fit and finish were superb. I had planned on keeping that truck forever.(and I do mean forever) BUT! At 75k the rear end cashed it in and i never towed a thing.(2500.00) At 98k the transmission started slipping but I was nursing it along thinking about getting rid of it and at 100k miles on the nose bang! The engine blew (4500.00). I put a new engine in it and sold it a month later. Theres just no excuse for this these days.  Just ask a Toyota truck owner.  By the way I changed the oil every 3k.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I bought this new and I had only one major problem with the rear axle pinion bearing tore apart at 28,000 miles with just over 3 years on the truck($1000 of work). No 7/70 drivetrain warranty back then but now they do. I informed Dodge of this with lots of pictures but they wouldn't even help even though its something that should went out with so few miles and should have lasted a lifetime.Other than that, the truck has served me well and plan on keeping a long time.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Ever since the re-design of the '94 models, I lusted after one. Leased a loaded quad-cab. Then, reality hits.Had to replace rotors around 10,000 miles($500). Front bumper paint(Black Sport Model) started to bubble, flake.Now, the front bumper has rust spots all over. Dealer said "we've seen this happen before, but warranty doesn't cover". Had to replace speakers TWICE!Then, all was good until 55,000 miles(5.9 L - engine).Passing gear and poor fuel caused a sucked intake gasket, and COMPLETELY threw off the timing. Once again, no warranty coverage. But overall, the truck did it's job and it's had it's own hightlights as well.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I ordered this trk in Nvo of 97 & waited impatiently! The dealer had it cleaned and waxed siiting in the middle of the shop, waiting for it's Master! and the expirience goes on from there. Excellent TRUCK, and that is what I expected ..a TRUCK. Pulls like an ox, I pulled so many people out of the snow! People would ask just what kind of truck is that, or what model is that? It is my pride and joy Has won 1st place every year in the Mid Atlantic Jamboree 4 years in a row! Lots of mods done & alot of aftermarket available. What more can I say. A great Fun TRUCK!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Best truck on the market in '98. I

column1: enjoy the interior room and towing
capability. Looks great too.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Owned Fords for years, but bought 2 of these Dodge turkeys in 98. After warranty period expired they began to fall apart.  One needed the differential replaced at 50k, major AC work and major transmission problems shortly thereafter.  Leaking brake slave cylinders.  Second one was fine until 79k when the computer failed which also costs big bucks to replace. Both trucks see light duty & regular services.  Won't buy another Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: With nearly 58,000 miles on my truck I've had only one major issue to date.  The dealership had the truck back to me within 48 hours and since all has been perfect.  I wish there was a little more variety available in fabric options.  Otherwise no complaints at all.  This truck takes me everywhere without questions.  The sound system is above average. The fun factor is WAY ABOVE average.  If you're looking for fuel economy WHY are you looking at a full size truck?

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This vehicle is drivn mostly highway miles and very,very little off road. I have had to replace the air conditioning system, transmission, several fuel injectors just to mention a few items. VERY costly to keep on the road. Don't recomend this truck to anyone who needs reliability in their transportation!!
