Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I owned my Dodge Ram for 2 years.  I

column1: loved the design and comfort. After 2
years and about 40 days in the shop for
the same problem over and over again
(transmission) I finally gave up.  The
Dodge service people should be renamed
Lip Service people.  Dodge service is
by far the worst service department of
any of the big three auto makers.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Purchased my 1998 1500 Quad Cab Sport (5.9) as a dealer leftover for $24000 in December of 1998. Price was so cheap I purchased the dealer extended 7year/75,000 mile warranty for an additional $1200. I havent needed it. With 60,000 miles and regular dealer maintainence it has not had ONE mechanical problem. The original tires even lasted 50,000 miles! The truck is a joy to own and drive, very comfortable ride (smooth on the highway) and plenty of power. With the tow package, it cruises smoothly at 80 mph on the highway, barely turning 2400 rpm, and returns a solid 20 mpg at that speed!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: All maintenance done on schedule.  Towing has only been performed with overdrive OFF.  NEVER exceeded or even came close to rated towing capacity.  Transmission after-cooler for additional protection installed.  Transmission failed at 30K, 75K, and 100K.  EVERY time it has been the torque converter clutch as the initial cause.  Rear differential needed work at 25K and 60K.  Transfer case failure at 75K.  DO NOT shift on the fly, it will ruin the transfer case eventually, even when ONLY performed below 30mph.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review_Title: As good a truck as any (Better than GM)
Review: I love this truck. I hate that they

column1: changed the body style in 2002. It
could have better brakes. I have
changed mine every 15000 miles. I had a
main fuse blew and that is it. I have
been very happy with the towing
package. I pull a 5000# boat with it
and it pulls it out of a steap ramp. In
all I give this truck a score of 95%.
Gas mile could be better but all trucks
could be but then how would it pull my
boat. (and it is the 5.9l 360)

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review_Title: Don't listen to the negative reviews
Review: I've had this car for a year and a half and let me tell you it's a great truck. Never had any major problems with it at all. Great on and off road truck. Having both a Yukon and a dodge ram, the dodge definitley gives you a better ride when you are going off road. Would recommend to anyone.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: This truck is a nightmare. I've had several full brake jobs, calipers, and master cylinder. Heating coil went out with 80000 miles. Now, after 6 times to ALLEN SAMUELS DODGE in Fort Worth Texas, I'm told that I need a new engine. Their suppossed 5-star service is truely pathetic. After several heated exchanges with service advisor, manager, I talked to the general manager, and was told that this is normal for the RAM1500 with 134000 miles. He actually tried to sell me another Dodge, I wouldn't buy another Dodge if you held a gun to my head!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I, too, was quite surprised to read all the negative reviews of this truck.  I have owned this vehicle for over 4 years now and haven't had any major problems that weren't covered by the standard warranty.  I understand the problem that was reported with the steering column.  I had to have it replaced shortly after buying the vehicle because the shift lever was acting flakey and sometimes wouldn't come out of park.  The brake rotors could be heftier; I've had problems with them warping and the most I tow is a 2000 lb popup camper.  It's a simple job to take them off and take them to be touched up at the local garage. Overall, it's been a great truck.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: This truck has been driven HARD for 130,000 miles and I haven't had a single problem.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab SB
Review: I just read a bunch of negative reviews of the truck I own and I have to speak up. I have 70K miles on my 98 quad cab and have never (knock on wood) had a single problem with it. New front brake pads at 45K, new tires at 55K, new battery at 63K, rear drum shoes are about due now. That's it. This is a great truck. Check the TSB's since 1998: Dodge: 1, Ford F-150: 200+!!! All this, and I regularly pull a 3000# boat around like it's nothing! Get both sides of the story before you buy.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab ST 2dr Extended Cab SB
Review: Nothing but troubles with this Dodge.

column1: Seat handles brake. Need to replace
brakes every 10-12000 miles. (poor
design I guess). The gas gauge stopped
working. The water pump and thermostat
gaskets are leaking water. and the
thing is using a quart of oil every
2000 miles. What a piece. All this and
I have only 38000 miles on it. Oh and
have always babied it with oil and
mello 6 mile trips to work. Oh and all
this came right after the warranty ran
out .How convenient for Dodge !!!!!!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 2dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: I've had to replace numerous parts some of which include the steering column, power steering pump, right front wheel bearing and front brakes.  All of this work was done before I even had 40,000 miles.  Now I have a problem in the rear differential which I was quoted $1100 to fix.  Fortunately my lease is up next month.  This truck has cured me of ever purchasing a Chrysler product again.  I purchased 15,000 miles a year and now with all the problems, I was unable to use all the miles.  If your considering a Chrysler product it would be advisable to look at a different make.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Extended Cab Laramie SLT 4dr Extended Cab 4WD SB
Review: Bought New in 1998. All highway miles.

column1: have replaced air conditioning compressor {2 times} air conditioner evaporator {1 time} and the transmission
just went out. Not to mention several sensors & other small problems.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I like smaller trucks/cars.I stayed away from trucks bc I just thought of them as a gas hog.I am a bit of a power junky too.So if i was going to get a truck I wanted power too.I was looking at the Dodge 5.7hemi motor for it's power.I test drove a 2007 hemi and a 2010 4.7 and thought they were both the 5.7L until the salesman pointed it out to me. I got a deal on a 2009 4.7 dodge quad cab and love it.It can pull a loaded 16ft trailer tractor with ease( about 4000lbs).It can pull trailer and still get 15mpg.I'm gettting 24mpg highway and about 16 suburb driving. I drives like a car and is very comfortable.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Bought a Ram after owning all the other brands over the years.Test drove all brands and the solid, comfortable, quiet ride combined with the 100,000 mile transferable powertrain warranty swung my vote.Also got a lifetime powertrain warranty as long as I keep the truck, no other manufacturer offered that!!I've put over 40k miles on the truck now with no problems.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have a 2009 dodge with 40000 miles and the engine is needing replaced. I was told there is no transferable warranty. If this is true I will never buy a dodge again. dodge the dodge you will cursre the day you bought it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Totally let down - no customer loyalty
Review: MANY owners have complained of a horrible MDS droan and vibration as well as a differential whine.Me included.These two conditions were A) not present during test drives or first 3000K miles (I wouldnt have purchased had I felt these issues!), B) not all owners have the problems and C) those that do have it to varying degrees, some really bad.However Chrysler Dodge, after not being able to fix the issues, has claimed its "AS PER DESIGN" and normal.As per design, to me, would mean by definition that it was present from day 1, all trucks had the condition, and all had it to the same degree.See full report at http://www.dodgeramhell.com/

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: 27,000 miles since August 2009. Pretty good on gas (average about 15-17 mpg). Plenty, and I mean PLENTY of power from the HEMI; 0-60 in under 7 seconds! This is a full-size truck! Absolutely in love with this motor! Dark gray with the 20's, turns a LOT of heads when it's clean! 4x4 works great here in Michigan. Interior design is very attractive, I like it better than the Fords and Chevys! Front seats are very supportive, all of the controls are within good reach. However, I tend to get backaches after long trips. Better stock sound system than the Infinity on our 2010 Journey. Very quiet ride(excluding the amazing exhaust note!), as well as a solid ride. Handles pretty good. Very versatile

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: It was scary at first, but after 8 years I went back to Dodge from Chevy. The redesign in 2009 was well worth it. I had a choice between a 2010 or the 2009, and for the price bought the 2009 (second hand). I am greatly pleased with the truck, especially the fuel economy. It has the 4.7 liter engine, plenty of hp, I got average 26 mpg driving from New Orleans a few weeks ago.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is one hell of a truck. You get much more value and quality with this truck than you do with other manufacturers.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: One of the best trucks I've owned. The Hemi is a much better engine than the Toyota.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my Laramie back in the summer when they were nearly giving them away.  I traded an 03 Tahoe with 120,000, absolutely nothing wrong with the Tahoe, except it wasn't really a truck.  Eight months later and the only time I really miss the SUV is when going on trips.  My Dodge drives well and is comfortable, but I miss the interior cargo space on trips.  The truck's passenger seat has developed an annoying squeak when there are any road imperfections, and it is getting worse with time and use.  Also the satellite radio is more susceptible to signal blockage than my wife's last two Acura's or the XM in my old Tahoe.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've bought around 15 new trucks in my lifetime and I have to tell you this is the best truck I have ever owned!! I switched from Chevy's to Dodge in 1977 and have been with Dodge since. I traded a 2003 SLT quadcab,Hemi, with a 3:73 axle, and a 5 speed manual tranny with 90,000 miles on it. No major problems in the 6 years I owned it.Traded it for a 2009 Quadcab,TRX 4x4,cloth bucket seats and a floor mounted shifter.Electric rear slider,frostplug heater,aluminum wheels with 275x70x17" tires.Anti-spin differential with a 3:92 axle.Color is Sunburst Orange. My old truck had a towing capacity of only 8500 lbs and this one has a towIng capacity of 10,000 lbs.Dodge has a "WINNER". No regrets!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: This is the best vehicle I've ever owned
Review: I very happy with my purchase. The truck has a ride like a car and is a pleasure to drive. The 5.7 Hemi has plenty of power and the fuel economy is good for a truck. I have hauled several cars with a car trailer and a 23 foot boat with no problems. The interior is great and I get a lot of compliments. I have owned Ford trucks in the past but this is by far the best truck I have owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is fantastic!  The quad cab interior is very spacious and comfortable.  There is loads of storage.  The ice coolers in the rear floors are great to keep bottled water cold on a long trip.  The ride is as smooth as my previous Lincoln, which is very impressive for a truck.  I live on a dirt road and the ride is even smooth on this road.  Cabin is very quiet, I would also compare it to the cabin of the Lincoln.  Have taken on a long trip and averaged 17.5 mpg between 75 and 80 mph.  City average is around 15 mpg which could be better.  Have the big horn Hemi.  Can I say wow what power!  Uconnect for cell phones is a great feature to be able to talk hands free.  If you are looking fo

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Nice truck, ride is great if you are a first time truck owner and not used to a leaf spring rear end. No mechanical issues yet, towing is lacking badly, very sluggish bracking and motor is def. not made to pull any load off line. cannot complain about gas mielage. Also a few cosmetic issues, little things like weather stripping and cheap cover over chrome accents. For 30,000 plus they could have a little better quality control.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is my 3rd Dodge truck in 20 years. My last new 1997 Dodge was a jewel, never a problem, dependable as a swiss watch. My 09 Dodge has 21000 miles currently,dead reliably like the 97. I LOVE the truck, the Hemi is powerfull gets great mileage. Interior is top notch Ride is superb Buyers, BEWARE of some dealers that insist on rear end oil changes at 15000 miles. Victorville motors( VICTORVILLE CALIFORNIA) insisted that i change oil ($175.00) when the factory recommends rear end oil be changed ONLY in severe duty situations every 15000 miles. Spark plugs need changing every 30K miles( all 16 of them) at about $250.00. Read the owners manual first and save money

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Bought the ST model with the 4.7 liter V8 Flex Fuel engine after being impressed with its power on the test drive. Drove all the makes and the killer warranty on this truck won me over. This is my first Dodge after owning GM, Ford and Nissan trucks over the years. Very smooth ride on the highway and on gravel roads, very little wind noise. Got 17mpg doing 75-80 on last road trip. Pitched the steel wheels and bought after-market 18s in black to complete the look. I do get the occasional question; Is it a 4x4? The body height seems lower on the new design. Overall, love the truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab ST 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck does not ride like a truck.  It a bit of a nice car feel to it. The suspension feels almost as good as my wife's magnum.  The 4.7L engine has some good pull to it and the new interior materials are better quality than past builds.  Definitely the best dodge truck I have owned to date.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The performance of this p. U. W 3:92 axle is almost unbelievable. Ride is very gd and the truck is quieter than the ram I traded. This is my 6th ram and everyone was excellent. No Major problems with any. 2009 is the best yet. A friend has a hemi w/vvt etc. And claims 19 mpg to and from work. Wld rec. This pick-up to any and all.    Don't forget lifetime drivetrain warranty.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: I Really Like My Dodge Ram
Review: I've only owned it a month or so but I'm very happy with the truck. I test drove Ford and Chevy and between the warranty and dealer deal, as well as the great ride and styling I was sold. I tow a trailer and it tows very well. I wish it had a few extra options like a camera and better stereo but I'm still content. I had it detailed and the paint actually looks very good. The trim and body all line up well and the interior noise is low for a truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: 10,000 miles and I love this truck
Review: Now that I have 10K miles on the truck,I can state that this is the best car/truck I have ever owned (I have owned VW/SAAB/Subaru/ISUZU/Toyota/GM/FORD). Getting between 20 and 22 on the hwy. The hemi is astounding for power but also is refined/smooth and economical (mpg does drop in the city to about 14-16). Interior is very comfortable for long trips. Very nimble for such a large truck and I don't think twice about taking it to the grocery store or shopping. Not one thing needed to be fixed since delivery. I am absolutely amazed with the quality. I love the 120v power inverter and all of the little thoughtful touches; Dodge really went out of their way to make it livable.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Best truck on the road hands down
Review: Been a long time dodge fan. My father headed up the glass plant for years in Detroit for Chrysler so I have been hooked on dodge for years. Owned 4 rams now, by far this is the best one. Comfort is top rated and driveability is outstanding. Hold on when you put the petal to the metal - it will set you back in the seat. More leg room in rear plus an added surprise vents for the backseat for cold air to reach whoever's in the backseat. Towing my boat is no problem, sometimes I forget it is back there. So you can keep your fords and your gms also no foreign trucks for me - dodge is back and going to be around for a long time to come.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Dodge ram 1500 st quad cab 5.7 hemi
Review: Jumped on this after seeing 10,000 dollars off in my local market/This is a ram 1500 ST quad cab w/hemi and the 3.92 gears. First of the new coil suspension makes it ride like a couch on wheels.The engine is well super quick, i have pulled off 0-60 in under 6 seconds.Mine came with the 3.92 gears so is very capable of towing 10,000 pnds plus with ease. This truck sits higher and is wider than all other full size out there so if size an issue this may not be for you.' But for me coming out of my third Honda accord, "which i loved" it actually is more comfy but the gas well it is a big truck and i can squeeze 17 or 18 to the gallon, but hey it's a huge truck . A+ Dodge ram has a great truck!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I got my Dodge truck after owning F150's for 15 years.  I tried to buy a new F150 but the Dodge dealer bet the Ford's offer by several thousand dollars.  I have had my Dodge for 1 month and have 3700 miles.  I went on a vacation and it was a great ride.  Plenty of power I bought a Hemi and am very impressed. When I test drove the Dodge I liked the ride a lot better than any F150 that I have had.  The breaking on the Dodge is much better than on the F150 and speed, the Dodge is far greater.   My wife told me that she liked riding in the Dodge much better than in my past F150 trucks. I can not tell you about the reliability but the life time warranty was one of the reasons I bought it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: WHY DID I BUY ANOTHER DODGE PRODUCT!?
Review: i should have learned after owning my 1997 dodge ram 1500 4x4 and all the known  problems with it that daimler chrysler knew about but never did anything about. plenum gaskets every 2 years, trac bars every year, tranny problems every 20k miles, and tons of cash spent for service after the warranty expired and i took care of this like a baby, but always had mega problems with it, and here i go and buy another one! someone want to give me a swift kick!? now anyone buying a new one prior to the bankruptcy will be stuck with any problems encountered. my cab is starting to leak in this truck and the dealership is trying to say i keep my window open every storm since they cannot find any leaks!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Dodge Ram drives great and I like most things about it.  I have just discovered a tear in the seat perforation and on close inspection found that my leather seats are really not leather at all!!!  I am so upset, because I was told and sold leather---not cheap vynal.  I only have 6000 miles on this truck and the vynal seating is already tearing apart.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is actually the SLT Quad cab with the Hemi.  This is my first truck ever.  Still in shock that I actually traded my nice VW for this be we needed more hauling capability.  I've had it 8 hours and 70 miles, but I'm really impressed by the feel of how it drives.  I thought I'd be creeped out by driving something this big, but I can now see why these things are so popular.  Still babying it since I'm not used to it, and it's so new, but so far so good!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: What a truck.  I have owned 6 dodge trucks this is by far the best.  I love the looks the comfort(Cowboy Cadillac)and the gas mileage(22.5 miles to the Gallon)WOW!!!!  Plus the great deal I recieved.  35000 MSRP Drive out 21200.  What a great deal.  I looked @ Toyota,  Liked the trucked to pricey.  Also looked @ Chevrolet.  Nice truck but cheaply made.  The 09 RAM the only truck for me...

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I'm stunned how nice this truck is!  I was going to buy a Toyota.  But, the price, 0% financing, warranty, and technical features in the new 2009 made the Ram a clear winner.  Now, having driven the truck in town and on one road trip, I'm stunned how nice it is.  The highlights: very quiet, drives like a dream, rides great, handles great, very comfortable, and oh and it's a truck!  It's hard to believe how great this truck, especially when you consider the things you don't see; lifetime powertrain warranty, stability control, traction control, air bags, and so many other features.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Have only 200 miles so can't say anything about long term reliability. This is a dream to drive. You feel you are in a (very big) luxury car.  Hwy mileage is 20mpg if I can believe the display; city it really drops -- to about 14/15. On the hwy you can listen to classical music at low volume as  the cab is so quiet. The switch between 4 and 8 cyls is unnoticeable. Initial delivery quality is excellent as is the fit/finish of the truck. The hemi is very smooth and pulls strong but I am babying it until it has at least 300mi. Definitely would recommend the hemi instead of the smaller engine due to mpg and smoothness.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've had my 2009 Dodge Ram for 4 days now. I test drove the other full size American pick-ups (F150 & Silverado). By far, the Dodge offered the most bang for your buck. Both Chevy and Ford were also not willing to author the same juicy deal that Dodge ultimately gave me. The interior is really nice, even if you can't afford the Laramie.  The Hemi power is ridiculous and the ride is smooth. Standard safety features are impressive. Uconnect and Sirius are great. Plenty of room in the Quad Cab for my 6 year old. MPG on freeway is impressive. Feels like I'm driving a semi with the higher road stance. My wife even likes to drive it.  All in all, buy American and go with the Dodge Ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased this truck March 10, 2009 and now have a little over 2000 miles on it.  It rides much better than any pickup that I have ever driven or riden in.  It rides better than most cars.  The performance is outstanding with plenty of power.  Fuel economy is not bad for an engine of this size and power.  The Hemi is very smooth and the MDS is seamless.  I love the look of the truck and the interior is comparable to my wife's Cadillac CTS.  I have the 3.92 rear end and was concerned about fuel economy but I have gotten as high as 21.5 MPG with it and this axle has great towing ability.  I hope that the merger with Fiat will not ruin this great truck. I am very happy with this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I took my wife and kids out one Saturday to look for a 4x4 quad cab.  The truck had to seat six.  Started with Toyota, then Nissan, then Ford, then Chevy, then Dodge.  I got what I wanted for $26,000 with the Hemi.  This truck was the best deal for the money.  We took it out on the test drive and the acceleration is amazing.  It put both my wife and I back in our seats.  We traded in the Nissan Xterra we were driving for this.  We love it!  It's a beautiful truck and the price is about $10,000 less than the others.  Plus, Obama backed my warranty for LIFE!  God bless America.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab SLT 4dr Quad Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've owned this truck for 2500 miles now, and I can honestly say I probably will never have to buy a new truck. The best ride, and nicest interior I've ever experienced in a truck. I bought my SLT with the 5.7 HEMI, best decision I've made. Just when you think this truck's going to bog down on an incline, that typical HEMI growl kicks in and you're taken to the next level. I've driven Highway, city streets and off-road, anywhere in this truck is a pure joy.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: A great year for the RAM
Review: This is a SLT Quad cab With the 5.7 Hemi. I have to say, this truck was long overdue. After test driving all of the 2009 competitors, this monster handles all of them in just about every catagory. Where else can you get 390HP w/407FTlb torque and still get 14 City & 20 Hwy? The rear coil-overs make rear leaf springs a thing of the past. I pull a 3000 lb boat&trailer, and have never used the Tow/haul feature. Build quality this year is drastically improved inside and out. This was the last truck I had in mind when I started shopping, but its in my driveway today.(with no regrets so far)

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Best riding truck I have ever owned. I have had GM, Toyota and Ford, this is by far the best.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Great combo of power and mileage
Review: I have owned Chevy and Ford but this Dodge is the real deal. I chose the 3.21 rear gear because I mainly do highway. Easily will do 22mpg and have gotten as high as 24.9. Great power. Will really move down the road when necessary.  Ride is great and even my Chevy loving 12 year old is now a Dodge fan!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have been a die hard Toyota owner for the past 10 years and this Dodge has sold me over. The 5.7 Hemi has more than enough power and is exceptionally smooth. The new rear coil suspension handles bumps as well as it handles daily driving. It's worth buying this truck just for the suspension upgrades. Trim appointments are solid. Excellent gauge and comfort control placement.  Driving this truck is too easy. The body balance and overall control belies the weight of this vehicle.  If your contemplating buying an 08' instead of a 09' don't do it. It's clear that Chrysler dumped a lot of technology into the 09's. The difference is night and day.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: My last 4 vehicles purchased have been Lexus and Toyota (ES 330, Sequoia, Tundra and a run-about Corolla). I was going to buy another Tundra until I saw the Ram on the road. I test drove and was sold immediately. The ride is amazing, you actually forget you are in a truck. Everything about this truck is big. The Ram has won me over. And it feels good to buy American! My truck also came with a locking tailgate. It's an option

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Just can't believe how good the 2009 Ram 1500 is! I would put this quality engineering against BMW, Mercedes, Toyota or anybody out there. Simply put, the best. You gotta drive this to believe it. Rides like a Mercedes with incredible power, speed, acceleration, comfort, you name it. Job well done Dodge engineers. Get the Hemi V8 and the 5 speed automatic, essential options. Everything else get what you like, they are all good, depends on what you like. Really nice interior overall, well thought out.  If you want the deal of your life, get it now. Really unbelievable buying opportunities out there.  Best vehicle out there and I have driven most everything.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab Laramie 4dr Quad Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: The new Ram is an exciting new vehicle in the Dodge lineup. The design is aggressive the interior is beautiful the motor is solid and it's incredibly quiet on the highway. The rear 4 link suspension makes this truck ride so smooth it feels like a luxury vehicle. The wrap around console keeps everything within reach and everything is where you expect it to be. The nighttime display is very nice. Hands down I drove an F-150 and a Silverado and this was the smoothest and best looking truck of them all. Also the price was the cheapest of all of them! You can't go wrong with the new 2009 Ram

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Like it was designed for me
Review: Love this truck! I ordered the regular cab short bed 5.7L Hemi 4x4 Sport. I've owned Chevy's and Fords, but never a Dodge. Did a lot of research before this purchase. For the first time in a long time, it's fun driving to and from work. This is a hot rod that can work as well. It corners, accelerates, hauls, and pulls a landscape trailer like it isn't even there. As others have said, the ride is phenomenal. Plenty of interior storage space, even though it's a regular cab. Did I mention I love this truck?

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab SLT 2dr Regular Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I'm a week into owning my new Dodge Ram 1500, and I have to say I'm very happy.  I have the regular cab, 2WD, short-bed version with the 5.7 liter Hemi engine.  From inside, outside and any angle you care to look from, this is a beautiful truck.  Dodge stylists did a great job of working out every detail.  The ride is the best I've ever experienced in a truck.  The Hemi engine is wickedly strong, too.  Very easy to get a speeding ticket in this thing, I think.   The interior is nicely thought-out, with lots of storage and an attractive dash.  I found a comfortable driving position almost immediately.  Outside noise barely intrudes at all.   All-in-all, an excellent choice.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: The best truck I've owned. 62yr. old man.
Review: Not a hard core rock crawler. but great for  road  4x4 use. but of course that's not what I got it for. great safe vehicle. comfort near lux. car. strong like a truck/SUV. safeta wise.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I got my 09 laramie crew cab close to 5 years ago. it's the first truck I have owned so I can't compare to any other brand of truck first hand. but from the stand point of living with it for a little bit I have to say it has been a great vehicle. I got the truck in 2011 with about 29,000 miles on it, now it has about 128,000 miles on it and runs amazing for the mileage. here and there it has had it's issues, the pinions were bad on these years which made them recall them, mine didn't get it done in time and caused my differential to blow. was unfortunate but the dealer was great with repairs. the exhaust manifolds also cracked at around 85,000 miles, at first I thought was a isolated issue but turns out it's common for these trucks. also if you ever have to change the headlights it's a pain compared to older models. used to be just a couple of bolts and the housing came out, now the grill has to come out and a clip thats in the wheel well has to be pulled. other than those issues I have loved my ram. I have driven it from coast to coast and to Canada on multiple occasions and never got uncomfortable. the coil suspension has really given it a awesome ride. as far as fuel economy goes there is always room for improvement but it's a lot better than most of my friends trucks. I put a bullydog tuner on the truck for the fuel economy about a year ago. in town still sucks, roughly 13 mpg. but highway miles is awesome, I regularly get 23-25 mpg at 70 mph. as far as towing goes, the thing is a beast, I pull a boat that weighs about 8,500 pounds through the texas hill country every summer and it does it with out issue, I also once pulled a 6,000 pound trailer from Toronto to central texas, 27 straight hours at 70 miles an hour the whole way at it never overheated on my once.  all in all the truck isn't perfect, but it has been reliable and never left me stranded, it pulls like a train, and sips fuel on the highway. I love this truck and plan to drive it till the wheels fall off. I would recommend ram to anyone who is looking for a truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Truck had no problems until it hit 80,000 miles. My radiator hoses gave way. 7000 miles after that my boyfriend who is a mechanic decided to run a compression test on the cylinders, to find my truck literally was limping on 2 cylinders. We were going to rebuild the motor but when we pulled the oil pan off we found huge shards of metal shavings (chunks) and that factory torqued Bolts were finger tight. Not for nothing but we had the truck maintained at the dealership from date of purchase in 09 every 3000 miles, on the dot. No reason this motor should've crapped out at 87000. Replaced the motor with an atk remanufactured motor $3000 dollars later (no labor we did it ourselves). Get the motor in, on test drive notices the rear end was whining. So, ordered a rear dif from Yukon, opened up the stock rear end to find nothing but broken pieces in the cover. Looked like a bag of change. The Yukon rear end is awesome now. Once replaced that I was driving to work to now notice an engine knock. Called atk (where I got motor) and was told "keep driving it, it'll go away". 200 miles later blows a rod through the oil pan . Pistons, crank, rings all internals in 2 cylinders grenaded. Long story short, check compression, if it's bad part ways.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Good power, Comfortable ride. Does not have a cabin filter, contaminated fluid and faulty sway bar links will cause it to pull left or right. Recall on the heating and ventilation actuators; If not repaired causes non response from the windshield wipers, door locks, 4x4 selector, lights, and ventilation fan - Also causes the TCP to illuminate. Recall on the manifold for exhaust leak. Causes poor gas mileage, also piston knock when the engine is cold. leak could cause overheating or a blown piston.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: We bought our 2009 with about 50,000 miles on it.Had nothing but issues from it since we bought it.Had it into the shop 7 times within a year to have different stuff fixed.For the price that this vehicle costs, there is absolutly no reason to have that many problems out of it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I was looking for a Ford truck, I told the salesman no Dodge for me, and then saw a used 09 TRX crew with 6k miles we took it for a test drive and wow it drives great very smooth, i towed my 63 galaxy from FLA to NJ with no trouble. I had an 05 F-150 with a 4.6 before,the 4.7 on the Dodge is much smoother and has a lot more power and a little better fuel mileage, the interior is very nice also the last gen Dodge trucks looked very cheep on the inside.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I told my wife when I hit 50 it was time to trade wife or truck. I got the 2009 1500 Laramie. I have installed a 3" lift kit and front in leveling kit with 285 Goodrich TA, chrome running boards, tonneau topper and cold air induction system. This truck will stop traffic with the looks. I have 16 year olds to 65 years tell me it is one of the most beautiful trucks they have every seen. The black paint with the gold flack really stands out. I had never owed a Dodge until now and man this is all the truck I ever wanted. Move over Ford and Chevy Dodge is headed your way.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: Great Truck! You will be surprised!
Review: First let me say that I am not brand loyal! If it fits my needs I buy it. I traded my 08 Chevy Crew for this truck. I was going to buy another Chevy till I drove this. It was very impressive in the beginning, after 20K it's even better than expected. I get 15-16 in town, and as much as 20.5 hwy, with a Hemi, 3.90 gears? That impressive. No problems with anything yet. Well the goodyears stink! I believe this is one of the last trucks I will buy. Till they come out with a diesel in it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Up to this day the ram was my favorite car. 07-12-10 I have a knocking under the dash, loud! Dealer said parts for repair are on back order. Maybe parts will arrive late August. 60 days. Are they out of their minds, I'm afraid to drive it. And what about my trip up north with my boat? Maybe Obama has a solution for this too. Not a happy trucker!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had a vibration problem since I bought the truck. It is a 1500 Laramie top of the line fully loaded. It came with a bent drive shaft, four bad rims, bad tires, poor paint (dirt in the paint, clear coat runs) Rough edges around the rear bumper. Very poor quality control. The regional manager says the truck is supposed to vibrate when you go down the road. It feels like you have a bent rim. I have had no support in trying to get it fixed right. I will never buy a Dodge product again. It's a shame, because they designed a very nice truck. It is the lack of support and the poor quality control that came with the truck I am unhappy about. Also the dealers I have used in Florida have poor service.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck is awesome! Obviously the styling is great on the exterior, but the interior is just as great! My truck has a center console on the floor and bucket seats that are very comfortable. I got a crew cab because I typically have people in the back seat, and this truck has more than enough room in back. The 5.7L Hemi is crazy powerful, and the acceleration is always smooth from any speed. Gas mileage for a truck this size is top notch. I average 14 city/19 highway. Cant beat that for a BIG fullsize truck! Also drove an '07 Sierra, and I liked it, but this Ram is the baddest truck on the road!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I traded in my 2004 Dodge Ram to get the 2009 Dodge Ram last summer from a dealership that was closing and HAD to sell everyone but the closing date (read:AMAZING DEAL). I loved my 2004 truck and would still be driving it if not for the great deal. I got the Hemi this time which offers noticeable improvement in performance. The ride is smooth and comfortable no matter what I have in the back. Just the other day I was carrying 1850 lbs of stone for a construction job in the truck bed. While I don't recommend it, the truck handled it like a champ.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: looks great drives great and fab power super handling and awesome appearance i love it

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've owned Chevy trucks all my life and when I bought the Ram I felt like I was cheating on my wife.  This is the best truck I've ever owned.  The ride and fit/finish is excellent. I should have got the Nav and U-Tunes.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: 2 tone paint on my Laramie is awesome. Leather heated seats and nav. I love this truck. I use it for work (own landscaping business). Can't see myself driving anything else. Didn't have interaction with anyone else at dealership other than my salesman. Seemed like a great guy, knew his stuff and was helpful. Get a Ram and you wont be sorry.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This is a family vechile. The confort and space that you need for travel and camping or hunting fun.  When I was looking at other truck most of them felt like a work truck but this truck has the confort of SUV.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I replaced my 2001 Ram 1500 with the new 2009.  No similarities at all.  This was a huge leap forward for Dodge.  The hemi is powerful and smooth.  I am not a fan of the variable valve timing which saves on gas mileage by cutting out 4 cylinders when in low load situations.  The only way to override this feature is to use the tow/haul setting which gives better shift points but it also won't let the transmission shift into 6th gear.  I love the new look with the chrome package.  This is a big truck and I recommend the side steps for easier entry and exit.  Plenty of room inside with the new crew cab.  The ride and handling while towing are excellent but power is lacking.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: 2009 SLT crew cab Hemi Bighorn.  The '09 is a night and day difference from the previous generation; there is NO comparison.  This truck rides like a Cadillac, and has more interior room to boot.  With 390 horses on tap, you will surprise more than a few people off the line.  This is the quietest vehicle I have ever been in, you can hardly hear the road noise.  The seats are comfortable & supportive, there is loads of storage. The back seat area has 2 in-floor storage bins plus the ones under the rear seat.  There are 5 cup holders.  Thanks to MDS, the gas mileage is excellent for a full size truck.  I get 13-16 city, 20-26 hwy @ 55 w/ cruise set, around 18 city/hwy combined.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: The Best Truck in the World
Review: I had my 2009 Ram 1500 Laramie special ordered to my spec.  This is the best truck I've ever driven.  The driver's seat makes you feel like a pilot.  Its got plenty of available power and all the creature comforts one could imagine.  The styling is bar none the best in the industry.  Chrysler integrated function with design, the curves are for more than just looks.  Aerodynamics help give the truck better fuel economy and less wind resistance.  My only regret is not ordering the camera for backing up to trailers.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've test driven older Dodge pick- ups... eewwww. Then I was reading a positive magazine review about the new '09 models and the changes they've made. (i.e. coil springs) A few weeks later I saw an ad for an '09 it was $26,500 with free financing. What the heck. Drove it and bought it. WOW! Now I love it. My only complaint is I should have got the Hemi. (But, atleast I saved about $3,000.) Also, the extended cab is plenty of room. Why spend extra for the Quad cab?

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love my new Dodge Ram. I had a 1997 Dodge Ram a few years back and can't believe that Dodge has completely remodeled and improved the Ram ten-fold. I finally, got an Hemi. I'm very empressed with the Hemi power and ride quality of this truck. I'm in the Army and I move/drive long distance, often. The storage and ride help my family and I on the drives. If you are in the truck market buy a Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Patience has landed the best truck on the road today. The 2009 Laramie crew cab is my 3rd Dodge and by far blows the doors in of all the others. Quiet interior lets you actually hear the Alpine stereo or the rumble of the dual exhaust. Comfortable leather seats with the center console is the way to go. Styling interior features with all the beels and whistles, added storage compartments throughout in the design are A+. The comfort of the ride is near flawless. No more wheel hop on the highway or spinning rear wheels in the rain with the coil suspension. Power everywhere - the performance of the hemi shows in increased fuel economy. Way too much to list for this review. Lifetimepowertrain!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I Was shopping for a F-150/Tundra I decided to check out Ram 1500 before purchasing one of the others. Boy am I glad I did. Simply put this truck is AWESOME! Rides like a luxury car (rear coil suspension), 5.7 Hemi is unbelievable in power,acceleration & torque. Interior design is great with regard to layout of instrument panel, dials etc. Interior is very comfortable with great visability all around.I should point out that this is  my personal car (not a working pick-up) and the only thing this bed sees are my golf bag/groceries and an occasional trip to Home Depot. Man I love this truck!!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I came from a 04 Titan to this I loved the Titan but they seem to have some issues and I got the life time powertrain and bumper to bumper on the Dodge which no one else offered. The power and comfort is great. One touch of the throttle and man your off like a shot but you only notice it if your looking at you odometer otherwise you think your on a Sunday drive. The Titan had a lot of get up and go but man not like the new hemi. I got the remote starter which is coming in real Handy in the north right now. The only thing I miss from the Titan is the towing mirrors. I plan on keeping this for a while so I got the slt with 17 in wheels and the reg. Muffler to keep replacement cost down to a min.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck rides smooth on and off the road. In the driver seat you feel like you command the road. Its big, powerful and yet gets good highway mileage. Everyone who has ridden in my truck has nothing but compliments. The Laramie package is just awesome.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've owned Ford trucks, Chevy avalanches, and numerous cars. This is by far the "most" fun vehicle I've owned. Sleek styling, power, practical to boot. My favorite story is a guy I work with had a new Tundra. As we travel a lot together in the office we take turns driving. He used to make fun of my "Dodge". After some time I let him drive it while out on the road. Now, he wants to drive it all the time. Loves the acceleration (can't keep his foot out of that Hemi) and how great it drives overall. I've already put 22000 miles on it this year and it's still as fun to drive as the day I bought it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: This truck has super power and comfort.  Fun to drive.  Performance is fantastic.  Fuel economy on the highway is very good, in city driving not so good.  I like everything about this truck.  I got the Big Horn Package, wished I'd gotten Leather Seats and Navigation.  Quietest and smoothest Dodge I've ever owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: These guys hit a home run. I want to bake a ton of chocolate chip cookies and send them to the factory to say thanks.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I'm sure glad this is an american product.If it had been built by the japanese I'd have to believe all the hype the media always gives to their vehicles. On the highway ,with the new hemi, I'm getting 19 mpg. And with the power it's a joy! Can we have a drumroll....this truck is a winner...

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just got my new truck I have always been a dodge truck fan but this one it most comfortable smoothest dodge I have ever owned I highly recommend it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Purchased this truck in May 2009.  The ride is great, the power is excellent. Love this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: F-150 watch out! The Ram is coming
Review: Who would have ever thought that a bona-fide Ford guy would find a Dodge Ram parked in the driveway? Not I for sure, yet there is one and I love it! The styling of this truck is top notch both inside and out. The reviews, both professional and consumer are dead on. Sometimes a product lives up to the hype, this one surely does. Ride, performance and handling are the best I have ever experienced in a 1/2 ton pick up. Do what I did, take one for a test drive...you'll trade that Ford in too.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have had my Laramie for a week now and am very pleased. The Hemi is very powerful and the ride is great. The optional Mynav system is very nice but the controls need a bit of tweaking. There has been a lot of thought put into the controls and execution of the interior layout. Lots of compliments from people who see me out in it.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab ST 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just bought this truck and I love it. I have the Crew Cab ST. The interior is well made and comfortable. I love the rear storage in the floor. I have always been a Chevy guy, but I won't ever go back.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Second Dodge owned. Love the Crew cab. All can ride in comfort and leg room. Plenty of storage. So much that I forget where stuff is. Don't need need a tool box. Plenty of power, always giving a mustang and corvettes a good run. Kids get tired of always taking out the other trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I can only say that I'm very happy with my purchase.  If your looking for the best truck on the market, this is it.  Can't wait to see if they come out with the 6.1L or 6.4L HEMI, I would go upgrade in a second.  Love the power.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I drove 4000 miles roundtrip to get this truck in the color and equipment I wanted and it was worth every mile. I have always been a Chevy man but after test driving every truck out there, I  found the Ram to be the hands down winner. I now know that I made the right choice for possibly my last truck in this lifetime.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I was turned on by all the toys. But what a piece of junk. I've owned many pick-ups in my life, but the ride quality in this tin can just plain stinks. You continue to feel a right to left up and down motion much like sitting in aboat anchored and feeling the wakes of other boats as they drive by. I owned this thing for two weeks. My combined mileage of 800hwy and 600 city was a whooping 14.6. I drove very conservative. I was so disappointed I traded it back and lost $10,000.00. It still hurts. I've never hated a vehicle so much.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just traded in my 08 Ram Laramie for a 09 Sport.  No problems with my 08 but could not resist the 09.  Dodge really put innovation and quality in mind with the redesign.  I have driven every full size, and you cant touch the new ram.  Power, performance, comfort, tech, and price.  It's got a HEMI, need I say more!  MPG is improved from 08 average 16 MPG mixed driving, vs 14.5 in my 08.  The truck is quiet and sure footed.  The new suspension rocks!  Quality is not Mopars best suit, but they are spot on with the RAM.  I hope this is the flagship of products to come.  Don't let the "old" Chrysler deter you, they ARE listening to us, the consumer!  Grab life by the horns!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: After a near total of the truck in a wreck, it is still the best dodge truck I have ever driven or owned. I love the reworked rear-end and the style of the front and rear exteriors.  The inside has a little ways to go but, better than the 2001, 2006 and 2008 by far.  Classic with the feel of today. That's Dodge and that is still the truck of tomorrow.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab ST 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I test drove the Tundra, Ford 150 and Chevy Silverado- all great trucks with tons of up-side features and technology, I've owned them all in the past, kept going back to the Dodge. Tried to talk myself out of it, but the rebates, incentives and research convinced me to go for it. So far, I'm amazed. Great handling, power, comfort and gas mileage (20/16). Drove 65-70 with 3 passengers and the bed stuffed with gear from my home near the Canadian border to Cape Cod through the mountains of Vermont and New Hampshire and got 20 mpgs. The ride was very smooth and the truck handles surprisingly well for the beast that it is.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: the 305/65/18E  BFG all terrans and the American racing black rims make this already mean looking truck look down right scary. stock rims and tires are crap and will soon replace the lame chrome grille and decals to finish the "blackout" overall great truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I purchased an SLT crew cab in May 09.  So far I've gone 3500 miles with no complaints other than after I got it home I discovered it had only 1 tow hook in the front (should have 2).  After several calls and a letter to the customer care center I was able to get another hook.  Still no rattles, no leaks, everything is fine mechanically.  Gas mileage is 15/20 which is good for a 390hp truck!  Plenty of room in the crew cab for hauling passengers.  I'm still happy with the looks, performace and overall package.  One nice feature is how the rear view mirror lights turn on when you exit the vehicle, nice for those dark driveways, parking lots, etc. I'd do it again.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: 2009 Ram 1500 4x4 CC 5.7 4wd with Bighorn 20's and 3.92's. Mostly, I like it. It doesn't ride as nice as my 1991 K1500, but just the same I like it. MPG is poor, very poor, and the ride is bumpy. The headrests are horribly hard, but still it's a good package with the employee pricing. Toyota's were many thousands more. Free Sirius a bonus too.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought my Dodge ram and Love it.  Interior is a substantial Improvement from previous years.  I have the 5.7 L hemi, crew cab, sport edition with bucket seats instead of the split bench.  I test drove the Sierra, F150, and The Ram and always came back to the Ram.   Sticker was 41350, walked out for 30000.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Okay, I have only had this truck less than 12 hours, but I jsut love it! I have had 3 previous F150/250 and decided to try something else. I would not have decided on a Dodge Ram until I saw the reviews on the revamped 09' design. I bought the SLT Crew Big Horn Edition and what a ride it is. VERY smooth and Dodge did it right with all the storage compartments and nifty features. I looked at all the big makers and Dodge took my breath away. I recieved a very good deal on the vehicle even though I lost my butt on trade-in (not the dealers fault). You can't match the grumble on the dual exuast. I hope my driving days are much better!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Desipte wanting to avoid a bankrupt company - I kept coming back to the Dodge Ram - it had by far the best ride, and the best vibe (love the rumble when you start it up).  Decided to go with the Larime and the crew cab 4x4.  Incredible room - can fit very comfortable my wife and 4 kids. Appreciated finding a truck that would put leather on a front bench seat.  Great on the highway with very a very quiet ride.  Sunroof,  uconnect, dual exhaustm, nav, dvd -> all great.  But in the end it was the: feel behind the wheel, the response from the gas petal, and its great stance when you looked at it.  I promise if you take a chance on this truck it will not disappoint.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Been looking at this truck online since it came out.  I kept finding myself going back to it.  I had a Jeep Grand Cherokee that I loved and I didn't need to get a new truck, but I had to go look at them in person, and then with all the incentives, I couldn't resist.  I LOVED IT!! The truck not only looks great, but it drives great too.  The other big trucks cannot even compare in styling to the Dodge.  I had to have the sport. Wanted silver, got blue and have got so many compliments on the color!!My only gripe is that I wish I would have purchased it 2 weeks later so that I could have had the government guarantee.  I just hope Chrystler/Dodge can pull through these tough times.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have the 5.7L Ram.  This is my third Ram and the one I should've had two trucks ago.  At least this ones lives up to the reputation of a Hemi.  It has much more power than previous year Hemis, handles better, brakes better and has more finishing touches like the 4 pin trailer connect mounted into the bumper, tire pressure sensors, box rail protectors (stuff that should've been standard years ago).  My 09 Ram is 2mpg better (average driving) than my 07 was.  The factory dual exhaust is perfect, it looks great and has just enough of a throaty tone when you step on it but quiet when you're cruising.  The response time of the MDS system is quicker than my 07 was, no lag between 8&4 cyl modes.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I recently purchased a 09 crew cab Sport.  I traded in my 08 Laramie and let me be the first to tell you that Dodge got this truck right through and through.  I had to drive 250 miles to get my deal, but after getting beat up in the 08, I drove home in the refined luxury of the 09.  EVERTHING about this truck is designed with you in mind.  Mileage, comfort, quietness, power, options, quality and fit and finish are all years above the previous model and better than competitors.  I cant say how happy I am with the 09 Ram!  If you can't Dodge it....Ram it!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned a 2002 ram ( 5.9), a 2005 nissan titan, 2007 ram ( hemi ) and now a 2009 big horn package. the titan was the fastest truck i owned until I drove the new one, the power is GREAT. I love the ride on this truck, going over rail crossing used to upset the back end of the 2007 ram, but not in this truck, its great that they finally made an interior to compete with Ford and Chevy. I cannot believe how quiet this truck is compared to others that i have owned, diving down the interstate at 80, there is no wind noise at all. Stickered at $41K and with all rebates i paid $31K and got $500 dallors in accessory cash, so I installed running boards.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: WOW!!!  I have been drooling over this truck ever since I laid eyes on it.  I have the Laramie Crew Cab 4X4 5.7L HEMI.  The sticker was 45700 and I walked out for 35500, great deal.  The interior leather is all high quality and the mygig is awesome to use.  The seats are very comfortable and spacious. The HEMI just tears off the line when you want and takes no prisoners when challenged (Ford 150 guys).  The coil springs help this truck deliver an unbelievable ride of comfort.  I'm glad that I made the decision to buy and will keep this truck for a long time.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: In my 1st couple thousand miles of use, I can say that this is the best truck I've ever owned.  The ride is very comfortable, the performance is excellent and the instruments are all accessible and intuitive.  I live in a mountainous area and passing up hills as always been cumbersome....until I bought the 2009 Ram 1500 with 5.7L Hemi.  I've driven many Dodge trucks as well as competitors and can honestly say that the new Ram the clear winner.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review_Title: You DON'T mess with the RAM!
Review: Got the "Bone White" 2-tone Laramie almost 3 weeks ago!  So far I love this truck!  This is my first truck so I did a lot of research into this one and others (Toyota and Chevy).  For some reason I did not look at the Ford F150 or Titan.  However, I found the RAM to have the best ride, exterior, interior and features.  I know the Tundra has a great drive train.  However with the HEMI and all of the new features in the RAM, plus the fact that I basically paid over $10K less than MSRP with all the incentives, 0% for 36months, I couldn't pass this up!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Sticker 39720 sale price 28500. I feel good. U.S. Gov. backed lifetime warranty. I've also got the 5.7 hemi and man can i say power. I only have 300 miles so far but I love it. I worked at Toyota for 5 years and that's all I drove and they don't even compare. My wife wants to trade me her 4runner for my truck. NO WAY! This thing is a lot fun to drive. If your on the fence about buying a ram go drive one and get the best deal out there!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Excellent Truck for the money. Sticker 48k yet was out the door tax, title and license for $35500.00 (still can't believe it) Laramie trim is excellent, sound system and hard drive are great.  Fuel economy is not bad for a 4X4 that ways in at more than 5500 pounds.  Very smooth ride.  Built in AC/DC converter is a great feature as well.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I just bought this truck. I love the interior and exterior designs. The power is fantastic! All the bells and whistles are fairly easy to use. Although weak on gas mileage, it's a great driver. I wish the bed was 6- foot instead of 5.7".

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I love this truck! I have the Sport Crew Cab 4x4 5.7L HEMI. The sticker was 42,600 and I walked out paying 31,500 with bed liner and chrome sidestep bars included. The truck by far looks and drives better than its competitors with performance like no other. I love that HEMI! The dual exhaust sets the truck off. I'm 23 years old and for the most part I drive like a  responsible adult. I did put the petal to the floor one time to pass someone and WOW!!!! I was thrown back in my seat. The comfort is top notch and the amount of room it has is amazing. My truck turns heads everywhere I go. Black on black is sharp.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I test drove and was not impressed by the competitors....F150, Tundra, etc. etc., (although the Silverado was nice).  I must say that the Ram 1500 crew cab with 5.7 Hemi is superior in many ways to all of them.  Ride quality is very impressive.  Power is impressive, yet fuel economy is very good with MDS system.  My MDS is on roughly half the time with 50/50 highway/city driving.  I'm getting about 21 mpg highway and 16/17 city.  Do not underestimate usefulness of Rambox with bed extender/divider option!  MSRP $40,000 - $6,000 EP- $2500 owner loyalty- no charge hemi- dealer cash-military discount = $26,700 + TTL.  WOW! Nobody else even came close on performance or price.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I've owned Chevy trucks all of my life, and still own a collector Chevy restored 1968 vette.  I was interested in Dodges Lifetime warranty, since I had my doubts about Dodge all my life.  Well, after test driving the new Chevy Silverado and the Ford F- 150, my wife and I both agreed that the Dodge not only had the superior ride quality, handling, Power, and asethetics were all the best.  Dodge must have changed engineers on this one, since it is way superior to any other truck on the road. This type of build quality will definitely make the company more profitable!! Correction to the type of truck purchased: It is a hemi, sport, crew cab, 4x4.  P.S. I will still hang onto my 68 vette!! LOL

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have owned many Dodge trucks --  '91, '95, '96, '99, '02, '04, '07 and '09.  The '09 is by far the best.  Build quality is unparalleled.  Have traveled in many Chev. and Fords, the new Dodge is far superior.  Took this new truck on a 1,200 mile trip first weekend I owned it, horrible winter roads -- truck stayed completely composed even at high speeds on wet and icy road.  Totally amazed at the ride, power, composure and competence of this truck.  Great creature comforts and interior amenities. Much more comfortable truck than previos models.  I look forward to many happy miles in this truck.  I use it for business and travel long distances. Can't say enough about how impressed I am.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Finally....Dodge has delivered on an upscale interior package.  This is the 2nd Dodge Ram that I have owned and it is much improved over my 2003 in all areas.  The HEMI is, well a HEMI!!  I bought a 2007 Chevy Avalanche and it was a big disappointment....rattle trap with allot of little problems, so I traded it for the 2009 Dodge Ram Laramie.  Test drove it once and had to buy it.  The power it delivers is unmatched in its class, forgot what it felt like to drive a HEMI.  Now it has the looks inside and out to match its performance.  I looked at the new 2009 Ford F150 King Ranch, but the new Dodge has a better look/feel in my opinion.  If your in the market for a new truck, look at Dodge!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Great truck! Shopped around the big 3 domestic trucks and after driving the new RAM I was in love. Truck rides and handles like no other truck I've drove/rode in. Mixed that with the sexy styling and powerful HEMI its an awesome truck! Gas milage is just as good if not better than my smaller 4x2 4.6L F-150 that I left behind for this truck. The cab is super quiet and I don't notice hardly any highway hop, that would be the coil suspension.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I would like to know if anyone is having a problem with the 2009 crew between 30 mph and 40 that it feels like the truck bogs down and has less power also happens at 50 mph seems slugish. Also air noises in cab.This is my 4th truck some how its running performance feels different at these speeds. Anyone can help please do. I brought it to the dealer he said its fine but I don't.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I bought an 06 Quad Cab with 20" tires only to have Dodge buy it back after three months due to not being able to balance the tires.  Ended up with an 06 Mega Cab that was great and ended up trading it in on a new SLT Crew Cab only to have the same trouble as I did in 06 with the Quad Cab.  It has been in the garage each week that I have owned it for tires.  They have tried Goodyears and BF Goodrichs with no success and I believe that it is up to around 7 different sets.  It is a shame that a great looking truck still has the same issues as they did back in 06.  They say it swallowed a Luxury car but evidently it forgot to eat the wheels!

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Well I don't have the laramie I acttually have the "Big Horn" but pretty loaded with a sticker of $40,130 plus $1800 in dealer installed options (Ram bed liner,Chrome step bars and Dodge molded mud flaps). I almost felt guilty driving away paying $29,110. Being a former Ford car salesman I know they were still happy to see it go. After the '04 F-150 debut I didn't think a pick-up could get any better but this Ram drives and looks like a dream, inside and out. That Hemi, Oh!!!! that Hemi! My best friend say's it launches like a rocket compared to his fathers 08 model. My word of advice, Buy Now! I heard financing was practically impossible, I promise you it is probable. + Lifetime PWRTRN War.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab SLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (4.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Previously owned a 2002 Ram 1500 that I had no trouble with, but it was going to need some work eventually and I got a great deal on the new 2009, which after driving it, there was no disputing its superiority.  I bought the SLT Sport Crew Cab and it looks great, performs great and is a true joy to drive.  The head-turning of others does not get old.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: When I was looking to buy, wanted to upgrade to a crew cab over my xcab F150.  I made a great choice.  The '09 Ram has all the power I need, superb interior style and build quality, and the ride is smooth.  It's a very fun truck to drive with the 5.7L Hemi under the hood.  Dodge's MDS system is FLAWLESS in going between 4 cylinders and 8.  There is no way you can feel the transition.  Mileage is improving as I break it in, but I am expecting nothing better than EPA estimates.  With 500 miles on the truck, I'm getting 13.5 mpg; all city driving and with a bit of a heavy foot.  If you want a truck that is sharp on the outside, impeccable on the inside, and power to boot, buy a new Ram.

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: I have been a Dodge/Mopar fan for years. I've owned many Jeeps, '99 Dakota, '04 Dakota, '04 Durango.  They have al been better then the previous. I traded an '04 durango[family vehicle] and '02 silverado for this '09 Ram 4x Crew. It rides better than the durango and is more versitle than the silverado...with the incentives Chrysler had I am actually saving front end monthly payment cash from previously having two notes.  This thing is a dream, only 3k on the clock. No complaints or critique yet.  I will update my thoughts as time goes by this year

Vehicle_Title: 2009 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Crew Cab Laramie 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.7L 8cyl 5A)
Review: Had mine since January. Love everthing about it. Has the luxary of a hummer H2 which I have owned, gas power that rivals diesel trucks form only a few years back. For the money this is a great all around truck. There is always room for improvement but I personally couldnt tell you what on this truck. My wife loves it and she is not a truck person (I think the heated steering wheel done it). Probably put a leveling kit on it and go up one size and a little more aggresive in tire.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my third dodge truck I have had great dealer support 4.7 engine is reliable but could use a better torque curve

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My first dodge and its an 05 ram HEMI 4x4 quad cab w/20's.The power is awesome. Got this ram with 59k miles and now have 111000.It has been flawless.It has taken me anywhere I have wanted to go.I have traveled and slept in it many times so it is very comfortable.Was moving from Tx to Az with a camper shell. So I packed it out as much as would fit.Put my wifes 4000 pound car on a tow dolly and packed it out .. I still did 75 mph and sometimes 80. It runs and idles so smooth you'd think it was brand new! Even w/o dual exhaust it still roars when you get on it. And its quiet when you don't.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: one issue in one year not too bad
Review: i have owned my reg cab 4.7l 4x4 automatic truck since january and truck has far exceeded my expectations, i have always owned chevy and last two let me down so i figured i would give dodge a chance. i bought it with 60,000 and have put 25000 miles on so far only issue i ran into was both front wheel bearings went on me and they are not the easiest to fix, have heard this is an issue with these at that mileage. other than that truck has been awesome. has descent gas mileage for what it is and has sufficient power i would buy it again in a heartbeat

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram 1500, 5.7 liter Hemi Quad Cab,  SLT
Review: I bought this truck new and have never regretted it. I like it very much. The ride is very comfortable and the dash board controls are easy to understand and easy to reach while driving.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The specs: 4.7 magnum, auto, rwd, quad cab, sb. Have had the truck for 5 weeks. Truck has been in shop for 11 days. Work completed: head gaskets (2), timing chain, radiator replaced and water pump. Have had the truck back for a week and the check engine light is now on. On the up side the truck gets 16 mpg mixed driving, rides fairly well and looks good.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I purchased a used quad cab with the 4.7 L and the 5 speed auto.  It had the 20" wheels, which the dealer traded out for me to the chrome 16's.  Dynamite combo; this gives you the 4.7 L with 3.9 gears and standard wheels which == good towing (7k), good power and good mileage (16-18 HWY).  I've towed tractors, horses and building materials for 3 years with no repairs.  Better truck than any ford I've ever had.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I Bought this truck because I had heard good things about the new Dodge trucks in 2005.  I have regretted it.  Problems include: EGR valve, rough idle (fuel filter is attached to the fuel pump, replacement of one means replacement of both) the adjustable driver's seat track has broken five times in 39,000 miles.  When the seat track breaks the seat freely travels back and forth upon acceleration or braking (dangerous and painful).  Dodge has told me that they do not care.  Their very high up management has told me that the safety of one person is not that important to them since there have not been many other complaints.  Never again will I buy a Dodge.  They do not believe in their product.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Do  not purchase this truck, they die at 62,000 miles. Bought mine new in 2006, maintained a perfect service record, and I was rewarded with nine trips to the dealership over the years for different issues. I am not a "brand" guy and this has no impact on my review, but in the interest of full disclosure I will never by another Daimler Chrysler product again. The dealer service is poor and was nearly a victim of consumer fraud at College Station Lithia Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Love this truck. Handling,take off and comfort. I installed a K&N cold air filter and Flow Master Duel muffler-neither helped my gas mileage. The 5 speed auto transmission won't go into over drive until you get above 58 mph-dealer says not enough torque. So I get about 11.5 mpg city and 15.5 highway it came with 17" rims not 20"--BUT I DO LOVE THIS TRUCK. It's fun to drive and the grand kids love to ride in it. Just wish the MPG was better and Trans shifted smoother. But I plan to keep it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
