Review: My dad bought me my grey dodge ram with hemi and laramie, its beautiful. i've raced the new chevy v8 vortec and beat it without skipping a beat. the hemi just kills anything, i have used it for hauling my dirtbikes and driven it super rough cuz im a teenager. gas mileage is decent but i wouldnt trade it for the power. when we bought the truck we were suppose to get free lifetime oil changes then the dealership went out of business.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: leased a new gmc 4x4 truck every 2 years since 1998 all loaded with every option, panicked when gas prices went up and got a g-6 (junk). gm would not help me out of a bad deal so took the loss and purchased 2005 dodge Laramie 4x4 4 door loaded to the max moonroof the works, black cherry 20 " wheels you name it. hemi all the toys. i will no longer go to a gm truck this thing rocks

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've had my Ram for a year now and I love it. I had to pick up my in-laws travel trailer and I had to keep looking to be sure it was still there!  Glad I traded in the wife's mini-van. The only problem I have had is a bad EGR valve. Dealer couldn't find the problem when the check engine light came on. They told me she was running lean . Checked it out on the internet and $70 and 20 minutes later I fixed it myself Haven't had a problem since. MPG ok if you don't hammer on it all the time.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my 2nd Dodge Truck the first was a 1999 SLT 360 cubic inch Quad cab. I now have 45,000 miles in 3 years on this 2005 Hemi Laramie and it has never been in the shop that I can recall. The miles are probably 50/50 city highway, with 1/2 the highway pulling a Bass Boat.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have had this truck for about 6 months and absolutely love it. Yes I have a hemi. Love the power and smooth ride mine is a special southern comfort edition. Black cherry paint with molded running boards and tauno cover. It also has embroidered seats all leather with a composite dash board. I use synthetic oil and have had no mechanical problems. Ride is great and it sits up high so seeing is easier for me at only 5'2". I have had nothing but compliments on how nice it looks.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I bought this truck with the 6 cylinder because I thought the mileage would be nice.  I am getting 14 city and the best so far 16.5 Highway.  If I run the the gas gauge to empty it cost 86 bucks to fill up at 3.20 a gallon.  The towing rating for this 4 door 3.7L 6M truck is only 3500 pounds.  I have to shift gears at at least 2750 RPM or I get passed by dump trucks when accelerating from a dead stop.  My little SUV gets better mileage, tows more, and has an extra 75 horsepower.  I should have got the HEMI!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Excellent all-around truck for work, commuting, and getting the family around. Very comfortable to drive, with power seating option. Great visibility in poor weather on the interstate as compared to a previous GMC that sat lower to the ground. Tows very well with excellent stability. Corners very well with 20 inch wheel option. Stops on a dime. Never felt more in control when driving a truck. No mechanical problems of any kind with over 47K miles on this truck. I just had the brakes checked at my last service interval and they had about 60% remaining on the pads, so it's definitely a low maintenance vehicle. The 4.7L V-8 is adequate, but the Hemi would be even more fun.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have had this pickup for almost 3 years, bought brand new. Fried tranny at 9000, dealership told me a piece broke off the pump and clogged the cooler. New transfer case and front differential at 26000, no explanation. Now at 35000 power steering has a horrible leak in it. This pickup has seen almost all highway miles and regular maintenance.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I wanted to get back into a truck, so I started researching different trucks online. I've had 3 Ford's, 2 Chevy's, 2 Jeep's and 1 Nissan Frontier. I'm really a Ford guy, but their gas mileage stinks! Dodge's popped up and I saw that they get better gas mileage than my Grand Cherokee. I've had my '05 1500 for a week now and I love it. I got the Hemi and the gas mileage is actually pretty good. My Dad is a Die-hard Ford guy and just bought a brand new F150 and now wants to trade it in for a Ram because he likes mine so much. I test drove a few 4.7L Ram's and if you really are looking for the best gas mileage out of any trucks, that's the one to get. It's not the same as the Hemi, but it'll go!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my second Ram, had an 2003 SLT RW drive. Use primarily for towing boat and travel trailer, never thought the trailer towing package did not include limited slip rear, but true!  One or two days on the ramp when wet told me I needed 4X4.  Now have the Laramie package and 4X4.  Love the truck, '05 has much less engine roar than 03 (Hemi in both), sometimes miss it but appreciated on long trips.  Towing is the ticket with this truck, will tow anything, anywhere!  Currently pull 28 ft travel trailer (6800 lbs) and 24 ft boat (6000 lbs) and get between 10-11 mpg!!  Have to go 55-60 to do that and not "hemi" away from lights, as my wife would say. Used to get 6-7 with Chev 1500 w/350.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck. The only thing that could improve would be the gas mileage. It actually only averages about 13-16 miles per gallon. It handles well, very comfortable, quite roomy, and attractive to the eye. Love it!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Very comfortable truck. Seats give lots of support for long trips. Plenty of power for towing. Not a single warranty problem since purchase

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have always grown up with Ford trucks. I drove a new F150 and was not impressed. Not much of a Chevy fan. Real trucks don't wear bowties! Had a few smaller Nissan trucks also. Titan was a close second but much more in price. I rented one and that sealed the deal. Hemi has great power and gas mileage is decent for size and power. For short distances, not so good 11- 13mpg. Highway I have had up to 22mpg avg is 18-20!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I drove Chevy trucks for years.  When I test drove the Ram I realized what a truck should be.  The Hemi is by far the best aspect of the truck but the fit and finish is solid also.  Anyone driving a Ford or Chevy should take a Ram Hemi for a drive and feel what a real truck feels like.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've noticed that on a windy day you must turn up the radio to block out the outside noise. I'm always checking the doors to see if they are closed tight. It seems like the manufacturer forgot to complete the rubber seal on the doors, although the seals all seem to be attached.  I've noticed when the cruise control is on the speed fluxuates sometimes ten to twenty miles an hour on uneven roadways. I've also noticed a slipping or some unexplained shift problem between second and third gear while the transmission upshifts during acceleration.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought it with a four inch lift and 33" BFG M/Ts. The 5.7L Hemi gives it a nice punch although the factory muffler has really quieted it down. The truck feels very solid and stable even with the 4" lift. For a light duty 1/2 ton, I've been very happy with it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I drive 30,000 per year. Transmission is slipping when you first start out or after truck has sat for one hour. The dealer said it was a bad filter. Transmission still slips. I will take it back again. The truck is an '05 with 50,000 miles. I have never towed anything with it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded my BMW M3 convertible in on this beast and it's one of the best things I ever did. I love this truck. It's a hoot to drive and I enjoy the power. I've added alot of aftermarket things to it such as dual exhaust, a Mopar cold air intake, a sprayed in bed liner, a brush guard on the front, a remote starter, to cool it off in the heat of summer before I get in it and a few other little things that make it uniquely mine. It's great! Seems that a lot of the men that I work with appreciate it too. They're always asking about the things that I've done to it. I'm very proud of my truck

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: This truck has no dull points
Review: This truck has been a blast for me to drive around town and on the highways. The coolest moments about driving this truck has been when I'm at a dead stop and I take off screeching the tires and everyone turns their heads. The Hemi realy does command respect. But driving my truck would be whole lot more enjoyable if it was not for those high gas prices, they cost me about 60 dallors to fill up now. Though even if I got one of those smaller engines I still would be hurt (but not as much) so I will just stick with what I got and hope gas does not go up any more.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've enjoyed owning my Ram Quad Magnum. I have wanted the new body design since its inception in the mid 90's. I am impressed by the interior room, cab design, and location of the instruments.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Fuel mileage could be a little better, but if you keep your foot out of it you can get 21MPG on the highway. About 16 on my highway commute. Shocks could be a little stiffer, but it's obviously tuned for highway comfort.  I drove the Chevy and Ford comparable trucks, and I thought the Dodge was the most truck for the money.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Love my Dodge Ram Hemi. Great performance, comfort, and reliability.  This is my third Dodge truck, and everyone has been wonderful. The only drawback is poor gas mileage, but the fun of driving this makes up for it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: To and from work, about 13.1 mpg mixed driving. The hemi is fun very few people try the "right lane run up" when the lane is running out, great for passing. Use for light hauling, haven't tried the trailer package out yet. Ride is good for a truck, fit and finish now complaints. Rear seat accomodates grand daughters car seat with no problems (had to buy the quad cab, she can't be in front sear yet, hey it was a great excuse) Live in the metro Detroit area, no problem with snow. Thumper says welcome to Detroit, drive it like ya stole it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The Hemi is sweet. Had to learn not to punch it until I swung out to pass because it gets it right now. Ride is pleasant and is a blast to drive. Some vibration at certain speeds but mild and is a 4X4. Paint quaility could be improved. Gas mileage is around 16 highway so far. 4X4 so far works great. Less expensive than a comparable equiped F150 by significant dollars. Much better look than Chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded in an aging Jeep Wrangler for this when Dodge was doing the employee discount option for anyone. I am still learning how to park this monster even after having it for several months. Just today, my average mileage (mostly hiway) on this all stock truck was 23 MPG. I was shocked! The onboard computer was indicating 17 MPG. Keep your foot out of the throttle and this truck will get decent mileage. When accelerating, I typically do not exceed 2000 RPM. Believe me, this is hard to do since Hemi sounds soo nice at wide open throttle.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Traded 05 Dakota with powerful 4.7 for Ram 1500 Hemi! Can't go wrong with this powerplant, it's outstanding for sure. It even sounds good with stock exhaust when you hit the gas. The truck rides and handles great. Great choice!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck, totaly impressed with the hemi. Handeling,ride and even fuel economy have been outstanding. I average 17-18 mpg normal driving. About the same as a previous Mazda B3000 4x4 and nearly as good as my old Tacoma v6 4x4. Build quality is as good as the Toyota. I have put Rancho9000's on and handling is great with the big 20" Goodyears. Front GY's at 40K still look new. Rears, can't blame the tires. My first American made truck, been driving Japaneese trucks since 1974. Dodge, you won me over.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my second of the current generation of Ram. The first was a 2002 Quad Cab with a 5.9 V8. Great truck.  This one is even better with a Hemi and 5 speed auto transmission.  Very reliable and fun to drive. I recently had to rent a 2006 Chevy Silverado and could not wait to get back into the Dodge. It out performed the Chevy in almost every way. I will buy another one for sure.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Traded in my 2004 Ram 4.7L SLT Quad Cab for an '05 w/ a Hemi. This truck will pull a tree out of the ground! The most powerful gas V8 I've driven by far. Gas mileage not so good but come on it's a truck w/ power. What do you expect?  Truck rides smooth and doesn't miss a beat going up hills on the highway. Should have went with the Hemi to begin with b/c there is a great difference in power and the gas mileage doesn't differ a whole lot.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have never owned a pickup truck or actually have a need for a truck- however when i saw the limited edition Ram 1500 Daytona Edition in bright orange at a dealer... I left my Cadillac CTS-V and drove off with this great truck, By far my favorite auto ever owned. The power and handling are supurb, build quality is superior and who can't love that sound of the Hemi engine leaving corvettes at the stop light (in my dust!) The dealer installed extra's helped save me from going out and "pinping my ride"- the truck stops people in thier tracks when they see it. I am converted now, Dodge trucks from here on out. Looks like no other truck on the road. Dwarfs all the lame Chevy and Ford trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Ram 1500 Laramie 2WD SWB w/5.7 Hemi V8
Review: The Ram 1500 Laramie with the optional 5.7 Hemi V8 is about as good as it gets driving a full size truck.  Awesome power when it counts and loads of "eye- candy" both inside and out, especially with the sport package and 20" chrome wheels.  The Ram 1500 is sure to garner lots of admiring glances whether it's on the move or just parked. With a feeling of quality throughout and lots of attention to detail this machine "out-classes" anything else in it's class. This truck is truly the truck lover's "dream machine".

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I spent about 3 weeks looking for the right truck.  I looked at Dodge, Chevy, Ford, and Toyota.  Dodge trucks have great rebates available on the 05 models that no other company can compare to right now (6500 for regular cab, 6000 for quad).  The appearance, inside and out, as well as the smooth ride is what sold me.  I don't plan on doing much towing, so I got the 4.7L engine, and it gets down the road just fine.  After driving this truck around for the last few weeks, I can see why you are starting to see more and more Dodge Trucks on the road.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I wasn't getting anywhere on my 'offer' on a silver one then the dealer said, 'well, we have a red one'..My heart thumped (I wanted red) so I said show it to me. Yeek, very red over silver (I wanted it) will you take my offer? Another hour with two sales mgrs. we agreed on the deal. It was mine. A 2005 Quad Cab 1500. Dang, it's huge. Chrome grill and deflector trim, chrome clad rims..The SLT package with bed liner (I ordered the 'Bling' later from Brown's and a dealer in Tacoma, WA. Actually the dealership is great. They had it since Feb. 05 so it had some detail issues that were cheerfully taken care of. I couldn't have asked for more truck. Seems much larger than my 94' GMC Siera 1500..

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Purchased the last 2005 model the dealer had on the lot.  WOW! What a truck.  If ever a truck could have too much power (5.7L Hemi)this is it.  More standard Horse Power than a Mustang.  I have (had) been a Chevy man my whole life.  The look, feel, ride, and performance of this truck scream testosterone.  PLENTY of room for 6 people (Quad-Cab).  I was also informed by the dealer that 2005 is the last year Dodge is offering the 7 Year/70,000 mile powertrain warranty.  Sticker on window was $34k but after rebates/incentives drove it off the lot for $22k.  It also has the 4WD, SLT package.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I know the options only give you the 4.7 to review/rate so I'm writing this review here.  Finally took a while for me to find the "right" combination of options and color scheme but when I did it was worth it.  Hemi is second to none, just wish the bolt-on horsepower options (Air intake system, etc.) weren't so much more for the Hemi as compared to other engines.  As of now it presents more than enough power.  Envy factor has already made a close friend buy one only two months after I got mine.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love the overall look of the truck. The truck pulls like a freight train. The Hemi is great and has a great exhaust note to it. It's a pain in the you know what to park but you get use to it. the interior space is outrageous can fit 4 people in the back seat comfortably, same with the front all though the drivers view is limited. The hemi is really responsive the slight it tap and it dont miss a beat. The limited slip differential comes in handy when u gun it.overall I think the truck its great but shorter drivers may have trouble seeing. And the truck is a ways off the ground so it is best if you got running boards. The gas mileage stinks out loud.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Best truck I have ever owned. I have had Fords for the last 15 years. Dodge has the best pickup in the 1500 class

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The Dodge Ram 1500 is by far the best value in the full size market.  A great looking truck that can work hard and is also affordable.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The 5.7 Hemi is the best thing that ever happened to a pickup. It gives a real boost when you are wanting to get from here to there right now. 4door quadcad, although not quite as spacious as the Ford F150 crew cab, is still plenty roomy for most folks, and the optional flat floor provision makes secure dry storage (for groceries and such) very handy. A recent road trip delivered outstanding mileage, with the trip computer recording 21mpg(!) at one point across Kansas. My truck is a 2005 Ram 1500 SLT quadcab with 2wd and towing package. I like this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My Ram is driven on interstates and if I keep my speed reasonable, I can consistently get 20+ mpg.  Have had as high as 24 with a tail wind.  For this size vehicle, this tuff looking truck is amazingly economical with gas. Getting ready to trade and considering something smaller but why give up full size luxury and ride to pick up 1-2 mpg, if that.  Love my RAM and will probably by another, but not a Hemi.  Get the 4.7 v8.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: An absolute pleasure to own. The fuel economy is about the only negative to this truck, and for the power that engine packs, it's well worth it. Plenty of power, plenty of space, and the instrument cluster is the cleanest looking of any vehicle I have ever had. Switching to 4WD is a snap. The towing capacity is more than adequate, and the ride is firm, but comfortable. I have never regretted buying this truck, it is a fantastic buy.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just bought the truck and I can't complain.  The storage under the back seats and under the front middle seat is great.  Even with the 4.7L it is a great performing truck.  I love the way it sounds when you hit the gas, although Dodge should have made the exhaust louder.  When you have a V8 you want to hear it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just bought my '05 ram and I absolutely love it.  It sits tall on the 20" inch factory rims.  It's my first pickup and I would highly recommend for others to buy it

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The Hemi is a awesome engine, Ignore Consumer Reports "over hyped" comment in their review, if the Hemi was in a Ford they would be bragging that engine up. The engine is really that good. The interior fit and finnish is top notch, light years ahead of GM anything, including their luxed out Escalade. The handling in the 1500 is really good, almost car like. I have been getting about 19 mpg highway and 14 mpg city driving with the Hemi 1500 4x4, thats driving with a light pedal. Put your foot into it and it will get around 11 mpg city

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My Dodge is a very good-looking and strong running truck.  love the Hmi, but the 5 speed auto leaves much to be desired! I smell a new trannyin this one before it' over. I have already had it reprogrammed at 5000 miles and it still isn' right. If Dodge would fix their transmission issues, they would sell many more of these hotrods!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Great truck for the money especially with the employee discount & rebates.  Great ride and handles effortlessly.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: What a truck! The Hemi is well worth the extra cost. The comfort of the leather and interior room makes the Quad Cab worth it. I have had Ford Trucks in the past and I decided I was going to try the Dodge. Good choice! I have fallen in love with the looks, performance, and comfort of the truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Only truck I have ever owned that makes you smile every time you punch that accelerator. Very quiet interior, but when you accelerate you hear the low rumble of the Hemi straining to be unleashed. Overall, a wonderfull machine.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The overall looks of the 1500 sold me on this truck. It stands out among anything offered today. Dodge has a winner in design, comfort and quality. I reccomend anyone looking at buying a pickup look at Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I never owned a truck before, but I bought the 1500 with the Hemi and love it.  It fits me perfectly with plenty of room in the front for me and the wife and plenty of room for the kids in the back.  The power of the Hemi is great.  The look of the Dodge 1500 is great too.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: It's a nice looking truck, but extremely poorly detailed truck.  As I drove off the lot, there were problems!  Visor clip fell off.  Front torsion bars needed to be replaced (with 500 miles on it).  The radiator cap lost its seal, all fluid drained.  I was told it "must have been a defective part".  Door moulding is falling off.  Truck has two shades of paint on it from front doors to rear doors.  I have had it aligned three times and it still pulls to the right.  Dinged the rear bumper, found it to be made from aluminum foil - or pretty close.  I suggest you test drive one as well as a Chevy and a Ford.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Rugged yet comfortable. The high up cabin makes you feel like the "King of the Road".  Small glove box, but armrest storage makes up for it. Nice ride, good acceleration. I chose the 4.7 V8 over the Hemi. Good choice, as it averages 15-16 mpg vs the 10-11 for the Hemi. No defects so far.  Overall I am very satisfied.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have driven Ford trucks for over 18 years until last year when I had several unpleasant experiences at Ford dealers and with my most recent Ford product. So I switched to Dodge, and so far, that was an excellent choice. If you purchase the "Hemi" and the 3.92 rear, you can't go wrong for towing. Ford could take lessons from this. If I get my usual 150,000- 200,000 miles, I'll stay a changed man.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Super fun, and a workhorse for towing.
Review: I purchased this vehicle to fill our needs for towing a 5000lbs boat and also a 5000lbs travel trailer. The 5.7L Hemi is the choice for us due to its power of 345hp and 375ft/lbs of torque. When you drive this truck you immediately notice the power when you accelerate. After driving other brands before purchasing, we feel very confident in our selection. This truck handles our towing needs very well.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is so much fun to drive! The mileage isn't that bad for the power.  This truck has the best build quality of any Chrysler product I've ever seen.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I feel it has plenty of room in the cab, both front and rear.  Interior is very comfortable for driver as well as passengers.  Smooth body lines to the eye.  Its stance is very acceptable.  Power is definitely there with the Hemi V-8.  The front grill just screams "get out of my way."

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a great truck! Purchased the Laramie w/Sport Pkg, 4WD, Quad Cab. My 3rd Dodge truck since '98. Moved up from Dakotas. The Hemi is strong even at our Colorado elevation of 6,000ft plus. Even more impressive at sea level. Drove it to California and back, averaged 17.3mpg cruising at 75mph. Tight build quality, good materials, very smooth on the freeway and around town. Brake grip is quick. Quiet, great Nav/CD/Radio/Sat system. Infinity sound is impressive. Controls on the steering wheel for Cruise&Audio perfectly placed. Rated it w/9s for Ride/Drive because anything can be improved, and 5 for Fuel because that's average for big trucks. Gave it straight 10s for Design, it's that good! Buy it!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck has it all, it's great for riding around the country and it's extremely handy when just running errands around town. The best thing is it can tow a boatload of stuff and the boat or whatever you want to hook-up to. Mine has the 5.7L Hemi.  If I had to make the choice again I would still get it with gas at $2.37 a gallon.  There is no substitute for a well made engine with great reliability. The truck itself has great visibility and looks sharp.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Very nice truck, this is the second Dodge truck that I have purchased new and I doubt that it will be the last.  We love the Atlantic pearl blue color and the body styling.  The standard V8 has plenty of power and don't seem to be too bad on gas.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I am 6'4" tall and need the extra room. This truck fits the larger driver with ample leg and head room. From the first test drive to the last drive home, you have a feeling of riding in your easy chair. Plenty of power with the HEMI V8 engine. Shift down into passing gear and just listen to the roar of power. I love the full 8' bed. It really adds to a great ride with the longer wheel base, and of course makes hauling easier too. The ease of going from 2 to 4 wheel drive is like turning on the radio. With the 6 disc CD player and infinity sound system it's like a concert in your truck. I love the back seat under storage area for keeping things handy yet out of sight. I recomend this one!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Just got my 05 Quad Cab SLT 4x4 Molten Red after many months of looking and comparing the Ram to the Titan. I decided on the Ram because of the price. The power is nice and it is quieter inside than the Titan. I also like the extra length in the bed. Overall it is very comfortable.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought this truck new. It was OK for about 75K miles. I always had it serviced by the dealer according to manufacturer's recommendation, it now has 135K. I had to have one of the engine heads replaced because of a crack. The transmission shifts OK but will not move for several seconds after starting. The 4x4 is very weak. The front differential has leaked since 115K miles and they can't seem to get it stopped, In the last 20K miles I've replaced the left CV axle and stub shaft once and the left CV axle and stub shaft 3 times. I seldom use the 4x4. This will be my last Dodge or Ram truck

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: CONS-Poor build quality for the 3.7L, The bearings are Aluminum :( -also the gauges are practically dummy gauges, oil pressure gauge reads "normal", even if low pressure is going on. Very disappointed to find "spun" AL bearings, when the oil gauge read normal, >>"Each time the cluster receives a message from the PCM or ECM indicating the engine oil pressure is about 6 psi (very low) or lower, the check gauges indicator will be illuminated.", otherwise reads "normal" = your engine might already be already destroyed, (mine 100k),the 3.7 rebuild is almost as expensive as a Hemi & about 1000$ more than 4.7 ect. Very disappointed to find oil sludging was an issue with the vehicle as well.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I own a 2005 Dodge Ram with a 3.7 V6 with an automatic transmission.  I have 61,000 miles and there is absolutely nothing wrong with my truck, well except for the factory cd player which only takes a few of my cd's and spits the rest out.  I wish I could have gotten a quad cab with a V8 but I got a good deal on this one.  I was skeptical about the small V6 but it is plenty capable of getting around.  I have driven the V8's and the power difference is noticeable but all I really care about is reliability.  The ride is a bit more lively due to the short WB but it feels solid.  The brakes are outstanding.  The Ram is the best Truck nowadays and if you're considering one, trust me- V8 is a must!!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just purchased my 2005 Dodge Ram 1500 4.7. V8, 6 Speed Manual a couple of days ago, used of course but in great shape. Best truck for my money! It is a great drive seats are way better on my bad back than my previous Ford. Love the power and having 6 speeds. I also love that i am a 5' tall girl and I can still reach the clutch with no problems. Great truck, i might have to become a Dodge girl!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I bought this truck brand new in 2005 and have since put a little over 80,000 miles on it. I have never had any problems with the truck, did basic maintenance and she has been extremely reliable to me. I put a flowmaster muffler and a ram air intake and it increased the mpg buy a little also gave that v6 a nice v8 sound.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Great truck. Definitely love the Hemi. Don't even know there's a trailer back there, pulls HARD!. Very Fast. Whole truck is real tight, nothing falling apart. Only problem in 3 years was blower motor which was fixed under warranty. Besides that never been to the repair shop.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is the first pickup that I have ever owned, and it is AMAZING.  Lots of power, comfortable ride (for a truck), and a blast to drive.  My '05 Ram has the Daytona package (silver), and it constantly turns heads.  Semi drivers on the highway turn to look at it then realize it's a girl driving it!  Haven't used four-wheel drive much, but it did get me to work in a snowstorm without skipping a beat.  Limited slip hooks up quickly, and it has been known to go sideways on wet pavement, but that is part of the fun.  I love this truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is very well built and still is one of the best looking pick up trucks on the road even with all the new 2007 models out. This truck set the standard for all other pick up trucks and competes with all trucks on the road. Great acceleration, speed, and raw power for hauling, I have not driven a better pick up nor one that looks this good.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: With 53K plus miles so far, very satisfied. Manufacturer over-torqued front wheels so rotors got warped. Dodge mechanic states valve train noise is normal. Stock tires are a little "floaty" on curves with bumps. No out of pocket expenses yet other than maintenence.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I like my Ram 1500 very much.4.7 engine is all I need to pull my boat and Sea Doo.Gas mileage isn't great,but hey its a 4x4 truck not a mini van.Handles very well and rides nice too.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: Bought because of the dealer price break.  Sticker price 21,800 price paid 15,500.  Nice after putting work into truck, new rims, new hood, droped the back.  The qulity of the bed doesn't seem that great put a dent in the bed with a smaller bass amp.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: So far so good, engine takes awile to break in for better gas milage (I have a Hemi) I noticed an improvement at about 5000 miles and a slight improvement at 10,000 miles. I get 14 city and 17 Hwy at 11,000 miles. Have trans issue, see suggested improvements.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: '05 Dodge 1500: A great truck so far!
Review: I've had it for only 2 months (2300 miles), but so far it has run great, and it drives very comfortably for a 4x4 truck. I use it in my landscape design business, but it is also my primary vehicle. I will write another review in a few years on this same truck, hopefully with the same positive comments!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: I have had the truck for about 8 months now, and I really love it. I have the 3.7 V6 with the automatic transmission, and it gets a solid 20 mpg! I love the looks of the truck, and I think it is a very solid vehicle. I would buy another one tomorrow! They only hauling I do with it, is my quad. I dont do any towing. if you were going to use the truck for towing, I would recommend the 4.7 V8. Other than that, get the V6 and save some dough! Great truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I just bought a new 2005 Dodge Ram 1500 with the 5.7 HEMI and I love it. Super Fast, powerful engine. I am extrememly pleased with it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my second Ram 1500.I've got the highest praises for it's durability and reliability. Truly the best truck I've ever owned!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab ST Rwd SB (3.7L 6cyl 6M)
Review: This is my third Dodge and I love my new truck. I drove a Chevy for the last 4 years at work. Now I drive a Dodge Ram 1500. It looks and feels like a real truck, if you know what I mean. Great turn radius and handling. Smooth ride and flashy chrome grille. The best thing is the reliabilty.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My second late model Ram (I just traded my 2002). As you see, I'm going on my second Ram. I'm not saying I'm a "Dodge" man, as I've owned lots of makes and models. I rebought the Ram because I like a vehicle that has been good to me. Very roomy and comfortable (I'm 6'6") and well layed out interior. I was in an accident doing 75 MPH in my first Ram and this truck saved my skin (putting it lightly). Best priced truck in the market, I have to laugh at people who say that about Toyota- they obviously haven't priced the Ram. I have shopped around a lot and have seen what others are giving for rebates.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD LB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Fun to driver on or off road and has the power you need. When you need it to pull heavy loads, it still has get up and go even in 4x4. All I can say is, sweet!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck! Get the Hemi !!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: they keep getting better everytime i buy one, just a amazing truck. does what ever i want it to do. hauling capacity dont really know any thing is back there. gas mileage is better than past dodge products have 5.7 hemi in mine and it runs better than the 4.7 smaller engine my friend has in his

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT 4WD SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: THE TRUCK IS GREAT LOOKING. MORE THOUGHT COULD HAVE BEEN PUT INTO INTERIOR DESIGN. THE RIDE IS HARSH TO SAY THE LEAST. I HAVE A VIBRATION IN THE DRIVETRAIN OR SUSPENSION THAT THE DEALER REFUSES TO ACKNOWLEGE. THE HEMI ENGINE HAS AN ANNOYING TICKING SOUND THAT THE DEALER SAYS IS "NORMAL." THE DRIVER'S SEAT SHIFTS WHEN TAKING OFF FROM A STOP-STILL NOT FIXED. ENGINE AND TRANS ARE A GOOD MATCH AND FEEL STRONG.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab SLT Rwd SB (4.7L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Just bought the truck on the 1st of themonth, and have only driven about 1000miles, but I love this truck... I tradedin an '02 Chevy Avalanche and couldn'tbe happier with the trade. I wasoriginally looking for a 2dr, sb Hemibut when I saw the $2600 Solar YellowRumble Bee option package (see dodge.comfor a description as Edmunds makes nomention of this limited edition) withthe dealer installed custom leatherseats, I fell in love with it... I havealways been a fan of yellow and when Itook it for the test drive, the off theline acceleration, tons of power acrossthe powerband and deep throaty exhaustnote had me hooked!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Great truck! Loads of SMOOTH power, Hemi eater, Volant air box, magna flows. have all oem parts available with truck. garaged and babied, shines excellent, interior brand new looking. Note to owners out there, these trucks have wild rear end steer, tighten U bolts with big bar it will improve and tame your beast a lot!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I have owned this truck for 10 years... all I can say is "HOLD ON".  Not a good idea to "hot dog" in the rain, the rear end is so light it could get away from ya.. but on dry flat surface... good bye!  Still handles like a dream at 11yrs old.  Interior still like new.  Exterior paint didn't last more than a few years.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: My wife had a 4 dr truck she loved. She drove it tell it started falling apart. Her dream car is a Viper so I bought her the best of both. A 4 dr srt-10 Viper she loves the truck and I rarely get to drive this one. It has excellent acceleration and braking to match great combo for a truck and fun to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I went looking for a high performance truck from the start. One test drive and I had to have this beast. Don't give a darn about gas mileage. I get about 12mpg in the city and 16mpg on the road. Added a Volant cool air system which makes the engine compartment even better looking. I've had so many people just want to stop me and look at the engine. Plan on adding a supercharger when my extended warranty runs out. Lambo doors in a few weeks for looks.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Well, If you're looking for fuel efficiency, don't buy it. If you're looking to crush sports cars, Lightnings, C600's, this is the truck for you. I've even beat a few SRT8's, almost all SRT4's, and ticked off a few Vettes while it was still stock. What's really fun is when you hit it, and put everyones head in the back of the seat! I for sure bought the right truck for fun.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: This is the best truck I have ever purchased. I have done some extensive mods (custom paint, lambo doors, rims, exhaust, cold air, etc.) but it just added to the fun. I go to many car shows and always get tons of questions or people just look in awe at the engine. It's a shame they stopped producing them. If they ever decide to start up again with maybe 600 hp plus engine, I would be first in line.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I bought my 05 Viper SRT 10 in Tucson AZ. When I first seen it I knew I had to have it. It is white with blue stripes that goes from the front to the rear of the vehicle. 2 dr with all the bells and whistles of course 6 speed. I'm running on 22" like any true player would. My truck is 99 out of 200 made that year. I was told that this might possibly be a collectors item. I presently have 6000 miles on it, shall I sell or keep?!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This the pinnacle of performance trucking. it's a shame that these beast are not produced anymore!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: What a fun truck. It is without a doubt the baddest truck ever built. My biggest complaint is when people ask me how I like that Hemi engine. Maybe if the "viper powered" decal was bigger that wouldn't happen. Brakes are the best of any car, let alone truck out there. handling is great, for a truck. Ride is stiff, but not bad. I'd rather tow with my diesel Ram, so I do. The SRT is just for hauling around town. 0-60 is good, 0-120 is great, 70- 120, not so good, but it is a heavy brick wall to move through the air at those speeds. Buy one and step up, this is the only truck a true "car-guy" can drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I absolutly love this truck. The looks you get, the power it has. This truck will put you back in your seat! I don't think I will ever sell it. I got the black one and it looks really sharp, but hard to keep clean. That is the only thing I would change.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: What can I say that has not already been said? It is pure fun and excitment to drive, and it sure makes heads turn when you drive by. I had to get used to how well this "truck" handles. It bounced me around because the response is so fast and exact. I love it and don't plan on replacing it any time soon.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: The Ram 1500 4x4 4 door is a strong truck with some problems. It has a view issue when turning to your left. The exterior paint is failing from under the clear coat to the top. Bad grip during wet conditions.  It has type of skip when A/C is on and in idle. The dealership showed that all the '05s have it. The bed cover (extra) lock quit working. Engine is powerful though.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: It is a really nice truck to own. It turns heads everywhere you go. If only gas was cheaper than $2.00 dollars so that one could ride it more.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is so much fun! The engine is incredible, the shifts are fairly short considering the length of the lever. Stereo is pretty good, the sub will make the rear view mirror a little tough to see on the heavy bass - worth it to enjoy the good vibrations. So far gas mileage has been pretty good, much better than expected. Handling has also been very positive as have the very comfortable and supportive seats. Hope the quality holds up, so far so good.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I bought the truck 2 months ago and cannot believe that I used to to think my Vortec 454 Chevy was powerful. This truck is awesome to say the least. The V10, 22" wheels, 500 watt stereo, stainless steel trim package are all great. Some owners complain about the mileage, I didn't buy the SRT because it was fuel efficient I bought it because it was fun. I am 40 years old and the truck is one of the fastest vehicles I have ever driven and the fastest I have ever owned. Nice job Dodge!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: When I saw my Ram SRT I fell in love with the way it looked. It looks like it is flying when it is just sitting still. The front of the truck is unlike any other truck out there, being styled very aggressive looking and shouting get out of my way. The interior is actually very comfortable and stylish. The performance of the truck is the main reason I had to have it. The Viper drivetrain is the heart of the truck which makes it a beast. I have driven the truck on small trips to visit family which is 130 miles round trip. The speed limit is 55 mph the entire trip. The truck has averaged 16.5 to 17.8 mpg at a constant speed of 62 mph in 6th gear at 1400 rpm several times. Highway miles only!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: Hands down this truck sets the curve.. personally I would like all that power and performance in a 4x4 .This is my first truck not a 4x4. and was aprehensive, but I am happy with the performance. I know however the day will come when it is stuck on the job site and I am looking for another powered axle. but until then, giddy up!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: This truck is fun to drive. One can feel the power as soon as you start it. Not all cars give you the same feel. My wife has the Porsche Cayenne Turbo and it doesn't come close, it just doesn't feel lke a true 500hp car. With this Dodge baby you know what you have under the hood. The driving is great, although, the turns are a bit wider than most trucks. The only compaint I get from my wife is that the seats are not very comfortable for long travel, and the gas usage, well let's put it this way, those who buy this type of trucks really shouldn't care about that, we know is high, but this truck is a luxury. Last word, this truck make you feel like you're driving a nascar.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: I have never enjoyed driving a vehicle like this since I was 16 and got my first vehicle. Drives like a sports car and I do not feel like I am scooting along on the ground. Anyone looking for a performance truck should take a serious look at this vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Hurricane totaled my '04 and i just had to have another. It's roomy, sporty and has unbelievable power. It may not pin you in your seat, but your neck will snap!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: You can write a review of this truck with just 3 letters, fun! Since buying the truck my C5 vette has been sitting in the garage gathering dust. This truck is just too much fun to park!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Awesome Truck... Demands attention everywhere it goes. People of all ages seem to enjoy the looks of this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Shifting (flat) from 1st to 2nd has to be, I don't know, just WOW.  This truck handles like no truck I've ever been in and better than most cars.  The heck with the gas prices, I love this Truck.  Didn't think I would like shifting again but as for now it's fun again.  MoPar did it right with the SRT-10.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Extremely fun to drive. Very comfortable interior. Looks great inside and out. Lots of positive comments.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: The truck is a ball to drive and handles great. I haven't felt that much power since I had my LS6 70 Chevelle. Dodge did it right building this truck. Try it, you'll like it.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Absolutely the best vehicle I have ever owned, and I'm 50 and have owned a few!  Fit and finish is excellent! I have had no problems with this truck, although I only have 4,000 miles on it so far.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Fun to drive, but not for everyday use. Gas mileage is horrible and have had problems with fuel injection system.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I have had my 2004 SRT-10 for 6 months. It has performed great, it is fun to drive, get's lots of looks, runs very well - will hold it's own with anything on the road!  The only negative is 3rd gear is hard to find under high rpm shifting and reverse is hard to shift into.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is scary fast! If you want to go real fast this truck is for you. Its impressive handling will make you want to go to the nearest speedway and really test it out. The interior is very well designed, and there is plenty of room. The seats are very comfortable. The sound system is fantastic.This is by far, the most exciting vehicle I have ever driven, and owned!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: The power of the SRT-10 is awesome, you really feel the torque every time you drive!! It is a rush when passing traffic, as you step on the accelerator and within seconds the person you passed is now a figment of your imagination!! Anyone with a heavy right foot and the love of a pick-up truck will definitely not be disappointed with this machine!! I will own one of these for the rest of my driving days!!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: I use the truck as daily driver find the truck easy live with do to the engines low end torque and comfy seats. Owned a SVT Lightning before the SRT. The SRT's more rigid frame gives more precise handling. The brakes equal my EVO VIII in feel and stopping power. MPG is accptable at 14 combined highway and city.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is awesome!  I own a 1969 Plymouth GTX with a 4spd and 440-6pac engine and this truck brings all that power and fun back...AND MORE!  500HP and A/C? You cant beat that. I would stay away from the new 4 door version. This truck is a head turner and a magnet for anyone that appreciates a true factory performance vehicle.  I was getting food at the local fast food joint and some kid who worked at the jiffy lube across the street ran down just to get a picture of it so he could tell he friends that he actually saw a REAL SRT-10 Ram in person! When did that ever happen to you in any of your cars? If you dont mind replacing a tire for $350 a piece, this truck is for you!

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Power and performance that rivals my 1995 Viper, with excellent fit and finish.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review: I have owned vehicle for a little over 6 months. Only problem was with the radio. Two days after purchase it stopped working. But It took Chrysler over 5 months to repair the problem because the part was on back order.The truck has great braking, handles  more like a sports car than a truck. First look at the undercarriage and you can see that it is more than a pickup with a large engine. Much more comfotable than a GTS or a SRT10 Viper. Not as fast but more fun to drive.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 2dr Regular Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 6M)
Review: Just an awesome truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2005 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 SRT-10 SRT-10 4dr Quad Cab Rwd SB (8.3L 10cyl 4A)
Review_Title: station to station but fun in between
Review: my first experience with this truck was, Thats it?  I guess i was thinking it will handle like a porshe, but who was i kidding.  This is a heavy, jaw dropping ass whoopin truck.  Built for one thing.  Acceleration  and crazy burnouts.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have had my 2001 Dodge Ram 4x4 quad cab since it has 2 miles on it and it has about 110000 on it now. I love the looks. At 6'7" I love the room and height. Now lets get to the rest. Since I bought it I have replaced the rear end twice. U joints twice. New brakes three times. A brake line broke ( rust) so suddenly that I went to a store with brakes and when I left I had NO brakes. They went to the floor. Replace shocks twice. A/c compressor. I keep it very clean and it still is rusting on the bottom rails. Window fits are terrible ( air noise). I have over serviced this vehicle as far as required maintenance. The cd player went out at 55000 miles and now I have to get a new radio. The engine has held up ok ( knock on wood).  All this that has happened is due to poor parts being used by Dodge and low quality craftsmenship.  They keep saying Ram tough on TV. I say.  Ram is not tough at all.   Then they ask why does Toyota and the other foreign models do so well. They make cars that stand up. Dodge makes them good enough to just get you out the door.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: LOVE LOVE LOVE MY DODGE RAM!!!
Review: My husband purchased this truck for me in 2002 as an anniversary present, it is the best gift he has ever purchased for me! It is now 2014 and I now have 220,000 + miles on it.It is by far the best vehicle we have ever owned!The v8 has plenty of power, fun to drive, reliable, roomy and comfortable.We replaced the transmission at about 120,000 and have put a radiator on it but that is it.Great truck! I can not say enough good things about it.I truly love my truck!It has kept me safe when was hit in the side on 3 different occasions and then on the 4th when a drunk driver hit me.I feel safe it this truck.I praise God 1st and foremost but I am thankful for the quality the truck

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Purchased or 2001 Dodge with only 26,000 miles on it and purchase Dodges "Platanuim" extended warrenty coverage for extra $1900 cost.The best they offered.Within the first year cracks began forming on dash.Took for warrenty but turns out Dodge purposally excluded interior because they used poor quality plastics for years 1999-2003!They tried to tell us is was due to sun exposure...even though truck stays under cover!Has only 52,000 miles on it.Runs like new and looks like new until you look inside.Whole dash is gone!As is the glovebox and all the overhead added storage details!Cheaply made and then won't stand behind it.Trading for a Ford!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD LB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The V8 is peppy,handling good. Turning radius could be better. Dependable, access to bed and cab good, under hood items easy to see/access. Dual exhaust sounds great, fuel mileage better w/duals. My wife loves this truck and says it is easy for her to operate, she's 5ft tall. Good truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Must be a great truck still!
Review: I owned a 2001 dodge ram 1500 for about a year and had to sell it. I am actually in the process of buying another. I was very happy when I had mine. It had plenty of power,drove great and was very comfortable. I did have a bad taste about the gas but who doesn't. I am just surprised that this rating is so low for this vehicle. I mean if gas and a CRACKED DASHBOARD is all there is to complain about? I mean I didn't know the dash had an effect on drivability. Just get a cover like I did.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is an awesome truck. I have put over 90,000 miles on it since I bought it in 04. The Tranny just went out thanks to the Tq Converter at 166,000. Really good for this crappy tranny. I currently have a friend not just rebuilding it but doing it all the way. Everyone who has Tranny problems replace your tq converter with your tranny. I hate the dash. My water pump died at 100.000 and my right front hub bearing went at 100,000. But after all that I love this truck. I have driven it across this country 4 times and about to again. Very comfortable, plenty of power. Tows well past its rating and still hooks even with a bad tq converter. Again awesome truck. I will be driving it for along time.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this truck in 09 only prob was the transmission but other than that i love my dodge ill drive it till the wheels fall off.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I post this review mainly to warn anyone thinking of purchasing a used 1994-2001 Ram 1500 4x4.  Purchased new in 08/01.  The first sign of things to come was when a stranger approached me and started a conversation with "So, have you ever had any trouble with your transmission?"  The list of problems are water pump(bearing), transmission(rebuild at 70k and 95k after all req. service and no off road and towing 2x), "death wobble" (very nasty, do internet search), int. map light, and "Humpty Dumpty" dash.  I call it that 'cause Dodge couldn't or wouldn't put it together again.  Some of these complaints are highly reported on the internet.  It is my first and last Dodge.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Good truck, except for the cracked dash. Changed the thermostat to a colder one, get about 19 mpg hwy, and colder plugs (they like it cold) found that info on bionicdodge (all Dodge people), great place for info. Change the exhaust to dual pipes. Had a trans problem not long after I purchased, under warranty. I guess the owner before me did not know how to drive it (city owner).Now have 112,000+ miles on it, runs great! Love the cab space.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: do not buy a dodge truck
Review: I purchased this truck because it had a lot of interior room but I was warned by co-workers not to purchase a Dodge and I should of listened. The truck is falling apart inside, dashboard has many cracks in it, cd player does not work, a/c has been replaced 6 times... Etc... Dodge will not own up to these issues and there are many complaints about the dashboard issue which makes airbag deployment a real safety issue if it were to deploy... All that cracked plastic would fly like shards of Glass

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The Ram is a overall good truck, its reliable, gets me were i need to go and gets me unstuck through lots of places. The only problem is The dash cracks really really bad and the trim around the gauges.. other than that its a nice truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have owned this truck for two years now and so far no problems. I have the 5.9 and it gives me the power i need to pull my trailer. The only downside is the gas milage is 14-17 and maybe 12 when pulling my trailer.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: So far I have had no problems with my truck. It came with nice aftermarket wheels and its looks good. I will have to say that the 5.9 does not have the best MPG but it can pull my trailer with no problem. Love the room in the engine area. I was able to change/get to the plugs with no problem. Hope to get some good years out of this truck

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Bought it at 72500 miles for a dependable move from WA to Anchorage AK. It was dependable even with the - 20 temperatures of living there. 14MPG at utmost best towing a 6x12 U-haul all 2400 miles to AK was about 9.5MPG. Replaced a couple u-joints and both front wheel bearings at 105000 miles after we moved back.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought my 2001 Dodge Ram 1500 Quad Cab 4X4 brand new in January 2001. I hadn't had any problems with it at all until about two years ago when the dashboard started with one small crack. Now the entire dashboard looks like a jigsaw puzzle. And, Dodge hasn't done a recall on the dashboards? I'm disappointed. As much as I love my truck, I'm seriously considering trading it in on anything in which the manufacturer will stand behind the product.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: is this what a dodge is?
Review: my wife loved the looks and sound, but I found the 5.2l underpowered and the trans a joke. one of the most comfortable trucks on the road, but it labored badly with just my 16 ft boat at 60mph. my 02 Chevy doesn't know it's there with the 4.8l

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD LB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: i love this truck...it's very nice..it catches a lot of attention with its sport and off road packages and its sound...i wash it 2 times a month and still don't let people eat in it...i will be getting the 2009 dodge ram when it comes out, i will ALWAYS buy dodges (i hate chevy and toyota) even if they go out of business. has a lot more power then the 2003 toyota tundra...love this truck

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I love this truck. This one of the best truck I have ever seen, I put around 55000 on the truck since I bought it and I drive it really hard and not one problem. Replaced the water pump when it leaked. I can haul 2000 pounds of stuff in the back and the truck pulls great. I have the Off- Road Pac, and the truck will out drive any but the most lifted of chevys and ford which usually get broke down anyways. My only problem is the gas mileage with the 5.9 and 4.10 gears is awful. I am luck to get 14 on the highway but then I don't have to pay to keep the truck running other than that.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This has been a very good truck for the time that I have owned it, the only problems that I have had with it is the O2 sensor and spark plug wires, which is basically just regular parts that are going to need to be changed eventually. This truck has got plenty of power with the 5.9L v8. The truck sits high for a stock truck, when I pull up to the other competitor trucks and they have the 2500 or 3500, or 250, 350, etc. I am usually the same height or a little bit higher, which makes the truck seem a lot bigger for the model. I would buy this truck again, no questions asked.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Great truck to drive. I basically use it to hunt and pull my boat.  Plenty of power, just wish that it got better gas mileage. I had removed the muffler and run straight pipes and the mileage went from 8-10 to 12-15mpg. With 50k it looks and drives great! Pulls a 18ft tyee with no problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Excellent truck, great styling. Strong engine. Bought to tow a trailer and looking forward to it

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I fell in love with the sound and look of this truck. That's the only good thing about this truck. It's had a new transmission ,which still does not shift right. Replaced the power steering pump, it just cut off the other day going down the road. The heated seats no longer work. The truck will just crank up sitting in the yard with no key or anybody in it. The dealer told me to call ghost busters. I would of thought it would of pulled better than this. My dad's F-150, with a 4.6L, will out pull and out run this. I have a K&N air filter and still get about 10 to 11mpg hwy. If you put an empty trailer behind it it drops to about 8mpg. The truck's interior is real comfy. I will never buy a Dodge again.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Great truck, bad dealer & ball joints
Review: I love the truck, in spite of the fact that 15mpg isn't obtainable if you drive 75% on Interstates. 18mpg on sticker (5.9L) is possibly a simple lie. I took delivery after the dealer did a "safety inspection" and found all 4 ball joints had deteriorated leaving the joints open to sand and dirt incursion. In addition, all four tires were abraded near the inside bead due to the 245/85R16 tires being too large for the truck ($800+). The ball joints need a recall and replacement with joints that can be lubricated (figure on $900+). I have a bad back but the truck is a great ride! The front seat is comfortable althought I will probably replace the bench with buckets.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD LB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Outstanding drivetrain, comfortable ride. It is used for work truck. Found after purchase, the boots on the "lifetime" front upper and lower bearings were all cracked and the tires were rubbing the steering because they were oversized.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought this used and from day one put it to work and has done everthing I've wanted it to do from loads to pulling. The suspension is great. I can load the bed and does not sag. The harder I work it the more it wants. A couple of things though. I only get about 10-12 mph maybe 14 tops. I notice there is a delay or no resposne when most times when gas is pushed (at a cruise speed)until you get down on it little. Tried everything to correct this don't know if design or a problem. Overall very satisfied.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck is better than my last two trucks which were both Fords . It has more wheel hop durring tight turns while in 4 wheel drive than my other  4 x4's , 2 Fords and a GMC .The others had shorter wheel bases which may be the reason .

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I purchased this 01 Ram 1500 Quad Cab 4wd with the 360 back in January. So far it has been a pretty good truck. The brakes have started squeeking slightly so need to be replaced but that happens with any vehicle. The other problem I have had is the dash has started cracking which is a common problem and just kind of annoys me. The chrome grill has also started bubbling but not very noticable unless up close.  That's the bad now for the good. I love the truck it's pretty powerful and fun to drive. Rides pretty good especially since mines lifted and mud tires. It does great offroad while looking great. The interior is comfortable and the 360 has plenty of power to haul you around town.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Good truck overall. Dodge needs to put a better transmission in this full sized truck. Just replaced for the second time at 121,000 miles. Terrible gas mileage of 13.5 city, 15.5 highway.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Overall, very satisfied.  Have done little more than change oil, basic maintenance.  Only "major" issue so far has been water pump at $200.  Does have a few irritating squeaks, but overall has been a good, reliable vehicle.  Car seat in back holds young kids well, but back seat room and comfort rate a 1.  Gets 17.7 mpg highway (to-from work), so not bad.  Excellent front seat comfort for big people (I'm 6'4").  I'm not keen on the maintenance schedule (manual states to change plugs/wires every 30K).  I did have to pay $500 to have this done ... no way a homeowner could change these without major difficulty, and it should be a simple thing to do.  Air filter change could be made easier too.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: All though I don't have a ton of miles on the truck, it's more fun than a pile of puppies to drive. Gas mileage isn't spectacular but it'll get the job done. Nice pulling capabilities, good ride, and lots of fun gadgets on this model. No real problems to speak of. I had the dealer go through it before the warranty ran out and take care of a couple of minor problems. Additions like cold air intake and catback are nice and help the HP/mileage a little.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have had no problems with this truck of any kind.  Owned it for two years.  The interior is really comfortable for long drives.  Fits both car seats in the back and tows anything I put on the back of it.  Of course mileage is bad but most trucks do not get good mileage.  If you want good mileage go buy a Metro and park the truck.  My truck has the 5.2L.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Very happy with this truck.  The ride and handling are great. The styling is excellent (better than the new ones). Overall size and function are just what I wanted. Not impressed by the gas mileage, but it is as good as Ford or Chevy at least. It seems well put together, no squeaks or rattles. Nothing falling off, no minor glitches.  I had a 1997 just like this one and it was also fun to drive, trouble free and gave me no reason not to buy this one, I only switched to get one with lower miles and the newer sport styling

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This has been a work horse from day one. I have not been easy on this truck in the slightest, and it just keeps begging for more. I will definately be purchasing another one if this one ever slows down, but untill then, she has been the best truck I have ever owned!!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Have fought to get 18mpg on the

column1: highway.  Had the truck for 25000 miles
before the ECU was programmed
correctly.  Before that the mileage was
16mpg highway.  Dodge service is awful
in every shop I've been to.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: So, is this the new bluesmoblile or what
Review: Sharp looking truck with the sport

column1: option. The grill that is the same
color as the truck.  Love the room in
the front seats. I'm satisified
with truck and service at dealer.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Overall style is great and when the truck is clean, it gets all kinds of comments, not bad for a out of date body style.  Seems to have a high step in for half ton two wheel drive, higher than old 88 3/4 ton chevy 4x4.  Love the extended cab, will never go back to regular cab.  Car seats works great in the middle of back seat and allows for easy reach to the little one.  So far, its been mostly trouble free driving, change the oil, add gas, gas, gas...  5.2 needs to be able to breath more than it does, feels a little on the weak side for the weight of the truck.  Maybe that would help with the gas milage.  But it is a truck after all.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: Looks good but I think I have a lemon
Review: The truck ran good until I hit the 28,000 mile mark where I started to run into engine problems.  Looking on www.alldata.com, a internet resource that shows common errors with all makes and models, I found the symptoms I was experiencing.  The dealership updated my computer and repaired a couple things.  Since then I have been bringing it back just about every month.  The lastest trouble was when I was running at 60 and the truck just cut out.  The truck only has 34,000 milies on it what kind of build quality is that?

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: No problems. Great truck. Comfortable on long trips. Not much room in back seat,adults would be a little cramped.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I bought the Dodge 1500 Ram SLT Laramie in March 01.No problems until this year Feb 04, with 1 month left to go on the waranty and 28500 miles the trans began to slip.The truck was tied up for two weeks at the dealer before they finally agreed to repair it.The front tires wear on the outside even though i rotate every 3000 miles and had the front end adjusted at 12000 and 20000 miles. The front wheel bearings will be next I guess.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 2WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have the extended cab 5.9L SPORT, I LOVE IT! Itty bitty girl, in a big truck, but hey, it works. I have yet to lose a race =). Flowmasters are a definate must b/c Dodges have a distinct low rumble... yummy. Very roomy in the interior and under the hood, I love working on it. Lacks in rear seat space, pulls to the right, and I have a squeeking noise coming from the front, I just turn up the radio though. Fast for a big heavy truck, and so many extras to put on it. Only thing I hate is the gas mileage. I average 13 mpg. I'm sure racing doesn't help that either though...

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have 34000 miles on my 4by4 slt with the 5.9 in it.Most impressed by its offroad prowess.I remember the first winter i had it.It snowed 17 inches in 1 day,and on a small residential road leading to a recreation area,only half was plowed.The other half had a good 2 ft of snow.Anyways,i drove right thru the 2 ft of snow like a hot knife thru butter.No problems to date.One minor irritation.It has a slight pull to the right.Could be a design flaw,as numerous accounts of this occurance,and no remedy that i know of.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Dodge Ram Pickup 1500 Quad Cab 4dr Quad Cab ST 4WD SB (5.2L 8cyl 5M)
